entries.zh: §SFirst Contact§!是一个探索与前超光速文明早期遭遇的故事包。该故事包同时还引入了隐形科技！
entries.en: §SFirst Contact§! is a story pack that explores early encounters with pre-FTL civilizations. This story pack also introduces Cloaking technology!

entries.zh: 我们推荐§SFirst Contact§!，因为该故事包所包含的新特色可以让你与前超光速社会的交互更加动态和具有沉浸感。
entries.en: We're recommending §SFirst Contact§! as the new features contained in this story pack make interactions with pre-FTL societies more dynamic and engaging.

entries.zh: 我们推荐§SFirst Contact§!因为你所选的部分变量适用于其中的内容。该故事包着重于与前太空文明的外交、谍报和对其发展的观测。
entries.en: We're recommending §SFirst Contact§! as some of the variables you've selected suit its content. This story pack focuses on diplomacy, espionage, and observing the development of pre-FTL civilizations.

entries.zh: 弥那玛特种实业集团自诩为一个仁善的企业，致力于向欠发达的文明提供技术以促进其进步。多亏了公司激进的高利贷业务和横跨整个星系的契约劳工，股东们受到保证，能够收取丰厚的红利。
entries.en: Styling themselves a benevolent corporation, Minamar Specialized Industries offers technological advancement to underdeveloped civilizations. Thanks to the company's aggressive usury and a galaxy-spanning pool of indentured labor, shareholders are guaranteed a handsome return on investment.

entries.zh: 自打$NAME_MSI_country$的董事会第一次将我们的文明送抵星辰，我们就明白这样一个道理，宇宙是如此瑰丽璀璨，不将其分享给他人乃是暴殄天物。从那时起，我们就不遗余力地帮助欠发展的文明实现超光速旅行。\n\n尽管启蒙并不是免费的，但在$NAME_MSI_country_initials$，这是一笔值得的投资。
entries.en: From the moment the Board of Directors at $NAME_MSI_country$ first delivered our civilization to the stars, we have understood that the galaxy was too beautiful not to be shared. Since then, we have worked tirelessly to help less developed civilizations achieve FTL travel.\n\nEnlightenment may not be free. But at $NAME_MSI_country_initials$, it is always worth the cost.

entries.zh: —游戏开始时成为§H高级帝国§!\n—开局时拥有一些被奴役的£pop£§H人口§!，它们是从全星系的各个§H前超光速文明§!处绑架得来。\n—允许采用§H$bombardment_raiding$§!轰炸姿态，能够从行星上绑架£pop£§H人口§!，并将其重新迁移到你的殖民地。
entries.en: - Starts as an §HAdvanced Empire§!\n- Start with a number of enslaved £pop£ §HPops§! abducted from §HPre-FTL Civilizations§! across the galaxy.\n- Allows the §H$bombardment_raiding$§! bombardment stance, which abducts £pop£ §HPops§! from planets and resettles them to your colonies.
We have made contact with [MSI_country.GetName] in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! system.

entries.zh: 我们已与[MSI_country.GetName]取得联系。当务之急的事情是，我们必须要小心翼翼地驾驭不断变化的局势。我们应该派遣一名特使来代表我们的利益。无论与我们以前的主人进行任何互动，这肯定会对我们的人民产生深远的心理影响。
entries.en: Contact has been made with [MSI_country.GetName]. It's imperative that we navigate the evolving situation carefully. An envoy should be be dispatched to represent our interests. Any interaction with our former masters is sure to have a profound psychological effect on our people.

entries.zh: 在§H[This.System.GetName]§!遭遇的外星飞船上得到的数据让我们不寒而栗。它的外观我们再熟悉不过了，上面的徽章宛如我们恐惧的象征：§H$NAME_MSI_country$§!的带翼图章。\n\n我们找到了曾经的侵略者。他们发现我们这些舰船的身份只是时间的问题，因为使用的完全都是他们的科技。新的接触不可避免，但我们绝不会重复过去的错误。
entries.en: Data on the alien vessels we encountered in the §H[This.System.GetName]§! was met with a shudder of recognition. Familiar ship designs, marked by an emblem we learned to fear: the winged logo of the §H$NAME_MSI_country$§!.\n\nOur former invaders have been found. It's only a matter of time until they realize the ships they sighted are ours, fueled by their own technology. A new contact may be unavoidable, but we can avoid repeating past errors.

entries.zh: 开始同§Y$NAME_MSI_country$§!进行§Y第二次接触§!流程。
entries.en: Starts the §YSecond Contact§! process with the §Y$NAME_MSI_country$§!.

entries.zh: §R-警告：具有挑战性的起源§!\n这个文明曾被一个异星帝国造访过，这个帝国强行启蒙了他们，之后奴役了他们。如今他们击退了入侵者，但那些入侵者有朝一日还会回来吗？
entries.en: §RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!\nThis civilization has been visited by an alien empire who forcibly enlightened and enslaved them. They have repelled their invaders, but will they return?

entries.en: Enlightenment may not be free. But at $NAME_MSI_country_initials$, it is always worth the cost.

entries.zh:
我们曾经做过一个交易。

当来自外部星辰的访客显露身形时，他们向我们提供了一份公平的合同：技术启蒙，分期偿还。在一代人的时间里，我们的行星被转变成为了一个所谓的“先进文明”。

然后我们才了解到小字条款：为了偿还我们的“债务”，他们坚持要我们为他们劳作，而且是无限期的。我们的领袖对此反对，但这些外来者马上翻脸动用了暴力。我们奋起反抗。

我们赢了，但是赢得十分艰难，并且为此付出了惨烈得代价。现在，我们的科学家终于从过去我们摧毁的飞船上，通过逆向工程攻破了超光速旅行的秘密。宇宙很大，但迟早我们肯定会再次遇到我们的“恩人”。而实际上，我们也迫不及待，摩拳擦掌。

现在是时候血债血偿了。
entries.en:
We had a deal.

When the visitors from the stars revealed themselves, they offered us a fair contract: technological enlightment, to be repaid in installments. Within a generation, our planet was transformed into a so-called 'advanced civilization.'

Then we read the fine print: to repay our 'debt', they insisted we work for them, on an indefinite term. When our leaders protested, the outsiders turned violent. We fought back.

We won, though barely, and only after suffering sizeable losses. Now, our scientists have finally reverse-engineered the secrets of FTL travel from the ships we destroyed. It's a big galaxy out there, but sooner or later we're sure to meet our 'benefactors' again. In fact, we're looking forward to it.

It's time to get some payback.

entries.zh: 坠毁的残骸来自于停驻在轨道上的弥那玛飞船，残骸覆盖了一大片区域，阻碍了这颗行星的发展。
entries.en: The crashed debris from the orbiting Minamar ship covers a massive area, blocking development of the planet.

entries.zh: 清理 MSI 舰船的残骸或许能够找到科技数据或资源。
entries.en: Clearing the debris from the MSI ship could lead to a recovery of technological data or resources.

entries.zh: 在[from.GetName]清理舰船残骸时，找到了一箱科技数据。
entries.en: While clearing the ship debris on [from.GetName], a cache of technological data was recovered.

entries.zh: 在[from.GetName]清理出的舰船残骸可以回收利用。
entries.en: The ship debris cleared on [from.GetName] can be repurposed for our own use.

entries.zh: 侵略者的到来使我们的星球团结统一起来。现在我们已经重新掌握了自己的命运，要做的工作有很多。
entries.en: The arrival of the invaders unified our planet. Now that we have regained control of our destiny, there is work to be done.

entries.zh: 由损毁的弥那玛飞船产生的轨道残骸频繁地掉落到下方的行星上。任何地表基础设施都需要更加频繁和更多投入的修复工作，才能恢复造成的损害。
entries.en: The orbiting debris from the wrecked Minamar ship frequently rains down upon the planet below. Any surface infrastructure will require more regular and intensive maintenance to repair the damage done.

entries.zh: 在前弥特集团的战舰内部，我们遇到了一个千载难逢的机会，可以解锁他们科技的奥秘。
entries.en: The interior of the former MSI warship provides us with an unmatched opportunity to unlock the secrets of their technology.

entries.zh: 这些通风装置结合了最新的芳香疗法和先进的化学技术，掩盖了绝望的恶臭，取而代之的是各种令人振奋和愉快的气味。
entries.en: These ventilation units combine the latest advances in aromatherapy with advanced chemistry to mask the malodorous stench of despair and replace it with a variety of invigorating and delightful scents.

entries.zh: 为了自由，就要付出稳定的代价。
entries.en: Freedom is the cost of stability.

entries.zh: 为了稳定，就要付出自由的代价。
entries.en: Stability is the cost of freedom.

entries.zh: 同我们前入侵者的会面促使我们的政坛领袖、宗教人士、科学家、艺术家和外交官之间举行了一场紧急会议。各界人士纷纷就各种战略进行讨论、否定、重新论证、改进、投票表决。经过几个月的高强度磋商，我们帝国最聪明的头脑已经达成了类似于共识的东西。
entries.en: The sighting of our former invaders has prompted an emergency meeting between political leaders, religious figures, scientists, artists, and diplomats. Strategies have been discussed, rejected, reconsidered, improved, voted on. After months of tense consultations, the brightest minds of our empire have reached something resembling a consensus.

entries.zh: 我们会让他们瞧瞧，这里谁才是老大！
我们要求对等沟通交流。
entries.en: We'll demand to be treated as equals.

entries.zh: 我们会让他们就过去的所作所为做出赔偿！
entries.en: We'll make them pay for what they did to us!

entries.zh: 我们不愿同他们产生进一步的冲突。
entries.en: We seek no further conflict with them.

entries.zh: 我们不希望同异种产生交流。
entries.en: We desire no further contact with xenos.

entries.zh: 我们不能让恐惧阻止自己探索星海的步伐。
entries.en: We can't let fear stop us from exploring the galaxy.

entries.zh: 信徒的试炼必须要进行处理。
entries.en: The trials of the faithful must be dealt with in turn.

entries.zh: 我们希望研究他们。知己知彼。
entries.en: We want to study them. Know your enemy.

entries.zh: 尽管采取了一些安管措施，我们与§H$NAME_MSI_country$§!发生遭遇的新闻依然传播给了公众，给这个刚刚开始从苦痛的过往中恢复过来的行星造成了不小的混乱。公众舆论……难以统一：有许多持不同看法的声音，从出离的愤怒到不怀好意的怀旧之情。无论我们作出什么样的决策，都会需要一定的暴力阻力。
entries.en: Despite security measures, news of our encounter with the §H$NAME_MSI_country$§! is spreading to the public, bringing chaos to a planet that was just beginning to recover from its past. Public opinion is... Fragmented: many dissenting voices, expressing everything from rage to ill-aimed nostalgia. Regardless of the decision, our actions will be met with violence.

entries.zh: 他们有权表达自己的观点。
entries.en: They have the right to express their views.

entries.zh: 经过长时间的周密准备，我们的特使已经向$NAME_MSI_country_initials$呈递了一条信息。我们已经准备好按照自己的条件会见前主人，为我们人民的意愿发声。
entries.en: After extended preparations, our envoys have sent a message to the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$. We are ready to meet our former masters on our terms, giving voice to the will of our people.

entries.zh: 前入侵者为我们建造的§Y$building_medical_2$§!已经年久失修。其中的大部分科技超出了我们目前的认知，但我们还是可以试着§S修复§!一下。\n\n§L与其他的帝国签订科研协议将会提高我们成功的概率。[GetAgreementStatus]§!
entries.en: The §Y$building_medical_2$§! our invaders built for us are suffering from lack of maintenance. While most of the technology is beyond our current understanding, we could try to §Srepair§! it.\n\n§LSigning research pacts with other empires will increase our chances of success. [GetAgreementStatus]§!

entries.zh: 我们尚且没有同任何能够帮助我们的国家签署科研协议。
entries.en: We don't have a research agreement with an empire able to help us.

entries.zh: 我们同一个能够帮助我们的国家签署了科研协议。
entries.en: We have at least one research agreement with an empire able to help us.

entries.zh: 由于失去了$building_medical_2$，我们的生活质量受到了严重影响。
entries.en: The loss of our $building_medical_2$ severely impacted our quality of life.

entries.zh: 别忘了服用你的维生素！
$payback_declining_healthcare_desc$但另一方面，尸体的质量大大改善了。
entries.en: $payback_declining_healthcare_desc$ It also improved the quality of our dead.

entries.zh: 只有一劳永逸地摧毁这些外星人的医疗设施，我们才能治愈真正的伤痛。
entries.en: Only through the destruction of these alien medical facilities can we can ever truly heal.

entries.zh:
“我们要终结疾病。”

这就是入侵者们赢得我们的方式。我们允许他们在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上建造§Y$building_medical_2$§!，在一代人的时间里根除了绝大多数最要命的疾病。然而现在，这些诊所正在停摆，多年的高强度使用导致里面的机器陷入了停滞状态。我们无法得知这些入侵者的先进技术是如何正常运作的。我们能否对其进行逆向工程？或者我们应该把这个有毒的礼物改造成某种真正属于我们的东西？
entries.en:
"We are going to end illness."

That's how the invaders won us over. We allowed them to build §Y$building_medical_2$§! on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], eradicating most of our worst diseases within a generation. Now, those clinics are breaking down, years of intense use causing the machines within to grind to a halt. The proper functioning of the invader's technology is beyond us. Can we reverse-engineer it? Or should we repurpose this poisoned gift into something truly our own?

entries.zh: $origin.4300.base.desc$尽管其他国家可能也有类似的设施，但是向异种求助无疑会让我族蒙羞。
entries.en: $origin.4300.base.desc$Other empires might possess similar facilities, but asking the xenos for help would only bring us shame.

entries.zh: $origin.4300.base.desc$其他国家可能也有类似的设施。我们应该开口求助。
entries.en: $origin.4300.base.desc$Other empires might possess similar facilities. We should ask for help.

entries.zh: $origin.4300.base.desc$如果我们多认识些朋友就好了。
在行星面板上选择§Y$building_medical_2$§!，点击§S修复§!按钮尝试对其修复。同其他国家签署§S科研协议§!能够提高成功修复的概率。
entries.en: Select the §Y$building_medical_2$§! on the planetary view screen and click the §Srepair§! button to attempt a fix. Establishing §Sresearch agreements§! with other empires will increase our chances of success.

entries.zh: 将§Y$building_medical_2$§!转变成一座§Y$building_autochthon_monument$§!，花费会有所减少。
entries.en: Turn the §Y$building_medical_2$§! into an §Y$building_autochthon_monument$§! at a reduced cost.

entries.zh: 将§Y$building_medical_2$§!转变成一座§Y$building_galactic_memorial_1$§!，花费会有所减少。
entries.en: Turn the §Y$building_medical_2$§! into a §Y$building_galactic_memorial_1$§! at a reduced cost.

entries.zh: 我们的前入侵者或许会将这一切视作来去无踪的狗屎运，或者宣称修复工作是由他们主导的。他们甚至会说，我们所做的对§Y$building_medical_2$§!背后的技术进行逆向工程压根就不是什么壮举。
entries.en: Our former invaders would likely wave it off as a stroke of luck, or argue that they did most of the work. They would claim it's not a big feat, to retro-engineer the technology behind the §Y$building_medical_2$§! as we just did.

entries.zh: $origin.4301.base.desc$但不管他们说什么，我们都自主独立地完成了，没有他们的任何协助，这下胜利独属于我们了。
entries.en: $origin.4301.base.desc$ But we did it anyway, without their assistance, and the triumph is ours alone.

entries.zh: $origin.4301.base.desc$但不管他们说什么，在慷慨的盟友派出的专家的帮助下，我们都完成了。
entries.en: $origin.4301.base.desc$ But we did it anyway, supported by the expertise of our generous allies.

entries.zh: 或许……外星人也不全都是那么坏？
entries.en: Perhaps... the Xenos aren't all bad?

entries.zh: 我们能够自己照顾自己。
entries.en: We can take care of ourselves.

entries.zh: 事实证明，要想对使§Y$building_medical_2$§!运转的技术进行逆向工程，这件事比我们料想的更具挑战性。但我们的[root.GetEngineerPlural]仍然充满希望。他们说，自己只是需要更多的时间。然而，随着成本和失败开始堆积，一些人认为应当对诊所进行改造，使其用于另一项事务。
entries.en: Reverse engineering the technology powering the §Y$building_medical_2$§! turned out to be more challenging than expected, but our [root.GetEngineerPlural] remain hopeful. They just need more time, they say. But as costs and failures start piling up, some argue the clinics should be retrofitted to suit a different purpose.

entries.zh: 这次没那么容易失败了。
我们尝试维修§Y$building_medical_2$§!的努力最终失败了：巨大的爆炸吞没了建筑，现场死伤惨重。\n\n无疑，前入侵者一定正在嗤嗤嘲笑我们的自大、愚蠢和鲁莽。这次失败我们咎由自取，但这堂课我们也同样印象深刻。
entries.en: Our attempt to repair the §Y$building_medical_2$§! ended in failure: a massive explosion engulfed the building, and numerous casualties have been reported.\n\nNo doubt our former invaders are laughing, calling us arrogant, foolish, unprepared. Yet this failure belongs to us, and its hard lessons will not be forgotten.

entries.zh: 我们的§Y$building_medical_2$§!可能不再能够治愈疾病，但是通过将一些关键部件拆卸下来，并将其重新用于纪念馆的展出，至少我们能够开始治愈入侵者留下的疤痕。与过去和解，我们才能逐渐克服这一切。
entries.en: Our §Y$building_medical_2$§! may no longer have the power to cure disease, but by stripping them of their components and repurposing them into memorials, we can at least start to heal the scars left by the invaders. By making peace with the past, we can learn to overcome it.

entries.zh: 由于我们失去了§Y$building_medical_2$§!，医疗保障的质量急剧下降。曾经很容易治愈的遗传病和慢性病病例又开始上升，我们的预期寿命中位数返回到了占领前的水平。公众对医疗保障系统的信心已经达到了新的低点，我们中的一些人甚至开始感叹，入侵者走了不如不走。
entries.en: The loss of our §Y$building_medical_2$§! has precipitated a sharp decline in the quality of our healthcare. Genetic conditions and chronic illnesses that were once simple to cure are again on the rise, and our median life expectancy has returned to pre-occupation levels. Public faith in the healthcare system has reached a new low, and some of our people are even starting to lament the departure of the invaders.

entries.zh: 在医疗研究方面加倍投入。
entries.en: Double our investment in medical research.

entries.zh: 提高发现§Y$tech_frontier_health$§!科技的可能性。
entries.en: Increases the likelihood of discovering §Y$tech_frontier_health$§! technology.

entries.zh: 死亡对我们来说从来不是问题。
entries.en: Death has never been a problem for us.

entries.zh: 在掌握了基因工程的奥秘之后，我们的人民现在有能力建造§Y$building_medical_2$§!，其能力水平同入侵者先前留下来的那些一模一样。对我们的人民来说，这是极其光荣的一天：证明我们无需[root.species.GetHandName]的把控，也能触及星辰。
entries.en: Having mastered the secrets of genetic engineering, our people are now able to build §Y$building_medical_2$§! like the ones left by the invaders. It's a glorious day for our people: proof that we need no [root.species.GetHandName]-holding to reach the stars.

entries.zh: 轨道上的残骸属于一艘曾经强大的战舰。
entries.en: The orbiting remains of a once powerful warship.

entries.zh: 曾经威胁我们家园的战舰仍然高悬在头顶，严酷地提醒着我们侥幸逃脱的命运。现在该去夺回我们的天空，取回这艘舰船残骸中的高超科技了。
entries.en: The warship that once threatened our homeworld still looms over us, a stark reminder of the fate we narrowly escaped. It is time to take back our skies and salvage the technological marvels contained within the wreck.

entries.zh: 与外星侵略者的战斗使我们的母星系充满了残骸、破碎的战舰和背弃的诺言。大量的废弃物料散布其中，使得从[owner.capital_scope.GetName]研发卫星和发射宇宙飞船变得更加困难。得益于清理计划的提出，专门设计的工程船可以用网在近地轨道上进行清理，让我们逐渐打通去往那艘仍漂浮在我们首都上空的$NAME_MSI_country_initials$战舰的路线。
entries.en: The battle against the alien invaders left our home system full of debris, shattered warships, and broken promises. The sheer amount of flotsam cluttering the area has made it harder to develop satellites and to launch spaceships from [owner.capital_scope.GetName]. Under the proposed cleanup project, specially-designed construction ships will utilize nets to dredge the space in near-orbit, allowing us to approach the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ warship that still looms over our capital.

entries.zh: 我们星系中的清理工程正在顺利进行中。[owner.capital_scope.GetName]上空的碎片数量大幅减少了。随着天空逐渐明晰，我们的未来也变得越来越光明。工作仍在继续，一切都在向好的方向发展。
entries.en: The cleanup operation in our system is well underway. The amount of debris over [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has been significantly reduced, and with clearing skies, our expectations for the future are also bright. Work continues, but things are looking better.

entries.zh: 清理工作已经大功告成了。穿过这一片没有碎片的天空，我们的科研船就可以靠近战舰并安全地开始探索残骸。
entries.en: The cleanup operation is now complete. With our skies free from debris, our science ships are now able to approach the warship and safely explore the wreck.

entries.zh: 我们的传感器无法在废弃战舰中探测到任何生命迹象，空空如也的船舱里引擎仍在轻微地嗡嗡作响，各种机械也还在运转。有理由相信，这艘船仍可正常运转，如果强行登船肯定会激活其安保系统。\n\n我们务必谨慎开展工作。
entries.en: Our sensors cannot detect signs of life within the derelict warship, and yet the engines still faintly buzz and machines are at work inside the empty halls. There is good reason to believe the ship is still operational, and attempts to board it are sure to awaken its security system.\n\nWe must proceed with caution.

entries.zh: 我们的施工人员正在清除碎片，修复损伤并确保舱室安全，把这艘曾经威胁我们星球的战舰变成新的行动基地。在残骸中，我们找到了越来越多的船员尸体或者残肢断臂。\n\n如何处理这些遗体引发了公众的热议。
entries.en: Our construction crews are clearing debris, repairing damage and securing rooms, turning the warship that once terrorized our world into a base of operations. Amidst the wreckage, we have uncovered the bodies of the ship's crew, or rather, what's left of them.\n\nWhat to do with these remains is a matter of public debate.

entries.zh: 恶人也应该得到妥善安葬。
entries.en: Even villains deserve a proper burial.

entries.zh: 当我们仔细搜索战舰的中央数据库的时候，我们逐渐搞清楚了前任主人的整个计划。他们打着启蒙的幌子接近我们，只是为了将我们训练成为更好的奴隶；他们满怀善意呈上的计划和协议，只不过是精心编织的谎言。我们的星球显然不是他们第一次这么干，而是他们核心“商业战略”的一个典范。
entries.en: As we scour the warship's central database, the designs of our former masters have grown clear. The way they approached with enlightenment, only to train us to become better slaves; their well-honed plans and protocols; their calculated lies. Our world was clearly not their first attempt, but rather an example of their core 'business strategy.'

entries.zh: 我们已经完全控制了这艘废弃战舰的系统。我们现在必须决定如何处理它。根据我们的需求，它对于战争和研究都可以成为非常有利用价值的资源。
entries.en: We have gained complete control of the derelict warship's systems. We now must decide what to do with it. Depending on our needs, it could be a powerful asset for either war or research.

entries.zh: 让我们可以将战舰修复成一艘§H旗舰§!或§H居住站§!。
entries.en: Allows us to restore the warship into either a §HFlagship§! or §HHabitat§!.

entries.zh: 前 MSI 战舰将得到修复，为我们所用。
entries.en: MSI's former warship will be restored to serve our purposes.

entries.zh: 这艘战舰将成为我们舰队的瑰宝。\n\n这艘战舰将得到修复，变成一艘功能齐全的§H旗舰§!，能够作为一个移动船坞使用。
entries.en: The warship will become the gem of our fleet.\n\nThe warship shall be repaired and turned into a functioning §HFlagship§!.

entries.zh: 这艘战舰经过改造之后，现在将用于科学研究。\n\n经过修复之后，这台曾经的死亡机器现在被转变成一个功能齐全的§H居住站§!，致力于揭开弥特集团科技的秘密。
entries.en: The warship will now be retrofitted for scientific research.\n\nFollowing repairs, this former instrument of death will be fully converted into a functioning §HHabitat§!, devoted to uncovering the secrets of MSI's technology.

entries.zh: 技术的最新进展使得我们能够改装旗舰，用上一些以前未使用过的系统。
entries.en: Recent advances in our technology will allow us to refit our flagship to make use of some previously unused systems.

entries.zh: 对前弥特集团战舰进行改造的工作已经完成。现在我们能够指挥一艘具有强大火力和战略意义的舰船了。\n\n接招吧，星辰大海！
entries.en: The retrofit of the former MSI Warship is complete. We now have at our disposal a vessel of massive power and significance.\n\nWatch out, galaxy!

entries.zh: 战舰已经修复成为了一艘§H旗舰§!，能够在[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的轨道上作为一个移动船坞。
entries.en: The warship in orbit of [owner.capital_scope.GetName] has been restored into a §HFlagship§!.

entries.zh: 对前弥特集团战舰进行改造的工作已经完成。现在我们拥有了最先进的科研设施，它将会为我们推进科技知识的开发提供帮助。
entries.en: The retrofit of the former MSI Warship is complete. We have now gained a state of the art science facility which will be instrumental to us in advancing our technological knowledge.

entries.zh: 战舰已经被修复成了一座§H居住站§!，在[owner.capital_scope.GetName]的轨道上专门攻破弥特集团科技的秘密。
entries.en: The warship has been restored into a §HHabitat§!, devoted to uncovering the secrets of MSI's technology, in orbit of [owner.capital_scope.GetName].

entries.zh: 最近我们在舰船设计方面有所进步，使我们对升级旗舰、利用以前未使用的系统有了深入了解。
entries.en: Recent advancements in our ship designs have led to an insight in how to upgrade our flagship to make use of previously unused systems.

entries.zh: 开启一项升级旗舰的特殊项目。
entries.en: Enables a Special Project to upgrade the flagship.

entries.zh: 我们已经升级了旗舰。利用船上现有的技术，我们能够对它的系统进行逆向工程，以获得对飞船内部运作更好的了解。
entries.en: We have upgraded the flagship. Utilizing the existing technology onboard, we have been able to reverse-engineer its systems and gain a better understanding of the inner workings of the vessel.

entries.zh: 我们的旗舰已经升级，可以利用以前未使用的系统。
entries.en: Our flagship has been upgraded to make use of previously unused systems.

entries.zh:
我们的前主人声称我们亏欠他们战争赔款。他们已经雇佣了一个星际债务回收机构来处理此事。

[root.GetDebtCollectorsDeal]

§L收债人将在§Y[root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]§!访问我们。§!
entries.en:
Our former masters claim we owe them war reparations. An intergalactic debt collection agency has been hired to settle the matter.

[root.GetDebtCollectorsDeal]

§LThe debt collectors will visit us on§! §Y[root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]§!
We agreed to pay §R5000§! £energy£ §H$energy$§! every 15 years.
We agreed to pay §R2500§! £consumer_goods£ §H$consumer_goods$§! every 15 years.
We agreed to pay §R1250§! £alloys£ §H$alloys$§! every 15 years.

entries.zh: 我们同意每15年交付收债人§R200§!£pop£§H人口§!。
entries.en: We agreed to give the debt collectors §R200§! £pop£ §HPops§! every 15 years.

entries.zh: 我们拒绝进行交易，与收债人进行作战，并且获胜了。但他们总有一天会回来的。
entries.en: We refused to strike a deal, fought the debt collectors, and won. But they will be back.

entries.zh: 我们拒绝进行交易，与收债人进行作战，但是输了。他们总有一天还会回来的。
entries.en: "We refused to strike a deal, fought the debt collectors, and lost. They will be back.

entries.zh:
是时候回敬我们的前宗主$NAME_MSI_country$了。

我们已经不再是当初那个由他们随意剥削的新生文明，现在，是时候让他们血债血偿了。

§L使用§Y$casus_belli_cb_payback$§!宣战理由赢得对于§H$NAME_MSI_country$§!的战争。§!
entries.en:
It's time for us to retaliate against our former masters, the $NAME_MSI_country$.

We are no longer the naive world they so readily exploited. In the end, they will be made to pay.

§LWin a war against the §H$NAME_MSI_country$§! using the §Y$casus_belli_cb_payback$§! Casus Belli.§!

entries.zh:
我们反击前主人$NAME_MSI_country$的计划被[event_target:payback_stole_revenge_country.GetName]挫败了。

他们要为盗取了我们的复仇而付出代价。

§L对§H[event_target:payback_stole_revenge_country.GetName]§!以§Y$casus_belli_cb_payback$§!作为理由宣战并获胜。§!
entries.en:
Our plans to retaliate against our former masters, the $NAME_MSI_country$, have been twarted by the [event_target:payback_stole_revenge_country.GetName].

They will be made to pay for stealing our revenge.

§LWin a war against the §H[event_target:payback_stole_revenge_country.GetName]§! using the §Y$casus_belli_cb_payback$§! Casus Belli.§!

entries.zh: 是时候开始向我们的前主人$NAME_MSI_country$发起还击了。\n\n在星海共同体的参议院中，我们会让他们屈膝，揭露他们奴隶贩子和懦夫的事实。
entries.en: It's time for us to retaliate against our former masters, the $NAME_MSI_country$.\n\nOn the Senate Floor of the Galactic Community, we will bring them to their knees, exposing them for the slavers and cowards that they are.

entries.zh: 我们已经挣脱了来自前宗主的锁链，但征途不会到此为止，我们将在星海共同体的参议院中向所有仍想剥削利用前超光速文明的国家开展斗争。
entries.en: Our former masters are no more, but our goal doesn't change: on the Senate Floor of the Galactic Community, we will fight all those who wish to exploit pre-FTL civilizations.

entries.zh: $payback_make_them_pay_words_chain_desc$\n\n§L通过§Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§!和总计四种个§Y经济制裁§!类型（经济、行政、科研、军事）。§!
entries.en: $payback_make_them_pay_words_chain_desc$\n\n§LPass the §Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§! and all four §YEconomic Sanction§! types (Economic, Administrative, Research, Military).§!

entries.zh: $payback_make_them_pay_words_chain_desc$\n\n§L通过§Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$§!和总计四种个§Y经济制裁§!类型（经济、行政、科研、军事）。§!
entries.en: $payback_make_them_pay_words_chain_desc$\n\n§LPass the §Y$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$§! and all four §YEconomic Sanction§! types (Economic, Administrative, Research, Military).§!

entries.zh: 哪怕最强大的帝国也要在正义的威严下屈膝遵从。
entries.en: Even the mightiest empire will bend under the weight of Justice.

entries.zh: 我们必须给和平一个蔓延发展的机会。
entries.en: We must give peace a chance to flourish.

entries.zh: 大国咬我们，我们就狠狠地咬回去。
entries.en: When a bigger empire bites, we bite back.

entries.zh: 对终末危机阵营造成伤害：§G+20%§!
曾经的学生，如今成为了大师。
\n§E当复仇目标不再是我方宗主国后，§Y$casus_belli_cb_payback$§!§H宣战理由§!可用§!
entries.en: \n§EThe §Y$casus_belli_cb_payback$§! §HCasus Belli§! is granted when the target of our revenge is not our Overlord.§!

entries.zh: 发动战争，以终结威胁到我们帝国的势力。\n\n§R这场战争不存在维持现状情况下的和平：我们要么胜利，要么屈服。§!
entries.en: War is waged to end a threat against our own empire.\n\n§RThere will be no Status Quo peace in this war: we either win, or we succumb.§!

entries.zh: 发动战争，以将进攻者的政体和思潮强加给敌人。\n\n§R这场战争不存在维持现状情况下的和平：我们要么胜利，要么屈服。§!
entries.en: War is waged to force one's ethos and government form on the enemy.\n\n§RThere will be no Status Quo peace in this war: we either impose our ideals, or we succumb.§!

entries.zh: 发动战争，以强迫敌人成为我们的子公司。\n\n§R这场战争不存在维持现状情况下的和平：我们要么胜利，要么永远失去机会。§!
entries.en: War is waged to subjugate the enemy as a Subsidiary.\n\n§RThere will be no Status Quo peace in this war: we either prevail, or we lose the chance forever.§!

entries.zh: 发动战争，以迫使敌人成为朝贡国。\n\n§R这场战争不存在维持现状情况下的和平：我们要么胜利，要么错失机会。§!
entries.en: War is waged to subjugate the enemy as a Tributary.\n\n§RThere will be no Status Quo peace in this war: either we will be victorious, or we will lose the opportunity.§!

entries.zh:
发动战争，以强迫敌人成为我们的子公司。

该子公司的初始协议条款由我们的§Y$policy_subjugation_war_terms$§!政策决定。

§R这场战争不存在维持现状情况下的和平：我们要么胜利，要么永远失去机会。§!
entries.en:
War is waged to acquire the enemy as a Subsidiary.

Initial Agreement Terms of the Subsidiary are determined by our §Y$policy_subjugation_war_terms$§! Policy.

§RThere will be no Status Quo peace in this war: we either prevail, or we lose the chance forever.§!

entries.zh:
§Y[From.GetName]§!的政策被强制更变为：
-禁止奴隶制
-禁止净化
-原住民干涉设置为禁止干涉
entries.en:
§Y[From.GetName]§!'s policies are forcibly changed:
- Slavery is prohibited
- Purge is prohibited
- Pre-FTL Interference is set to Non-Interference

entries.zh:
一个小型的自推档案存储器刚刚进入了我们的母星系边缘，用一个信号信标大声宣告了其到来。该档案一经取得，就显示出它所包含的阴森信息：一份长长的列表，里面详细列出了在与侵略者作战期间我们摧毁的所有军事资产，包括船组人员的伤亡，以及每艘被摧毁的船只的估计价值。

我们先前的入侵者正式提出了战争赔款。更讽刺的是，他们还声称，在我们的星系中被摧毁的所有船只仍然是他们的财产，任何试图对残骸进行摧毁、改装或者逆向的行为都将会使我们违反条款。

一个债务收集机构很快将与我们联系，以便解决此事。
entries.en:
A small, self-propelled cache just entered the edges of our home system, loudly announcing its arrival with a signal beacon. Once retrieved, the cache revealed its grim contents: a lengthy list detailing all the military assets we destroyed during the war against our invaders, complete with crew casualties and the estimated value of each destroyed vessel.

Our former invaders are officially demanding war reparations. This despite the fact that they are the ones who invaded us. Even more outrageously, they also claim that all the destroyed ships in our system are still their property, and any attempt to destroy, refit or retro-engineer the wreckage will put us in breach of terms and conditions.

A debt collection agency will soon contact us to settle the matter.
The debt collectors will visit us on §Y[root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]§!.

entries.zh:
亲爱的[owner.GetName]，

我们代表§H$NAME_MSI_country$§!就债务未偿还一事与您进行联系。鉴于我们也是新近崛起的太空社会中的一员，我们理解您或许无法承担全部债务。我们的目的是帮助您选择一种适当的还款计划，在不阻碍经济发展的情况下偿还所有未偿还债务。

相应地，我们很高兴为您提供一名咨询顾问，免费！我们热切地希望这个问题能够顺利解决。
entries.en:
Dear [owner.GetName],

We are contacting you on behalf of the §H$NAME_MSI_country$§! regarding an outstanding debt. Being a fledging space-faring society, we understand you may not be in a position to repay the full amount. Our aim is to aid you in selecting an appropriate repayment plan, one which will settle any outstanding debts without stifling economic growth.

Accordingly, we are happy to offer you a consultation, free of charge! It is our ardent wish that this matter can be settled amicably.

entries.zh: 我们很乐意协商解决问题。
在我们的族人第一次触及星辰之前，我们就知道每个人在这个宇宙都有自己要扮演的角色。有些文化渴望力量。而另一些文化追求知识。我们进化是为了提供人情服务。\n\n如果一个人从未因无私奉献而感到喜悦，那么此人错过了生命的主旨。弯腰鞠躬并不是自降身份，而是提升周围的人。
entries.en: Even before our people first reached the stars, we understood that everyone has a role to play in this galaxy. Some cultures crave power. Others pursue knowledge. We evolved to favor service.\n\nThe one who has never felt the joy of unselfish service has missed the very theme of life. To bow down is not to be diminished. It is to uplift those around you.

entries.zh: 根据我们先前提交的估值，你亏欠我们客户的总额等于§Y£energy£ [owner.debt_collectors_amount]能量币§!。我们非常乐意提供给你各种各样的偿还计划。
entries.en: According to the estimations we previously submitted, the amount you owe to our client is equal to §Y£energy£ [owner.debt_collectors_amount] Energy Credits§!. We are happy to offer you a variety of repayment plans.

entries.zh: 你们想要一次结清债务的积极态度让我们感动不已，但仔细检查之后，你方提供的能量币看起来并不全是真货。想必，这只是单纯的产生了误解！让我们假装无事发生就好了。
entries.en: We are touched by your eagerness to settle your debt, but upon close examination, the energy credits you offered do not appear to be entirely genuine. Just a simple misunderstanding, we're sure! Let's pretend this never happened.

entries.zh: 承诺下次收债人返回时交付§R5000§! £energy£ §H$energy$§!。
entries.en: Pledge to give §R5000§! £energy£ §H$energy$§! to the debt collectors upon their return.

entries.zh: 承诺下次收债人返回时交付§R2500§!$r_consumer_goods$。
entries.en: Pledge to give §R2500§! $r_consumer_goods$ to the debt collectors upon their return.

entries.zh: 我们还能为您提供什么？
entries.en: Anything else we can offer you?

entries.zh: 承诺下次收债人返回时交付§R1250§!£alloys£§H$alloys$§!。
entries.en: Pledge to give §R1250§! £alloys£ §H$alloys$§! to the debt collectors upon their return.

entries.zh: 棒极了！很高兴我们能这么快就达成协议。我们将在§Y15年§!后回来收第一笔分期付款，相信你们对这些条款感到很满意。\n\n祝您有美好的一天！
entries.en: Splendid! We are pleased we managed to reach an agreement so quickly. We will return in §Y15 years§! to collect the first installment and ensure you're happy with the terms.\n\nHave a nice day!
The debt collectors will return on §Y[root.payback_debt_collectors_timer]§!.

entries.zh: 如果你无法或不愿意支付能量币，你可以向§H$NAME_MSI_country$§!提供一定比例的劳动力储备来抵扣你的债务。你的工人将被送往指定工作场所，并获得基本食宿，直到他们成功偿还债务。\n\n值得注意的是，上述劳工不需要有完整公民权。任何具有劳动能力的都可以。
entries.en: If you are unable or unwilling to cover the energy cost, you may repay your debt by pledging a certain percentage of your labor pool to §H$NAME_MSI_country$§!. Your workers will be transported to their designated job sites and will be provided with basic accommodation until they have successfully repaid the debt.\n\nIt's worth noting that said workers do not need to be full citizens. Any able bodies will do.

entries.zh: 实际上，我们更愿意用能量币支付。
entries.en: Actually, we'd prefer to pay using energy.

entries.zh: 承诺下次收债人返回时给出§R200§!£pop£§H人口§!。
entries.en: Pledge to give §R200§! £pop£ §HPops§! to the debt collectors upon their return.

entries.zh: 正确的术语是“契约仆人”。奴隶制是一种不公平的做法，依靠的是利用现存的权力结构进行剥削。我们的交易完全基于合约条款。
entries.en: The correct term is "indentured servants". Slavery is an unfair practice based on exploitation of pre-existing power structures. Our exchanges are based solely on the terms of contract.

entries.zh: 我们真的很抱歉，因为我们没能在这个问题上达成一致。你是否有机会再重新考虑一下？根据合约的条款，如果债务国不愿意或无法偿还，我们就必须代表客户收缴资产。
entries.en: We are truly sorry that we were unable to reach an agreement in this matter. Is there any chance you would be willing to reconsider? According to the terms of the contract, if a debtor is unwilling or unable to pay, we are required to seize assets on behalf of our client.
The debt collectors will attack us.

entries.zh: 让我们重新考虑一下我们的选择……
收债人的舰队被迫撤退。他们毫无疑问还会回来的，但至少目前我们安全了。
entries.en: The debt collector fleet has been forced to retreat. They will doubtlessly return, but for now, we are safe.

entries.zh: 再一次，我们迫使收债人撤离了我们的母星系。这或许不太可能是我们最后一次和他们打交道，但至少我们的子民和财产目前又安全了。
entries.en: Once again, we forced the debt collectors to retreat from our home system. It's unlikely we've seen the last of them, but for now, our people and our assets are safe.

entries.zh:
我们对此感到极度失望。

作为一家专精于启发那些欠发展文明的公司，我们因我们的专业才干而自豪。但很明显，我们未能传授一些最基础的知识。你们不能无缘无故地攻击其他人，而应该为你们的失败承担责任。

你们显然需要额外的指导。让我们来教你们如何偿还债务。
entries.en:
The disappointment is heavy.

As a company specializing in the enlightenment of less developed civilizations, we pride ourselves in our expertise. Yet it has become abundantly clear that we have failed to impart some basic lessons. Rather than attacking others without cause, you alone must bear the responsibility for your failures.

You are clearly in need of additional guidance. Let us teach you how to repay a debt.

entries.zh: 我们绝不会再向你们低头！
entries.en: We'll never bow to you again.

entries.zh: 在我们的舰队被击败后，收债人突袭了[PLANET.GetName]，绑架了我们的许多族人。比起这次战败更加令人心痛的，是他们留下的“账单”，告诉我们这些被扣押的人们将被用来偿还我们的“债务”。收债人说，我们应该心怀感恩，债务清算后我们的族人就能回家。还债时间大约只要29637年左右。
entries.en: After our fleet was defeated, the debt collectors raided [PLANET.GetName], kidnapping a number of our people. Even more galling than the defeat was the 'invoice' they left behind, informing us that the seized population will be put to work to repay our 'debt.' We should be grateful, the collectors say, that our people will be returned once the debt is settled. This should only take 29,637 years or so.

entries.zh: 下一次我们会做好准备。
entries.en: Next time we will be ready.

entries.zh: 收债人夺走§R500§!£pop£§H人口§!。\n\n收债人将于§Y[root.owner.payback_debt_collectors_timer]§!回来。
entries.en: Lost §R500§! £pop£ §HPops§! to the Debt Collectors.\n\nThe debt collectors will return on §Y[root.owner.payback_debt_collectors_timer]§!.

entries.zh: 亲爱的[owner.GetName]，\n\n我们再次联系你，代表§Y$NAME_MSI_country$§!商讨关于你们欠债的事。
entries.en: Dear [owner.GetName],\n\nOnce again we're contacting you on the behalf of §Y$NAME_MSI_country$§! regarding your outstanding debt.

entries.zh: $origin.4030.desc.base$\n\n根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴总额为§R5000§!£energy£§H$energy$§!的费用来偿还你的债务。
entries.en: $origin.4030.desc.base$\n\nAs per our agreement, we are here to collect a sum equal to §R5000§! £energy£ §H$energy$§! for the repayment of your debt.

entries.zh: $origin.4030.desc.base$\n\n根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴总额为§R2500§!£consumer_goods£§H$consumer_goods$§!的费用来偿还你的债务。
entries.en: $origin.4030.desc.base$\n\nAs per our agreement, we are here to collect a sum equal to §R2500§! £consumer_goods£ §H$consumer_goods$§! for the repayment of your debt.

entries.zh: $origin.4030.desc.base$\n\n根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴总额为§R1250§!£alloys£§H$alloys$§!的费用来偿还你的债务。
entries.en: $origin.4030.desc.base$\n\nAs per our agreement, we are here to collect a sum equal to §R1250§! £alloys£ §H$alloys$§! for the repayment of your debt.

entries.zh: $origin.4030.desc.base$\n\n根据我们之间的协定，我们这次将收缴愿意尽心尽力的劳动来偿还你债务的共计§R200§!£pop£§H人口§!。
entries.en: $origin.4030.desc.base$\n\nAs per our agreement, we are here to collect §R200§! £pop£ §HPops§! willing to dedicate their labor to the repayment of your debt.

entries.zh: 亲爱的[owner.GetName]，\n\n我们再次代表§H$NAME_MSI_country$§!就债务未偿一事与你联系。我们只希望和平解决此事，同时希望贵方更愿意参与建设性的对话。
entries.en: Dear [owner.GetName],\n\nOnce again we're contacting you on behalf of the §H$NAME_MSI_country$§! regarding an outstanding debt. We only wish to resolve this matter peacefully, and hope that you are more willing to participate in a constructive dialogue.

entries.zh: 亲爱的[owner.GetName]，\n\n这是我们的最后警告：你欠§H$NAME_MSI_country$§!的债务亟需偿还。尽管我们多次试图和平解决此事，你始终没有表达出合作的意愿。如果你再次拒绝执行偿还计划，我们将别无选择，只能采取所有必要的手段收缴你的资产。
entries.en: Dear [owner.GetName],\n\nThis is our last warning: the debt you owe to the §H$NAME_MSI_country$§! urgently needs to be repaid. Despite multiple attempts to resolve this matter peacefully, you have consistently failed to cooperate. If you refuse once again to agree on a repayment plan, we will have no choice but to seize your assets by any means necessary.

entries.zh: 我们很乐意协商解决问题。
这是你要求支付的款项。
entries.en: Here is the payment you requested.

entries.zh: 抱歉，能再说一遍你是谁吗？
我们知道你是谁：受害者。和我们一样。
entries.en: We know who you are: victims. Like us.

entries.zh: 感谢你的及时回应，以及你公平地解决此事的意愿！现在未偿还款项总额为§Y[owner.debt_collectors_amount]§!£energy£§H$energy$§!。我们将在15年后再回来，收下一笔分期款项。祝您愉快！
entries.en: Thank you for your prompt response and your willingness to settle the matter equitably! The outstanding sum is now equal to §Y[owner.debt_collectors_amount]§! £energy£ §H$energy$§!. We will be back in 15 years to collect the next installment. Have a nice day!

entries.zh: 未偿款项比预期的要高。
entries.en: The outstanding sum is higher than expected.

entries.zh: 正如这个小字条款所标明的，我们执行的是标准利率。如果你继续按现有分期方式支付，你就能在29637年后偿清你的债务。
entries.en: As indicated in the small print, standard interest rates are applied. If you continue with your payments at the current rate, you will be able to repay your debt in exactly 29,637 years.

entries.zh: 我们很遗憾你们没能在商定时间内筹措到足够的款项。我们已经调整了你们的还款计划，减少了下次分期偿还的所需金额。\n\n不幸的是，由于你方无法偿还债务，造成了违约。与之对应的，我们不得不扣押你们的一部分族人以代替资金。我们希望这么做不会造成不合时宜的不便。
entries.en: We are saddened to learn you weren't able to collect the agreed amount in time. We have adjusted your repayment plan, halving the required sum for the next installment.\n\nUnfortunately, your inability to pay puts you in breach of our contract. Accordingly, we will now seize a segment of your population in lieu of funds. We hope does not cause undue inconvenience.

entries.zh:
$origin.4036.desc.base$

考虑当下情况，我们有必要告知您，我们的客户也接受以工作时长为形式的偿付。你们的一些人口将会被运送到指定的工作地点，提供基础食宿，直到他们成功地偿还了债务。

值得注意的是，上述劳工不需要有完整公民权。任何具有劳动能力的都可以。
entries.en:
$origin.4036.desc.base$

Considering the situation, we feel compelled to inform you that our client also accepts repayment in the form of dedicated work hours. Some of your population will be transported to their designated job sites and provided with basic accommodation until they have successfully repaid the debt.

It's worth noting that these workers need not be full citizens of yours. Any able bodies will do.

entries.zh: 我们不会让你抓走我们的人民。
entries.en: We won't let you take our people.
The debt collectors will attack us.

entries.zh: 我们恳请你重新考虑一下你的决定。如果你拒绝付款，这将会在你的信用分数上留下一个永久的印记。拖欠债务会限制你未来的经济机遇，对于你自己的形象来说没有任何好处。你希望世人将你们当作这样的一个文明吗？通过唾弃那些愿意自降身份提升你们的人？
entries.en: We beg you to rethink your decision. Your refusal to pay will leave a permanent mark on your credit score. Defaulting will limit your financial opportunities in the future, to say nothing of your own self-image. Is this how you wish to be known as a society? By spitting on those who kneeled to lift you up?

entries.zh: 我们意识到你方拒绝偿还债务是一件令人十分担忧的事情。我们的客户，§H$NAME_MSI_country$§!，提供给你的全是帮助和支持，所求的仅仅只是一笔公平的款项作为交换。难道你们学到的东西就是这些？用友善温和换来的竟是阴险欺诈？
entries.en: We find the refusal to repay your debt deeply concerning. Our client, the §H$NAME_MSI_country$§!, offered you nothing but help and support, and only asked for a fair repayment in exchange. Is this all you have learned? To reciprocate kindness with deceit?

entries.zh: 收债人离开了我们的母星系，但一股深深的恐惧感至今依然在我们心中挥之不去。考虑到他们对于雇主尽心尽力，他们肯定不会停止对我们的骚扰。即使我们以某种方式偿还了全部债务，他们一定也会想出其它办法——利率、法律漏洞、隐藏在文档中的小字条款，藏在我们稀里糊涂签下的文件中。\n\n如果我们无法回购自由，我们别无选择，只能为此而战。唯一的问题是该怎么做。
entries.en: The debt collectors departed from our home system, but a deep sense of dread still linger. Given their dedication to their employer, they will never stop harassing us. Even if we somehow manage to repay the full sum, they will come up with something else - interest rates, legal loopholes, small print hidden in documents we don't remember signing.\n\nIf we can't buy back our freedom, we have no choice but to fight for it. The only question is how.
We will triumph over the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ through warfare.

entries.zh: 我们将通过外交手段战胜$NAME_MSI_country_initials$。
entries.en: We will triumph over the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ through diplomacy.

entries.zh: 我们击败了他们一次，我们就能再次这么做。但这并非易事——第一次，他们没有料到我们会还手。现在，他们将动用舰队的全部军力来攻击我们。要赢得一线机会，我们必须争取时间，做好准备。这是一场我们输不起的战斗。
entries.en: We defeated them once, and we can do it again. But it won't be easy - the first time, they weren't expecting for us to fight back. Now, they will attack us with the full might of their fleet. To have any chance, we must bide our time and prepare ourselves. This is a battle we cannot afford to lose.

entries.zh: 我们现在可以使用§H血债血偿§!宣战理由向$NAME_MSI_country_initials$宣战了。
entries.en: We can now use the §HPayback§! casus belli to declare war to the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$.

entries.zh: $NAME_MSI_country$对我们的所作所为或许是合法的，但这些事情在道德上站不住脚。为了防止类似的事情再次发生，我们需要强硬的法律来让他们负责。通过谨慎的外交，我们可以尝试破坏维系他们帝国的原则：贪婪、剥削、奴役。如果我们幸运的话，我们可以不费一刀一枪就将$NAME_MSI_country_initials$瓦解。
entries.en: What the $NAME_MSI_country$ has done to us may have been legal, but it was far from moral. To prevent this from ever happening again, we need strong laws to hold them accountable. Through careful diplomacy, we can attempt to undermine the very principles that hold their empire together: greed, exploitation, slavery. With luck, we can destroy $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ without ever firing a shot.

entries.zh: $origin.4042.desc.galcom$\n\n如果存在某个管理主体，我们就可以和想法类似的国家共同商讨这项事务……
entries.en: $origin.4042.desc.galcom$\n\nIf only there was some sort of governing body we could join to discuss this matter with like-minded empires...

entries.zh: $origin.4042.desc.galcom$\n\n是时候让我们加入星海共同体了。
entries.en: $origin.4042.desc.galcom$\n\nIt's time for us to join the Galactic Community.

entries.zh: 星海共同体将会成为我们的战场。
entries.en: The Galactic Community will be our battlefield.

entries.zh:
这是我们的新战场：参议院，一个通过选举投票和辩论来解决冲突的战区。

这是我们的武器：外交支持、大使、我们经济的力量以及我们愿景的纯洁。

我们的目标：禁止启蒙行为，阻止像$NAME_MSI_country_initials$这样的帝国剥削较弱的文明。

这就是我们获胜的地方。不是用暴力，而是用法律那不可动摇的力量。
entries.en:
Here is our new battlefield: the Senate floor, a war zone where conflicts are solved through vote-casting and debate.

Here are our weapons: favors, ambassadors, the strength of our economy and the purity of our vision.

Here is our goal: to ban enlightenment practices, preventing empires like the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ from exploiting weaker civilizations.

Here is where we win. Not with violence, but through the immutable power of the law.

entries.zh: 我们将工作重心放在通过§H$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§!上，阻止帝国对前超光速文明进行剥削。为了确保法律执行，我们还需要支持所有§H4种制裁类型§!。
entries.en: We'll focus our efforts on passing the §H$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_equal_standing$§!, preventing empires from exploiting pre-FTLs. We'll also need to support all §H4 sanction types§! to enforce the law.

entries.zh: 我们将工作重心放在通过§H$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$§!上，防止帝国以任何方式影响前超光速社会的发展。为了确保法律执行，我们也需要通过全部§H4类制裁§!。
entries.en: We'll focus our efforts on passing the §H$resolution_pre_ftl_stances_non_interference$§!, preventing empires from influencing the development of pre-FTL societies in any way. We'll also need to pass all §H4 sanction types§! to enforce the law.

entries.zh: 我们清单上的第一项议案已经通过。我们阻碍$NAME_MSI_country$的计划目前正全力推进。
entries.en: The first resolution on our list has passed. Our plan to hinder the $NAME_MSI_country$ is now in full motion.

entries.zh: 通过艰苦奋斗和坚毅决心，我们赢得了参议院的主导权，对前超光速文明的启蒙行为进行了限制，并且对违反这类规定的帝国实施了严厉的制裁。
entries.en: Through hard work and determination, we have dominated the Senate Floor, restricting enlightenment practices and enforcing harsh sanctions against those empires which breach them.

entries.zh: $origin.4055.intro$要想生存下来，$NAME_MSI_country_initials$必须全盘颠覆式地重新思考他们的商业战略——他们帝国内部不安定的消息已经开始传播。
entries.en: $origin.4055.intro$ The $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ will have to radically rethink their business strategy to survive - and news of instability within their empire have already starting to spread.

entries.zh: $origin.4055.intro$$NAME_MSI_country_initials$已经消亡了——多亏了我们的辛勤运作，没有其他帝国会取代它们的地位。
entries.en: $origin.4055.intro$ The $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ is already gone - and thanks to our work, no other empire will ever replace them.

entries.zh:
致全体前客户的一封重要讯息：

自该公司第一次踏上星空的那一天起，我们就一直致力于改善其他文明，勤勉地帮助他们实现完全的潜能。经过数年的成功，董事会决定简化我们的流程，以更好反映我们公司的价值观。

相应地，我们已经暂时停止了文明启蒙活动，以便更好地将主要精力聚焦在品牌重塑上。

我们将在$NAME_MSI_country$开启勇于进取的全新篇章，感谢您的继续支持！
entries.en:
An important message to all our former clients:

From the day this company first reached the stars, we have dedicated ourselves to the betterment of other civilizations, diligently working to help them ascend to their full potential. After many successful years, the Board of Directors has made the decision to streamline our processes in order to better reflect our company values.

Accordingly, we have temporarily ceased our enlightenment activities to better focus on rebranding.

As we embark on a bold new chapter at $NAME_MSI_country$, we thank you for your continued support!

entries.zh: 甚至在我们踏上星空之前，我们就已经知道自己并不孤单。几个世纪以来，$NAME_MSI_country$一直悬于我们的头顶上——最初作为一个导师，后来又作为一个压迫者，如今到头来成为了一位堕落的暴君。
entries.en: Even before we reached the stars, we knew we were not alone. For centuries, the $NAME_MSI_country$ has loomed over us - first as a mentor, then as an oppressor, and now finally as a fallen tyrant.

entries.zh: $origin.4060.intro$\n\n我们应该庆祝。然后，也许我们应该放下武器，最终开始休养生息。
entries.en: $origin.4060.intro$\n\nWe should celebrate. And then, perhaps, we should lay down our weapons and finally rest.

entries.zh: 我们的事业仍值得为之进行斗争。
entries.en: Our cause is still worth fighting.

entries.zh: 我们现在可以利用§H$casus_belli_cb_payback_punishment$§!宣战理由，向那些仍在剥削前超光速文明的国家发动战争。
entries.en: We can now use the §H$casus_belli_cb_payback_punishment$§! casus belli to wage war against those who exploit pre-FTL civilizations.

entries.zh:
$origin.4060.intro$现在$NAME_MSI_country_initials$已经不复存在、被另一个[root.species.GetHandName]摧毁了。

我们的天空可能变得更加晴朗了，但我们的人民仍为永无止境的需求所占据，那便是：

§R复仇。§!
entries.en:
$origin.4060.intro$ Now the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ is gone, crushed by another [root.species.GetHandName].

Our skies may be clear, but our people are still possessed by an insatiable need:

§RRevenge.§!

entries.zh: 我们的事业仍值得为之进行斗争。
entries.en: Our cause is still worth fighting.

entries.zh: 我们将继续斗争，直到全宇宙禁止对前超光速文明进行剥削。
entries.en: We'll keep fighting to ban the exploitation of pre-FTLs.

entries.zh: 他们偷走了我们的复仇。他们要为此付出代价。
entries.en: They stole our revenge. They'll pay for it.

entries.zh: 我们现在可以使用§H血债血偿§!宣战理由向§Y[destroyer_country.GetName]§!宣战了。
entries.en: We can now use the §HPayback§! casus belli to declare war to the §Y[destroyer_country.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 复仇之后是什么呢？你已经目睹了天敌的陨落，那个应对灭亡你的天敌而负责的国家也因为你而陨落了。现在又该怎么办？我们现在能放下武器吗？我们能和平相处吗？
entries.en: What comes after revenge? What to do after witnessing the fall of your nemesis, and of the empire responsible for killing your nemesis? Can we lay down our weapons now? Can we be at peace?

entries.zh: 除非所有的剥削者都消亡，否则我们没法安息。
entries.en: There will be no peace until all exploiters are gone.

entries.zh:
当我们第一次与§Y[bsempire.GetName]§!接触时，我们曾惊叹于他们破译我们语言的速度。我们现在理解了原因。

当我们的前主人试图让我们屈服的时候，他们绑架了我们的人民。其中一些不幸的人被带上了一艘$NAME_MSI_country_initials$飞船。在孤注一掷的下，他们与船上的其他“契约奴隶”发动了兵变。他们在一颗无人居住的行星上进行了迫降，这次勇敢的反抗行为最终导致了§Y[bsempire.GetName]§!的诞生。

我们拥有共同的敌人，以及共同的历史。或许，我们可以携手共建一个没有压迫的未来。
entries.en:
When we first made contact with the §Y[bsempire.GetName]§!, we marveled at the speed with which they deciphered our language. We now understand why.

When our former masters tried to bend us, they kidnapped our people. Some of these unfortunates wound up on an $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ ship. To their lasting credit, along with the other 'indentured assets' on board, they mutinied, crashing onto an uninhabited planet. This brave act of rebellion eventually resulted in the birth of the §Y[bsempire.GetName]§!.

We have a common enemy, and a shared history. And perhaps, together we can forge a future free from oppression.

entries.zh: 也许这些异星人和我们并不完全是一模一样的。
entries.en: Perhaps these xenos are not entirely unlike us.

entries.zh: 我们双方的帝国有一个共同的敌人：§Y$NAME_MSI_country$§!。为了共同防范这个威胁，我们建议让他们的特工访问我们的机密情报。
entries.en: Our empires share a common enemy: the §Y$NAME_MSI_country$§!. To protect ourselves against this threat, we suggest giving their operatives access to our classified intel.

entries.zh: 共同的敌人并不能让我们加深友谊。
entries.en: A common enemy doesn't make us friends.

entries.zh: [root.GetName]，我们在参议院看到了贵方特使。团结一致，我们可以为共同的事业进行奋斗。通过协调我们双方的利益，我们可以更好地服务于共同的事业，反对奴隶制，终结对前超光速文明的干涉行为。
entries.en: We see your envoys on the Senate Floor, [root.GetName]. Together, we we can fight for causes that affect us both. By aligning our interests, we can make common cause against slavery and end the practice of interfering with pre-FTL empires.

entries.zh: 我们的利益并不总是一致。
我们听说了你打算对$NAME_MSI_country$开战的计划。尽管我们人民拥有共同的历史，但我们并不认同你对复仇的渴望。不过，如果你对$NAME_MSI_country_initials$宣战，我们也会加入你的事业。
entries.en: We have heard about your plans to make war on the $NAME_MSI_country$. Although our people share a common history, we do not share your thirst for revenge. However, should you declare war against $NAME_MSI_country_initials$, we will join your cause.

entries.zh: 在$NAME_MSI_country_initials$，我们将自己的客户视作家人。今天，我们不由得感到骄傲。击杀了一只星神兽！对于一个新生的太空文明，这是一个重要的里程碑。为了象征我们对你们成就的尊敬，请收下我们送来的这份小礼物。
entries.en: At $NAME_MSI_country_initials$, we see our clients like family. Today, we can't help but feel proud. Slaying a Guardian! An important milestone for a fledgling space-faring society. As a token of our esteem for your accomplishment, please accept this small congratulatory gift from us.

entries.zh: 多年前，我们给了你们一条通向天空的飞梯。今天，我们目睹了你们对一个低等文明提供了同样的帮助。\n\n我们相信你们能把我们曾经的教导传授给他们。当然，如果你们需要帮助来起草一项有利可图的启蒙策略，你完全可以向我们咨询。
entries.en: Years ago, we gave you a ladder to the sky. Today, we have witnessed you offer a lesser civilization the same help.\n\nWe trust you will be able to pass on our lessons to them. Of course, should you need any help in drafting a profitable enlightenment strategy, you have only to ask.

entries.zh: 我们可以运用你的帮助。

亲爱的前客户，

我们听说了你最近的经济困境。学习如何管理你的金融是运营一个帝国的必要部分，有些时候，失败也是学习的至关重要的一部分。

我们很乐意为你提供必须的资源，来让你的国家摆脱赤字。当然，出借的资源也将纳入你未偿还债务的一部分。我们希望这点小小的金融教训能对你有所帮助。
entries.en:
Dear former clients,

We heard about your recent economic troubles. Learning to manage your finances is a necessary part of running an empire, and sometimes, failure is an essential part of learning.

We are happy to offer you the necessary resources to put your country out of deficit. Of course, the cost loaned resources will be added to your outstanding debt. We hope this little financial lesson can be of help.

entries.zh: 我们可以自己处理好自己的事。
entries.en: We can manage it on our own.

entries.zh: $CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$\n这个文明始于一艘奴隶船上的发起的兵变，现在由多种多样的前超光速物种组成。
entries.en: $CHALLENGING_ORIGIN$\nThis civilization began as a mutiny aboard a slaver vessel, and is made up of a diverse group of pre-FTL species.

entries.zh:
终于自由了！

有些人生来便负着枷锁。还有的负债累累，然后被作为契约奴隶任人买卖。但前主人的科技并不能保护他们周全。我们密谋反叛。在一场短暂但血腥的斗争中，我们杀死了俘虏我们的人，也重创了他们的运奴船。我们不得已紧急迫降到[Root.Capital.GetName]的表面上。

尽管我们来自五湖四海和不同的物种，但我们找到了共同的目标。假以时日，这艘运奴船受损的系统就能修好，藏在其中的大量秘密-包括我们曾经母星的位置-也能被揭晓。

我们已挣脱枷锁。现在就开始劳动吧。
entries.en:
Free at last!

Some were born into bondage. Others, crippled by debt, found themselves sold as indentured labor. But the technology of our former masters was not enough to save them. In secret, we planned our mutiny. During the brief, bloody struggle, our captors were killed, and their slave ship critically damaged. An emergency landing left us stranded on the surface of [Root.Capital.GetName].

Though we are made up of species from many different worlds, we have found common cause. In time, the damaged systems of the slaver vessel will be repaired, and its bounty of secrets - including the location of our former home worlds - will be revealed.

Our shackles are broken. Now the work begins.

entries.zh:
终于自由*了！

有些人生来便负着枷锁。还有的负债累累，然后被作为契约奴隶任人买卖。然而我们都畅想着，能够过上轻松而富足的生活。我们密谋反叛。在一场短暂但血腥的斗争中，我们杀死了俘虏我们的人，也重创了他们的运奴船。我们不得已紧急迫降到[Root.Capital.GetName]的表面上。

尽管我们来自五湖四海和不同的物种，但在您的领导下我们找到了共同的目标。我们的前主人也许非常残酷，但他们懂得经营生活。我们应该像他们一样坚定地追求我们的利益。假以时日，这艘运奴船受损的系统就能修好，藏在其中的大量秘密-包括我们曾经母星的位置-也能被揭晓。我们已挣脱枷锁。是时候成立公司了。

*法律告示：
此处使用“自由”一词并不代表本公司将提供任何折扣或进行任何影响[Root.GetName]股东收益的活动。如对此或其他术语有任何疑问，或是希望退出[Root.Capital.GetName]上的持续存在，请在[Root.Capital.GetName]的$building_bureaucratic_1$联系我们的法律或安保专家，以获取他们的快速处理。
entries.en:
Free* at last!

Some were born into bondage. Others, crippled by debt, found themselves sold as indentured labor. All of us dreamed of something more, a life of ease and abundance. In secret, we planned our mutiny. During the brief, bloody struggle, our captors were killed, and their slave ship critically damaged. An emergency landing left us stranded on the surface of [Root.Capital.GetName].

Though we are made up of species from many different worlds, under your directorship we have found common cause. Our former masters may have been cruel, but they understood the business of life. Like them, we must be steadfast in our pursuit of profit. In time, the damaged systems of the slaver vessel will be repaired, and its bounty of secrets - including the location of our former home worlds - will be revealed. Our shackles are broken. Now is the time to incorporate.

*Legal Notice:
The use of the word 'free' is non-binding and does not oblige the Corporation to provide any discount or volunteer any action that could affect the profit margins of [Root.GetName] shareholders. If you have any questions regarding this or other terms, or should you wish to opt out of continued existence on [Root.Capital.GetName], please contact our legal or security professionals in the $building_bureaucratic_1$ on [Root.Capital.GetName] for immediate resolution.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$我们的起源不允许我们以这样的方式对待自己的人民。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Our origin does not allow us to treat our population in this manner.

entries.zh: 这颗行星是自由的，但它的民众仍在慢慢适应突然显现的现实，即宇宙比它们的预期要大得多这一事实。
entries.en: This planet may be free, but its populace are still adjusting to the sudden realities of a universe larger than they ever expected.

entries.zh: 我们是一个由来自许多星球的人们组成的民族，我们的政治也同样多元。
entries.en: We are a people of many worlds, and our politics are no less diverse.

entries.zh: 自我们宣布夺取自由以来，我们已经历经了许多磨难。那艘载运我们抵达此地的舰船已经被我们发掘出了一切有价值的东西，现在它已经没有什么秘密可言了。\n\n但是，我们决不能忘记过去的牺牲，更不能忘记挣脱镣铐的代价。坠毁的运奴船将被改造成一个公共纪念馆，以纪念我们国家的诞生。
entries.en: We have come a long way since claiming our freedom. The ship we arrived on has been stripped of everything of value, and our technology has advanced to the point that there are few secrets remaining.\n\nBut we must never forget the sacrifices of the past, nor the cost of casting off our shackles. The crashed slaver ship will be converted into a public memorial, commemorating the birth of our nation.

entries.zh: 自我们抵达此地以来，我们已经经历了许多磨难。尽管我们失去了对那艘载运我们到达此地的飞船的控制权，那艘船上遗留的东西不再对我们有价值，我们的科技也进步到了空前的阶段，那里对我们来说已经不再有什么秘密了。\n\n如果我们有一天将其复原，我们应当把这个地方改成一个纪念馆，以便我们在勇敢地走向未来时，还能记住我们卑微的开始。
entries.en: We have come a long way since our arrival. While we no longer control it, whatever remains on the ship we arrived on is no longer of value to us, and our technology has advanced to the point that there are few secrets remaining.\n\nIf we ever recover it, we shall convert the site into a memorial so we remember our humble beginnings as we move boldly into the future.

entries.en: - The §Y$d_crashed_slaver_ship$§! and related infrastructure will be converted into advanced infrastructure.

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]……终于，我们回来了。

我们的民族曾经历了难以想象的苦难。从家园中被掳走，被迫拷上脚镣，或是成为任人买卖的契约财产，往往我们要面对的就是这些凶残的遭遇。即便是那些过得稍微轻松一些的人身上也带着曾被奴役的耻辱。而现在，回到我们同胞的怀抱中，我们终于可以开始治愈创伤了。

但在欢乐之余我们别忘了，事实上我们是来自许多不同星球的民族。不论起源，我们中的每个人都有归乡的权利。

我们的前主人不择手段地打散我们。而今天，整个星系将见证他们的失败。
entries.en:
[From.GetName]... At last, we have returned.

As a people, we have experienced unimaginable trauma. Stolen from our homes, forced into bondage, the life of an indentured asset was often one of brutal suffering. Even for those who passed their days in relative comfort, the shame of indenture lingers. Now, reunited with our kin, we can finally begin to heal.

But in our joy we must never lose sight of the fact that we are a people of many worlds. No matter our origins, every one of us deserves the chance to return home.

Our former masters did their best to break us. Today the whole galaxy is witness to their failure.

entries.zh: 属于我们人民的伟大日子。
entries.en: A great day for our people.

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]……在轨道上看，它是这么地微小。

人们并不是拥有星球，而是属于这颗星球。回到这里，我们又向找回自己的过去迈进了一步。

我们在前主人的手中遭受的苦难永远不能弥消。真正的疗愈需要花费几个世代。但总之，今天确实是个好日子。
entries.en:
[From.GetName]... From orbit, it appears so small.

A world does not belong to its people; it is the people who belong to their world. In returning here, we take another step towards reclaiming our past.

The trauma we experienced at the hands of our former masters can never be undone. True healing will take generations. But today is a good day.

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]……在轨道上看，它是这么地微小。

人们并不是拥有星球，而是属于这颗星球。回到这里，我们又向找回自己的过去迈进了一步。

我们在前主人的手中遭受的苦难永远不能弥消。真正的疗愈需要花费几个世代。但总之，今天确实是个好日子。
entries.en:
[From.GetName]... From orbit, it appears so small.

A world does not belong to its people; it is the people who belong to their world. In returning here, we take another step towards reclaiming our past.

The trauma we experienced at the hands of our former masters can never be undone. True healing will take generations. But today is a good day.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]……肯定是搞错了什么。在轨道上我们无法探测到任何感性生命。所有的人口可能都被某种方式抹去了。\n\n尽管这与我们预想的归乡大相径庭，但返回这个恒星系还是让我们向着寻回自己过去迈出了一步。不幸的是，我们得独自携带者[From.GetName]前行了，只有靠我们才能传承记忆。
entries.en: [From.GetName]... Something is very wrong here. From orbit, we can detect no signs of sentient life. Somehow, the entire population has been eliminated.\n\nWhile this was not the homecoming we hoped for, by returning to this system we have taken another step towards reclaiming our past. Unfortunately, we alone must carry the legacy of [From.GetName]. It is up to us to remember.

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]……这里发生了非常不好的事情。

被炸毁的土地上尘土飞荡。大部分的表面都被辐射了，少数绝望的幸存者在废墟中坚持生活。

虽然这不是我们所希望的归宿，但通过返回这个星系，我们已经向收回我们的过去的一步迈进了。
entries.en:
[From.GetName]... Something very wrong has happened here.

Dust drifts across a blasted landscape. Much of the surface is irradiated, and the few desperate survivors cling to life in the ruins.

While this was not the homecoming we hoped for, by returning to this system we have taken another step towards reclaiming our past.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]……自从我们被掳走以来，这里发生了蓬勃的发展。他们不再被局限于单一行星上，而是已经迈向了繁星的征途。尽管这与我们预想的归乡大相径庭，但返[From.GetName]上的科技进步属实卓越。\n\n而我们则已经没有了归处，我们被偷走的过去再也找不回来。我们现在能做的只有朝前看。
entries.en: [From.GetName]... Since we were taken from our home, much has transpired here. No longer bound to a single planet, the population has turned towards the stars. While this may not be the homecoming we expected, the technological progress on [From.GetName] is remarkable.\n\nFor us, there is no going back; our stolen past can never be reclaimed. All we can do now is look to the future.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]……自从我们被掳走以来，这里发生了很多事情。我们的这些同胞已经失去了主权，被另一个星系强权所统治了。\n\n而我们则已经没有了归处，我们被偷走的过去再也找不回来。我们现在能做的只有朝前看。
entries.en: [From.GetName]... Since we were taken from our home, much has transpired here. Far from a sovereign people, our kin have been claimed by another galactic power.\n\nFor us, there is no going back; our stolen past can never be reclaimed. All we can do now is look to the future.

entries.zh: 归乡节给我们的人民留下了深刻的印象，让我们的社会焕发新的活力。
entries.en: Returning home has immensely impressed our people and reinvigorated our society.

entries.zh: 我们最近举行的归乡节激励了我们的人口，让社会焕发了活力。
entries.en: Our most recent homecoming has energized our population and galvanized society.

entries.zh: 限制自由迁徙的权利不得人心。
entries.en: Limiting the right of free movement has proven unpopular.

entries.zh: 授予自由迁徙的权利是民心所向。
entries.en: Granting the right of free movement has proven popular.

entries.zh: 作为一个民族，我们为集体的目标而团结，为共同的家园而骄傲。
entries.en: As a people, we are united in our purpose and proud of our shared home.

entries.zh: 鼓励自由迁徙导致了不受拘束的创造力爆发，促生了科学的繁荣。
entries.en: Encouraging freedom of movement has led to unbound creativity and a flourishing of science.

entries.zh: 鼓励自由迁徙对我们所处的社会产生了深远影响。
entries.en: Encouraging freedom of movement has had great effects on our progress as a society.

entries.zh: 关于我们曾经的家园传来了始料未及的消息，让我们的人民深感失望。
entries.en: The unexpected news about our former home has upset our population.

entries.zh:
挣脱枷锁后，我们走出了成为一个民族的第一步。然而，在返回我们曾经的母星后，共同的目标开始发生动摇。

大众媒体充斥着对$NAME_MSI_country$到来前我们被母星上“返璞归真生活”的高度浪漫化的描述。而有许多人已经回到了母星。

如果我们不加以晶体，这可能会让我们的社会发生严重的动荡。
entries.en:
In casting off our shackles, we took the first step towards becoming a people. However, after returning to our former home world that sense of shared purpose has begun to wane.

Popular media is awash with highly romanticized depictions of the 'simple life' enjoyed on our former home world before the arrival of $NAME_MSI_country$. Many have already returned.

If we are not careful, this could have a seriously destabilizing effect on our society.

entries.zh: 我们再也担负不起任何一名国民的损失了。
entries.en: We cannot afford to lose any more of our people.

entries.zh: 自由迁徙是一项基本权利。
entries.en: Freedom of movement is a fundamental right.
