entries.zh: §R5%§!不具备§H平等主义§!思潮的人口将向该思潮转化。
entries.en: §R5%§! of your pop groups without the §HEgalitarian§! ethic will drift toward it.

entries.zh: 一个新的群众运动已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上站稳脚跟。这些极端分子自称为“归乡者”，主张我们应该将全体人民送回他们的起源行星，同时令国家解体。安全部队已将警戒状态提高到高级别，任何人数超过100人的公共集会都被禁止。
entries.en: A new movement has taken root on [Root.Capital.GetName]. Calling themselves The Returners, these extremists are advocating for the wholesale return of our people to their planets of origin, as well as the dissolution of our empire. Security forces have been placed on high alert, and all public gatherings of more than 100 individuals banned.

entries.zh: 归乡者们正在煽动反政府情绪，呼吁我们帝国的各物种落叶归根，回到自己的故土。该运动中最极端的派系已经和亲政府军队之间爆发了战斗。据报道，几个主要的城市中心已经遭到了严重的破坏。
entries.en: Stoking anti-government sentiment, The Returners are calling on the various species in our empire to return to their roots. Fighting has broken out between the movement's most extreme factions and pro-government forces. Severe damage has been reported in several major urban centers.

entries.zh: 虽然为了禁止人民返回他们各自的家园星球，我们付出了一定的代价，但事实最终证明了这个决策是正确的。近期，我们目睹社会凝聚力得到了明显的改善，同时，人们对于[Root.Capital.GetName]才是我们的家园这一观点有了崭新的共识。
entries.en: While forbidding our people to return to their respective home worlds has not been without its consequences, in the end it has proven the correct decision. Recently, we have witnessed a marked improvement in social cohesion, as well as a newfound sense that [Root.Capital.GetName] is indeed our home.

entries.zh: 只有强人的手腕才能铸造国家。
entries.en: Only a strong hand can forge a nation.

entries.zh: 虽然允许人们移民到我们曾经的家园星球在过去是一项群众喜闻乐见的政策，但也有相应的后果。最近，我们经历了一次重大的“人才流失”，因为一些最聪明的人才选择了迁往别处。
entries.en: While permitting emigration to our former home worlds has proven a popular policy, it has not been consequence-free. Recently, we have experienced a significant 'brain drain', as some of some of our brightest minds have made the choice to relocate.

entries.zh: 我们必须避免人才进一步的流失。
entries.en: We must prevent any further loss of talent.

entries.zh: 允许我们的人民返回自己的母星，作出这样的决策并非没有代价。但是，自由迁徙的政策推动了思想枷锁的解除。新的想法正在蓬勃发展，科学技术的进步已成为常态，而非一时的例外。
entries.en: The decision to allow our people to return to their home worlds was not without its costs, but with freedom of movement has come an unshackling in thought; new ideas are flourishing, and advances in science and technology are the norm rather than the exception.

entries.zh: 允许我们的人民返回自己的母星，作出这样的决策并非没有代价。但是，自由迁徙的政策推动了思想枷锁的解除。新的想法正在蓬勃发展，社会层面的革新已成为常态，而非一时的例外。
entries.en: The decision to allow our people to return to their home worlds was not without its costs, but with freedom of movement has come an unshackling in thought; new ideas are flourishing, and advances in society are the norm rather than the exception.

entries.zh: [From.GetName]……我们几乎忘记了空气中的芬芳。在经历了所有的一切之后，我们现在回归了家园，一切都显得如此不真实。
entries.en: [From.GetName]... We had almost forgotten the scent of the air. To return now, after all we have experienced, feels almost unreal.

entries.zh: 在起义后，我们中有的人说，我们应该各奔前程了。他们坚称[Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]不是我们的家园，我们只不过是一群由契约资产组成的乌合之众，我们面临的困难太过艰巨不可战胜。\n\n但我们第一座空间站的竣工，昭示着自由民能够完成伟大的壮举。只有想不到，没有做不到。
entries.en: After the mutiny, there were some among us who said we should go our separate ways. They argued that [Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] was not our home, that we were nothing but a motley band of indentured assets, and that the challenges before us were too great to overcome.\n\nBut with the building of our first Outpost, we've shown exactly what a free people can accomplish. The only limit is our own imagination.

entries.zh: 在摆脱桎梏的斗争历程中，我们迈出了成为一个民族的第一步。然而，近年来，大众媒体充斥着对我们以前在家园星球所享受的“朴素生活”的叙述，言语之间尽是浪漫美化。许多人已经吵着要回去。\n\n如果我们不小心谨慎，这场运动将严重影响我们社会秩序的稳定。
entries.en: In casting off our shackles, we took the first step towards becoming a people. However, in recent years, popular media is awash with highly romanticized depictions of the 'simple life' enjoyed on our former home world. Many are already clamoring to return.\n\nIf we are not careful, this movement could have a seriously destabilizing effect on our society.

entries.zh: 团结一致反对我们以前的奴隶主很容易；有了一个共同的敌人，我们就能像拧成一股绳一样抗争和战斗。但随着自由的到来，人民内部的裂痕开始出现。\n\n我们是来自不同星球的民族聚集体，我们的政治也同样多元。新的派系正在组建起来。肯定也会出现未来更多的派系。作为一个民族，我们能否妥善处理这些差异，将决定我们的命运。
entries.en: To unite against our former masters was easy; with a common enemy, we struggled and fought as one. But with freedom, cracks have started to appear.\n\nWe are a people of many worlds, and our politics are no less diverse. New factions are being founded. More will surely follow. As a people, how well we navigate these differences will determine our fate.

entries.zh: 我们是一个拥有众多星球的民族，随着时间的推移，我们已经认识到多样性的宝贵价值。然而，要让几种不同的文化间保持平衡并非易事，更不要说完全不同的物种在生理上的需求也各不相同。我们之间隔阂渐生，尽管到现在为止，我们依然想方设法驾驭住了不断变化的政治格局，但我们不能对社会中固有的分歧视而不见了。\n\n现在许多人呼吁成立一个特别委员会，来调和这些改革的呼声。
entries.en: We are a people of many worlds, and over time we have learned the value of diversity. However, negotiating the dynamics of several different cultures - not to mention the physical needs of completely distinct species - has not been easy. Our differences run deep, and while we have managed to navigate the shifting political landscape up to now, the divisions inherent in our society have grown impossible to ignore.\n\nMany are now calling for a special committee to be formed to moderate the calls for reform.

entries.zh: 这是在无用地浪费资源。
我们政治文化中极深的隔阂已经引起了社会动乱。
entries.en: The deep divisions in our political culture have resulted in social unrest.

entries.zh: 我们组建的一个用于调研政治文化中存在隔阂现象的委员会。
entries.en: A committee has been formed to investigate the deep divisions in our political culture.

entries.zh: 我们的社会存在着严重的割裂。将许多星球和许多不同的文化统合在一起，免不了会滋生矛盾。希望本委员会能够为这个问题提供解决方案。
entries.en: Our society is deeply divided. A union of many worlds, and many different cultures, does not come without tension. It is to be hoped that this committee can offer solutions to the problem.

entries.zh: 当多样化的思想聚集在一起时，难以预料他们能够实现什么样的成就；我们的研究团队增加了一名新晋的、非[Root.GetSpeciesName]成员，此人已经取得了一些新的研究成果。
entries.en: When diverse minds come together, there's no telling what they can accomplish; the addition of a new, non [Root.GetSpeciesName] member to our research team is already producing results.

entries.zh: 作为一个起源于众多不同星球的民族，整合全体人民绝非易事。然而，我们多元化的艺术传统经过融合，产生了令人难以置信的创造力的源泉，广受好评的新产品层出不穷。无数艺术家和设计师涌现出来，他们都受到多元化的启发，不断拓展表现手法的前沿。国内相关产业得到空前的蓬勃发展，我们的人民从未像现在这样投身于这些事业。
entries.en: As a people of many worlds, integration has not been without its challenges. However, the synthesis of our diverse artistic traditions has resulted in an incredible amount of creative energy. New products are being promoted. Countless artists and designers have emerged, all inspired to push the boundaries of expression. Domestic industry is thriving, and our people have never been more engaged.

entries.zh: 多元思想的相互融合，为我们民族产生了数不胜数的益处。
entries.en: The synergy of diverse minds has resulted in numerous benefits for our people.

entries.zh: 我们在星海共同体的联系人向我们传递了消息：正在制定相关法律法规，意在禁止
entries.en: Word has reached us from our contacts at the Galactic Community: legislation is in the works that would ban

entries.zh: $resolution_proposed_intro$全星系范围内的奴隶劳工和奴隶牲口制度。如果我们真心想要支持自由，那么就必须旗帜鲜明地站在改革的一方。如果我们没能作出行动，我们的人民会怎么想？
entries.en: $resolution_proposed_intro$ chattel and livestock slavery throughout the galaxy. If we truly profess to favor freedom, we must stand on the side of change. What will our people think, if we fail to act?

entries.zh: 绝大多数的奴隶制度被取缔
今天对于星海共同体来说是伟大的一天，各成员国投票决定将绝大多数形式的奴隶制裁定为非法。星系的人们再也不需要担心被下作的暴徒和唯利是图的公司压迫了。尽管在确保所有感性生命体的自由权利方面，我们还有很长的路要走，但此次裁定代表了重要的第一步。
entries.en: A great day at the Galactic Community, where members voted to outlaw most forms of slavery. No longer will the people of the galaxy need to fear oppression at the hands of petty thugs and profit-hungry corporations. Although there is a long way to go before the right of all sentient beings to freedom is ensured, this represents an important first step.

entries.zh: 开明的思想取得了胜利。
由于压迫性政权和剥削性公司以恶毒的手段进行了阻挠，在可预见的未来，这种可憎的做法将继续下去。
entries.en: Due to the malign presence of oppressive regimes and exploitative corporations, this detestable practice will continue for the foreseeable future.

entries.zh: 今天对于星海共同体来说是一个令人心碎的日子，取缔绝大多数形式的奴隶制的动议未能获得足够的票数。$slavery_allowed_outro$
entries.en: A heartbreaking day at the Galactic Community, where a motion to outlaw most forms of slavery failed to gain enough votes. $slavery_allowed_outro$

entries.zh: $resolution_proposed_intro$绝大多数形式的奴隶制，包括可憎的契约式奴役。如果我们自己的斗争经验能教会我们什么，那就是如果不发声诉求，权力是不会让步的。一个地方一旦存在奴隶制，就不可能有正义。我们必须与星系中其他开明的成员国站在一起。只有这样做，我们才能保证我们人民的安全和尊严。
entries.en: $resolution_proposed_intro$ most forms of slavery, including the abomination of indentured servitude. If our own experience has taught us anything, it is that power concedes nothing without a demand. Where slavery exists, there can be no justice. We must stand together with the other enlightened members of the galaxy. Only by doing so can we guarantee the safety and dignity of our people.

entries.zh: 今天对于星海共同体来说是值得载入史册的重要日子，各成员国投票决定禁止一切形式的奴隶制——甚至包括契约奴役这样的卑劣做法。像$NAME_MSI_country$这样的公司将不再能够以利润的名义剥削无辜者。终于，星系历史上最黑暗的篇章之一可以结束了。
entries.en: A monumental day at the Galactic Community, where members voted to ban all forms of slavery - including the vile practice of indentured servitude. No longer will corporations like $NAME_MSI_country$ be able to exploit the innocent in the name of profit. At last, one of the darkest chapters in galactic history can finally come to a close.

entries.zh: 星海共同体传来令人心碎的消息，一场取缔一切形式的奴隶制的运动失败了。$slavery_allowed_outro$
entries.en: Heartbreak at the Galactic Community, where a motion to outlaw all forms of slavery has failed. $slavery_allowed_outro$

entries.zh: $resolution_proposed_intro$对有机体的奴役，而且是全方位的。对于我们来说，这件事没有妥协的余地。奴隶制是星系篇章上的污点。我们必须尽一切所能，彻底地将其终结。
entries.en: $resolution_proposed_intro$ the enslavement of all organic populations. For us, there can be no compromise. Slavery is a stain upon the galaxy. We must do what we can to end it permanently.

entries.zh: 今天是泛星系贸易市场的重要一日，我们决定将有机体奴役裁定为非法。人民再也不需要担心被下作的暴徒和唯利是图的公司压迫了。今晚我们都可以睡个好觉了。
entries.en: A monumental day at the Galactic Market, which made the decision today to outlaw the enslavement of organic populations. No longer will the people of the galaxy need to fear oppression at the hands of petty thugs and profit-hungry corporations. We can all rest easier tonight.

entries.zh: 泛星系贸易市场的行动受到了挫折，各成员国决定继续放任邪恶的奴隶制度下的各类行径。$slavery_allowed_outro$
entries.en: Frustration at the Galactic Market, as members agreed to continue the vile practice of slavery. $slavery_allowed_outro$

entries.zh: $resolution_proposed_intro$对智慧生命体的奴役，而且是全方位的。无论是哪个物种，一旦在有思想的个体身上套上锁链，最终一定会发现锁链的另一端套在了自己身上。我们必须支持这项动议。
entries.en: $resolution_proposed_intro$ the slavery of all forms of sentient life. No species can put a chain on a thinking individual without at last finding the other end fastened to themselves. We must support this motion.

entries.zh: 属于全体智慧生命的胜利
entries.en: A Victory for All Sentient Beings

entries.zh: 今天对于泛星系贸易市场来说是历史性的一天，各成员国投票通过废除奴隶制议案。自由成为了全体感性生命的天然权利。今日，星海历史中不光彩的一章体面地完结了。
entries.en: A historic day at the Galactic Market, where members voted to outlaw slavery in all its forms. Freedom is the natural right of all sentient beings. Today, a vile chapter in galactic history comes to a merciful close.

entries.zh: 今天是泛星系贸易市场上令人沮丧的一天，各国作出决策，决定继续出售感性的非有机体生命。再一次，权力和金钱驱使的恶行扼杀了自由的事业。只要还有一个有情感的生命体佩戴着镣铐——无论这生命是天然孕育还是人工制造——就没有人可以高枕无忧。
entries.en: A frustrating day at the Galactic Market, where the decision was made to continue the sale of sentient non-organics. Once again, the malign influence of power and money have stifled the cause of freedom. No one - whether organic or artificial - can rest easy while even a single sentient being is forced into bondage.

entries.zh: 企业的势力已经成功地废除了星海共同体最近制定的反对奴隶制的议案。虽然这一切令人失望，但此等不幸的发展并不出乎意料；历史是螺旋上升的，而且螺线有时候会很长，但最终，自由的事业终将取得胜利。
entries.en: Corporate forces have succeeded in repealing the Galactic Community's recent resolution against slavery. While this is disappointing, unfortunately it is not unexpected; the arc of history runs long, but in the end, the cause of freedom will prevail.

entries.zh: 修复这艘坠毁的运奴船的电脑核心应该可以令我们找到自己母星的位置……同时也是$NAME_MSI_country$的母星。
entries.en: Repairing the computer core of the crashed slaver ship should reveal the location of our former home worlds... as well as $NAME_MSI_country$.

entries.zh: 在起义中，将我们运往[Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]的运奴船受损严重。在紧急迫降后，我们的第一任务是生存，除了拆解舰船获取资源以外我们几乎没有什么别的想法。但现在是时候去发掘我们前主人的秘密了。\n\n为此，首先我们要恢复舰船中央计算机的供能。我们的[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师先是在船体的外部装配了一组太阳能电池，舰桥上的指挥控制台便可以恢复运转。但不幸的是，迫降时工程甲板的大门被卡死了，破拆防爆门进入其中可不是件容易的事。
entries.en: During the mutiny, the slaver ship that carried us to [Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] was badly damaged. After the crash, our first priority was survival, and other than stripping the ship for resources, we gave it little thought. But now the time has come to uncover the secrets of our former masters.\n\nTo do so, it will be necessary to restore power to the ship's central computer. As a first step, our [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers rigged a series of solar cells to the ship's outer hull. The command consoles in the bridge are now operational. Unfortunately, the engineering deck was sealed off during the crash, and breaking through the blast doors won't be easy.

entries.zh: $NAME_MSI_country$也不是盖的：这些蓄奴的混蛋还真挺能保护自己的机密。\n\n敲开舰船的防爆门果然是一项史诗级任务。我们几乎没有设计用来进行小规模采矿作业的激光切割器。我们的团队只能是从甲板的下方挖洞才最终取得了进展。[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师们现在已经开始加班加点恢复舰船其他部分的能量供应。
entries.en: Say this much for $NAME_MSI_country$: the slave-holding scum know how to safeguard their secrets.\n\nPrying open the ship's blast doors has proven a monumental task. What few laser cutters we possess were designed for low-scale mining operations. Only by tunneling up from the deck below was the team able to make any progress. [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers are now hard at work restoring power to the rest of the ship's systems.

entries.zh: 虽然我们的[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师已经设法恢复了飞船计算机核心的电源，但绝大部分的硬件还是在坠毁时损坏了。尽管还是有可能修复，但这样做意味着给我们已经负担过重的科学团队带来了更大的压力。
entries.en: While our [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers have managed to restore power to the ship's computer core, a significant chunk of hardware was damaged in the crash. It should be possible to repair, but doing so means putting even more of a strain on our already overburdened science team.

entries.zh: 我们需要那数据。修复核心。
entries.en: We need that data. Repair the core.

entries.zh: 修复运奴船的电脑核心给我们的工程师造成了巨大的压力。
entries.en: Repairing the slaver's computer core is placing a significant strain on our engineers.

entries.zh: 得益于一些异想天开的方案，我们的[engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj]工程师们诚通地重启了受损的计算机核心。在舰船系统中引入程序化人工智能，我们就可以开启会话。总的来说，我们感觉这台机器还是愿意帮我们一把的，而不是在碍我们事。\n\n这项突破给予我们的科学家一些关于数据加密的新线索。随着我们逐渐在星系舞台上崭露头角，这些知识一定能派上用场的。
entries.en: Thanks to some incredible, outside-the-box thinking, our [engineering_shackled_species.GetAdj] engineers have managed to restart the damaged computer core. By introducing a procedural AI to the ship's systems, we were able to engage it in dialogue. Essentially, we convinced the machine to work with, rather than against us.\n\nThe breakthrough has provided our scientists with new insights into the nature of data encryption. As we continue to make our presence felt on the galactic stage, such knowledge could prove invaluable.

entries.zh: 损坏的计算机核心已经完全修好了，尽管多数的数据是加密的，但破译工作已经开始。只要愿意花费时间和人力物力，我们迟早能获得包括我们原母星的位置在内的所有信息。
entries.en: The damaged computer core has been fully repaired, and while most of the data is encoded, decryption efforts are already underway. If we're willing to put in the time and allocate the resources, it's only a matter of time before we have access to everything - including the location of our former home worlds.

entries.zh:
$origin.5035.desc$

事实上，我们或许已经收集到了一些对我们有利的信息：通过对在超空间航道网中穿梭的贩奴船进行三角定位，我们已经发现了$NAME_MSI_country$的宇宙坐标。

现在有两个选项摆在我们面前，直面前宗主，或是单纯祈祷上天降下惩罚。
entries.en:
$origin.5035.desc$

In fact, we may have already learned something to our advantage: by triangulating the hyperlane dilations along the slaver ship's flight path, we have uncovered the galactic coordinates of $NAME_MSI_country$.

We now have the choice, either to confront our former masters, or leave them to their fate.

entries.zh: 我们已经完全解密了这艘坠毁殖民船中的文档，现在，我们已能够精准确定我们的母星在星系中的位置。
entries.en: Now that the files in the crashed slaver ship are fully decrypted, we will be able to pinpoint the galactic position of our home worlds.

entries.zh: 反编译坠毁殖民船数据库的特殊计划已经完成。我们找回了我们曾经的母星的位置。今日，我们大可庆祝我们在解放道路上踏出的又一步。
entries.en: The Special Project to decompile the databanks on the crashed slaver ship has concluded. We have uncovered the locations of our former home worlds. Today, we celebrate another step on the road to liberation.

entries.zh: 属于我们人民的伟大日子。
entries.en: A great day for our people.

entries.zh: 现在我们可以在情报日志中跟踪关于我们曾经的母星的发现。
entries.en: The discovery of our former home worlds can now be tracked in the Situation Log.

entries.zh: 曾经拥有最多人口的母星。
entries.en: The former home world of our largest demographic.

entries.zh: 我们的其中一支物种曾经的母星。
entries.en: The former home world of one of our species.

entries.zh: 我们的另一支物种曾经的母星。
entries.en: The former home world of another of our species.

entries.zh: 这一刻如期而至：我们与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!建立了联系。\n\n在起义后，有的人希望我们苟全性命于乱世，但显然$NAME_MSI_country$早已发现我们在星系舞台上的存在了。只有对利益的考虑可以阻止他们回来[Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName]拿回他们的“合法财产”。看来我们还不值得他们这么做。
entries.en: The moment we have long anticipated has arrived: we have made contact with §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!.\n\nAfter the mutiny, some hoped we could avoid detection, but it is now clear that $NAME_MSI_country$ have been aware of our presence on the galactic stage for some time. Only the pursuit of profit has kept them from returning to [Root.owner.capital_scope.GetName] to collect their 'legal assets.' It seems we weren't worth the cost of travel.

entries.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!的代表会见了我们的特使并表达的善意。但我们很明白这些允诺有多么地空洞虚伪。

公司来到我们的星球，允诺带来更好的生活。他们利用花言巧语和蝇头小利打通了我们领导层的关系，然后签订了协议并获得了贷款。资本开始运作，我们市场中的商品瞬间充盈了起来。在我们搞明白发生了什么之前一切都已经结束了：我们成了$NAME_MSI_country_initials$的私有财产。

这种事情不会再发生了。随着我们走向星系舞台，独立自主变得非常重要。
entries.en:
Representatives from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§! have approached our envoy with offers of friendship. But we know how hollow such assurances are.

The corporation first arrived on our worlds with promises of a better life. With sweet words and lavish gifts, they softened our leaders. Loans were provided; contracts signed. Investment capital flowed, and our marketplaces flooded with goods. Before we fully understood what was happening, it had already been done: we had become assets, and $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ our masters.

Never again. As we push forward on the galactic stage, it's essential that we stand on our own.

entries.zh: 经过了一系列冗长而措辞激烈的会议，我们与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!终于是正式建交了。然而，无论他们如何强调亲善，我们也绝不会忘记他们对我们的母星所犯下的罪行。想到这个公司还逍遥法外，肆意地像对待过去的我们一样奴役他人……我们早已出离愤怒。\n\n过去他们把我们视为财产和工具。现在我们要让他们知道自由民的厉害。
entries.en: After a prolonged and often intense series of meetings, diplomatic relations have been established between ourselves and §H[This.ContactCountry.GetRealName]§!. However, no matter their claims of friendship, we have not forgotten what they did to our home worlds. The thought that this corporation has been left unpunished, free to enslave others as they once did us... The emotion goes beyond words.\n\nOnce they called us property. Let us teach them the value of a free people.

entries.zh: 我们派往星海共同体的代表汇报：已经与[MSI_country.GetName]建立联络。\n\n公司来到我们的星球，允诺带来更好的生活。他们利用花言巧语和蝇头小利打通了我们领导层的关系，然后签订了协议并获得了贷款。在我们搞明白发生了什么之前一切都已经结束了：我们成了他们的私有财产。必须给星海共同体的成员提个醒，千万不要上$NAME_MSI_country_initials$的当。
entries.en: Word from our representatives at the Galactic Community: contact has been made with [MSI_country.GetName].\n\nThe corporation first arrived on our worlds with promises of a better life. With sweet words and lavish gifts, they softened our leaders. Loans were provided; contracts signed. Before we truly understood what was happening, it had already been done: we had become assets, and they our masters. The members of the Galactic Community must be warned. $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ cannot be trusted.

entries.zh: 此战非我所愿，但我们将给它画上句号。
entries.en: We did not seek out this war. But we will end it.

entries.zh: 我们在旧主的阴影下苟且偷生的日子太久了，我们享受着这应得的自由之时，有太多的同胞还在作为契约奴隶遭受着他们的羞辱。一些人可能会将这视作侵略战争并加以谴责。不管怎样，反抗暴政的时机已到。这些星系中的流氓和利润贩子将不再被准许继续他们那卑鄙的勾当。\n\n今天，我们迈向战争。
entries.en: For too long we have lived in fear of our former masters, but while we enjoy the benefit of a freedom justly earned, far too many continue to suffer under the indignities of indentured servitude. Some may decry this as a war of aggression. Nevertheless, the time has come for us to strike a blow against tyranny. No longer will the petty thugs and profit-mongers of the galaxy be allowed to ply their vile trade.\n\nToday, we march to war.

entries.zh: $NAME_MSI_country$的糖衣炮弹没有成功，于是现在他们要来硬的了。他们的董事会认为我们软弱可欺。但解开了枷锁的我们早已如钢铁般铸成一体了。\n\n$MSI_war_outro$
entries.en: Having failed to conquer us with money and lies, $NAME_MSI_country$ will now try with force. Their Board of Directors believe us weak. But in casting off our shackles, we have forged an identity that can never be broken.\n\n$MSI_war_outro$

entries.zh: 意想不到的事情发生了。[From.GetName]赢了，而我们再一次回到了他们的束缚之下。尽管我们输掉了这场战争，但争取自由与平等的斗争还远未结束。
entries.en: The unthinkable has happened. [From.GetName] is victorious, and once more we find ourselves bent beneath their yoke. But while we may have lost this war, the battle for equality and justice is far from over.

entries.zh: 我们同[MSI_country.GetName]达成了一个维持现状协议。但是它们要知道我们并没有忘记曾经在它们手上受到过怎样的对待。我们也不打算忘记。
entries.en: We have reached a status quo agreement with [MSI_country.GetName]. But let it be known that we have not forgotten our treatment at their hands. Nor have we forgiven.

entries.zh: 我们胜利了。战胜[From.GetName]不仅让我们赢回了尊严，更证明了我们才是自己命运的主人。\n\n解开枷锁让我们找到共同目标，而今天我们才算是真正重获自由。
entries.en: Victory is ours. In defeating [From.GetName], we have not only reclaimed our dignity, but proven ourselves the masters of our own fate.\n\nIn casting off our chains, we found common purpose. Today we are truly free.

entries.zh: $NAME_MSI_country$把我们从自己的星球家园中掳走，囚禁我们，用不平等的契约奴役我们。甚至现在，他们还妄想着在商业的幌子下继续进行那卑鄙的贸易。现在是时候彻底将它们终结了。
entries.en: $NAME_MSI_country$ stole us from our worlds, imprisoned and indentured us. Even now, they continue their vile trade under a guise of commerce. The time has come to end them once and for all.

entries.zh: 上回$NAME_MSI_country$没能征服我们，他们再次挑起了战争。他们的董事会不是傻了就是疯了。自由的人民是不可战胜的。\n\n$MSI_war_outro$
entries.en: Having already failed to subdue us, $NAME_MSI_country$ has once again declared war. Their Board of Directors is either incompetent, mad, or both. A free people can never be broken.\n\n$MSI_war_outro$

entries.zh: 尽管我们饱尝着通过正当手段赢得的自由之甜果，星系中还有太多人继续在奴隶制和契约奴役的屈辱下受苦。星系中的流氓和利润贩子别想继续从事他们卑鄙的交易。\n\n现在是时候我们站出来反抗此等暴政了。
entries.en: While we enjoy the benefit of a freedom justly earned, far too many in the galaxy continue to suffer under the indignities of slavery and indentured servitude. No longer will the petty thugs and profit-mongers of the galaxy be allowed to ply their vile trade.\n\nThe time has come for us to take a stand against such tyranny.

entries.zh:
今天，我们加入了一个有§Y$NAME_MSI_country$§!存在的联邦。

在我们重获自由之初绝不可能想到未来会有这样的展开。如今我们可以心平气和地与过去的压迫者们展开外交，这说明了我们的国家已经步入成熟。

显然，会有很多人不满意这一决定。但这次情况特殊，目的确实证明了手段的正确。
entries.en:
Today, we enter into a federation with §Y$NAME_MSI_country$§!.

When we first claimed our freedom, such a development would have been unthinkable. That we are now able to engage in peaceful diplomacy with our erstwhile captors speaks to the growing maturity of our nation.

There are those among us who will not be happy with this decision. But in this case, the ends truly justify the means.

entries.zh: 今天，我们作出了一个艰难的决定，与一个已知的奴隶主国家结成联盟。虽然我们认为每个有情感的生命体的自由是不可剥夺的权利，但国家的需要迫使我们做出妥协。我们的人民可能不高兴，但我们这样做是为了更加长远的利益。
entries.en: Today, we have made the difficult decision to enter into a federation with a known slaver. While we consider the freedom of every sentient being an inalienable right, the necessities of state have forced us to compromise. Our people may not be happy, but we have done this for the greater good.

entries.zh: 我们已经找到了$NAME_MSI_country$的星系坐标。
entries.en: We have learned the galactic coordinates of $NAME_MSI_country$.

entries.zh: 由于我们取回了坠毁的运奴飞船上的数据，现在我们已经找到了前家园星球的星系坐标。我们的人民迫不及待地渴望踏上返乡的旅程。
entries.en: With the data retrieved from the crashed slaver ship, we have pinpointed the galactic coordinates of our former home worlds. Our people are clamoring for a return.

entries.zh: 我们在穿越星辰的旅程中发现了各种奇迹。我们目睹了超越想象的景色，完成了乍一想根本不可能完成的壮举。作为一个民族，我们已经走了很远。但是，没有什么旅程，也没有什么奖励，比找到回家的路更重要。
entries.en: Our journey across the stars has revealed wonders. We have witnessed sights beyond imagination, accomplished feats that at first seemed impossible. As a people, we have traveled far. But no journey, and no reward, is greater than finding the way home.

entries.zh: 各类大众媒体上满是关于所谓跨物种融合的失败报道。特别值得关注的是，由于某些变种从未进化到能在特定星球上定居，为了支援这一部分特别的人群所划拨的额外款项。随着紧张局势的持续升温，安全部队报告道，物种间冲突急剧上升，已到了警报级别。
entries.en: Popular media is awash with reports about the supposed failure of inter-species integration. Of particular concern is the cost of supporting certain populations on worlds their xenotype never evolved to inhabit. As tensions continue to rise, security forces have reported an alarming increase in inter-species conflict.

entries.zh: 我们不会为言论自由设下限制。
entries.en: We will not place limits on freedom of speech.

entries.zh: 对媒体进行约谈，让他们不要阴阳怪气。
entries.en: Instruct the media to tone down their rhetoric.

entries.zh:
特别委员会发布了一份关于我们社会中政治割裂的详尽研究。他们发现了在[Root.GetName]中，有三种主要的驱动力在促使政治发生多极化。

1、为满足各个不同种族的最低生活标准需要投入不均等的花费。

2、在各个截然不同的文化群体中存在互不相容的信仰体系和行为准则。

3、我们的政治体制与特定的物种价值观存在冲突甚至是完全相反。
entries.en:
The special committee has published the findings of an exhaustive study of the political divisions within our society. They have identified three main issues driving political polarization within [Root.GetName]:

1. The unequal costs associated with providing a minimum standard of living to diverse xenotypes.

2. The discordant belief systems and behaviors between several distinct culture groups.

3. The nature of our political authority as being in conflict with (or even antithetical to) the values of certain species.

entries.zh: 这些议题是相互联系的。

entries.en: It is cheaper to reign in the media.

entries.zh: §L确保我们社会中的每一个个体都有公平和平等的利益，这件事情既不简单，也不省事。但它是必要的。§!
entries.en: §LEnsuring a fair and equal stake for every individual in our society will not be simple, or cheap. But it is necessary.§!

entries.zh: §L在跨文化交往中进行投资，未来肯定能获得好处。§!
entries.en: §LInvesting in cross-cultural engagement is sure to pay dividends in the future.§!

entries.zh: §L一切皆为政治。一个健康的社会会主动投资、培养高参与、高活跃的公民群体。§!
entries.en: §LEverything is political. A healthy society is one that invests in an engaged and active citizenry.§!

entries.zh: §L纠正我们社会中的系统性问题将需要大量的时间和资源投入。§!
entries.en: §LRighting the systemic problems in our society will require a massive investment in time and resources.§!

entries.zh: §L政府对媒体进行监管，能够减少政治上的分裂和对立。§!
entries.en: §LGovernment oversight of the media is necessary to reduce political polarization.§!

entries.zh: 政府的监管可能有助于淡化政治上的不和，但对消除社会中的分歧却起不到什么作用。社群领袖不断地在各物种和文化群体之间挑拨离间。根据信息网络上公布的材料，这个问题只会变得愈发糟糕。
entries.en: Governmental oversight may have helped to tone down the political discourse, but it has done little to combat the divisions in society. Community leaders continue to sow discord between various species and culture groups. Based on the kind of material being published on the information net, the problem is certain to get worse before it gets better.

entries.zh: 我们需要从根源上解决这个问题。
entries.en: We need to address the root causes of this issue.
Restrict access to the information net.

entries.zh: 几个月以来，我们限制了公众对信息网络的访问。虽然这能够阻止政治领域的一些偏激分子找到发声的平台，但物种间冲突的根本原因却没有得到遏制。暴力，包括对财产的大规模破坏，在我们的各个恒星系都呈上升趋势。
entries.en: For several months now, we have restricted public access to the information net. While this prevented some of the more outlandish voices in the political spectrum from finding a platform, the root causes of inter-species conflict have gone unchecked. Violence, including the mass destruction of property, is on the rise throughout our systems.

entries.zh: 不惜一切代价恢复秩序。
我们的安保部队已经成功地恢复了我们所有恒星系的社会秩序。各类政治激进分子要么被围捕，要么被监禁，他们的领袖现在面临叛国罪的指控。\n\n回顾我们历史上这段令人遗憾的时期，有一点是非常清楚的：像我们这样的社会只能由强硬的手腕来管理。现在是时候由我们提供强硬的手腕了。
entries.en: Our security forces have succeeded in restoring order throughout our systems. Political radicals of all stripes have been rounded up and imprisoned, and their leaders now face charges of treason against the state.\n\nAs we look back on this regrettable period in our history, one thing is abundantly clear: a society like ours can only be governed by a firm hand. It is high time we provided one.

entries.zh: 只有团结一致，才能繁荣昌盛。

我们的社会自建立之初，就充斥着冲突。也许事情在变好之前不可避免地会变得更糟；在整个信息网络上，仇恨团体激增。要求将一个或另一个物种从我们的星域中驱逐出去的呼声已经是随处可见了。然而，也有迹象表明，人们对共同斗争的意识也有所提高。\n\n一些团体，除了对变革的渴望之外几乎没有什么共同点，但依然愈发频繁地走到了一起。通过直面我们的问题，在其他文明可能归于黑暗的事物，我们成功将其照亮。也许有一天，我们会把这段冲突的岁月看作是历史大势的转折点。
entries.en: From its founding, our society has been shaped by conflict. Perhaps it was inevitable that things would get worse before they got better; across the information net, hate groups proliferate. Calls for the expulsion of one or another species from our systems are all too common. Yet there are also signs of increased awareness of a shared struggle.\n\nGroups with little more in common than a desire for change have been coming together with increasing regularity. By confronting our issues head-on, we have shone a light on what otherwise might have grown in darkness. Perhaps one day we will look back on this time of conflict as the turning of the tide.

entries.zh: 这届政府为提高我们公民的生活质量做出了不懈努力。我们投资于教育、犯罪预防和各种文化项目。然而，我们却不断地注意到自己成为了无情抨击的对象。更过分的是，一个由年轻人组成的跨物种运动已经组织起来，呼吁进行更激进的改革，变革的步子要迈得更大。\n\n这里只有一线希望：通过激励年轻人踊跃行动，我们可能在不知不觉中创造了弥合我们社会分裂的必要条件。
entries.en: This government has worked tirelessly to improve the quality of life for our citizenry. We have invested in education, crime prevention, and cultural programs of all kinds. Nevertheless, we continue to find ourselves the target of relentless criticism. What's more, a cross-species movement of young people has organized, calling for more radical reforms and a faster pace of change.\n\nThere is only one silver lining to be found here: in galvanizing the youth to act, we may have unwittingly created the conditions necessary to heal the divisions in our society.

entries.zh:
尽管我们一直在努力推动营造清朗良好的政治氛围，然而到目前为止，普通民众几乎没有表现出参与政治的意愿。民意调查一直表明，构成我们社会的各物种和文化之间仍然存在重大分歧。

明显相关的是，我们的经济学家已经注意到消费者支出的明显增加。虽然这在短期内可能对企业有利，但它也导致了通货膨胀的飙升。或许是我们的人民已经厌倦了争斗和不和谐。

讽刺的是，作为政治上的结果，这些人因为在烧钱上志同道合而团结了起来。
entries.en:
Despite ongoing efforts to promote a healthy political climate, thus far, the general population has shown little engagement. Public opinion polls have consistently demonstrated that significant divisions remain between the various species and cultures that comprise our society.

In an apparent correlation, our economists have noticed a marked increase in consumer spending. While this may be good for business in the short-term, it has also led to a spike in inflation. It may be that our people have simply grown weary of the strife and discord.

Ironically, in tuning out politically, they have been united in a shared desire to consume.

entries.zh: 一般而言，一定程度的政治不和总是客观存在的，但是我们之间塑造的连结却绝不会断裂。
entries.en: Naturally, a certain amount of political discord remains, but the bonds we've forged together can never be broken.

entries.zh: 作为一个民族，我们面临着几乎无法克服的困难。我们曾是一群各种各样的奴隶，因为争取自由的斗争被捆在了一起，我们的道路从来都不是一帆风顺的。但是，通过选择将我们的资源集中用于正义事业，我们成功地塑造了作为一个国家的身份。$cost_of_freedom_outro$
entries.en: As a people, we faced nearly insurmountable odds. A diverse group of former slaves, thrown together in a struggle for freedom, our path has never been easy. But in choosing to concentrate our resources towards the cause of justice, we have succeeded in forging an identity as a nation. $cost_of_freedom_outro$

entries.zh: 从一开始，我们就面临着几乎无法克服的困难。一群奴隶和契约仆人，联合起来为了摆脱自己的桎梏……还有什么样的基础能比这更强大更牢固呢？这并不容易，但通过选择促进跨文化的对话，我们已经创造了一个强健和繁荣的社会。$cost_of_freedom_outro$
entries.en: From the beginning, we faced nearly insurmountable odds. A group of slaves and indentured servants, banding together to cast off their shackles... What stronger foundation could there be? It has not been easy, but in choosing to foster cross-cultural dialogue, we have created a robust and thriving society. $cost_of_freedom_outro$

entries.zh: 我们中间很少有人想到，当我们揭竿而起诉求自由时，争取平等的斗争才刚刚开始。作为一个由来自多个星球的物种组成的民族，对我们来说，建立共识或找到共同点从来都不容易，但通过鼓励参与政治生活，我们成功地创造了一个健全和繁荣的社会。$cost_of_freedom_outro$
entries.en: Little did it occur to us that the struggle for equality had only just begun when we rose up to claim our freedom. As a people of many worlds, it has never been easy for us to build consensus or to find common ground, but by investing in political engagement, we have succeeded in creating a robust and flourishing society. $cost_of_freedom_outro$

entries.zh: 因为渴望自由而联合到一起，我们奋起反抗曾经的主人。但是，社会不仅仅由暴力组成。从政治分裂到经济上的不安全，我们面临着巨大的挑战，但现在，当我们开始看到为建立共识所付出的不懈努力终于开花结果时，我们有理由为自己的瞩目成就感到骄傲。\n\n同一个国家，多样的民族；同一个民族，多元的文化。团结一致，我们无所不克。
entries.en: United by a desire for freedom, we rose up against our former masters. But society is not made by violence alone. From political division to economic insecurity, we have faced massive challenges, but now, as we begin to see the results of a concerted effort to build consensus, we can rightly take pride in our accomplishments.\n\nWe are a nation of many people, and a people of many cultures. Together, there is no challenge we cannot overcome.

entries.zh: 多元之中孕育着我们的力量。
为了维持社会秩序，我们对新闻界实行了一定的限制。
entries.en: In order to maintain social order, we have imposed certain limits on the media.

entries.zh: 我们没有选择，必须解决造成政治割裂局面的根本原因。
entries.en: We have no choice but to deal with the root causes of our political divisions.
Too much information can be dangerous.

entries.zh: 为了维持和平和稳定，必须将不稳定的种子连根拔起，祛除干净。
entries.en: To maintain peace and stability, it will be necessary to stamp out the seeds of disorder.

entries.zh: 源于多样性，和于集中制。
entries.en: Diverse in origin, united in authority.

entries.zh: 我们对资源进行了重新分配，以推动建设一个更加平等的社会。
entries.en: We have reallocated resources to promote a more equitable society.

entries.zh: 我们对资源进行了重新分配，以推动文化交流。
entries.en: We have reallocated resources to promote cultural exchange.

entries.zh: 我们对资源进行了重新分配，以推动群众更加活跃地参与政治生活。
entries.en: We have reallocated resources to promote more robust political engagement.

entries.zh: 我们对资源进行了重新分配，以弥合我们社会内部的隔阂。
entries.en: We have reallocated resources to heal the divides within our society.

entries.zh: 尽管文化割裂在持续地困扰着我们的社会，政治参与度却在逐步提升。
entries.en: Although cultural divisions continue to trouble our society, political engagement is flourishing.

entries.zh: 我们活在一个现实的世界。
entries.en: We are living in a material world.

entries.zh: 我们已经准备收获打造一个公正社会所孕育的成果。
entries.en: We are ready to reap the rewards of a just society.

entries.zh: 我们已经准备收获打造一个文化多样社会所孕育的成果。
entries.en: We are ready to reap the rewards of a culturally diverse society.

entries.zh: 我们已经准备收获打造一个政治活跃社会所孕育的成果。
entries.en: We are ready to reap the rewards of a politically robust society.

entries.zh: 作为一个民族，我们能够品尝正当赢得的平等的成果了。
entries.en: As a people, we can reap the rewards of equality justly earned.

entries.zh:
我们中的许多人曾以为这一天永远不会到来。今天，我们与$NAME_MSI_country$的董事会签订了正式的外交协议。

毫无疑问肯定有些人会反对这一决定。过去的伤痛绝不能被抹消，但也不能让我们在未来面前故步自封。

今天我们踏出了和解的第一步。
entries.en:
Many among us thought this moment would never come. Today, we have formally entered in a diplomatic agreement with the Board of $NAME_MSI_country$.

No doubt there are some who will oppose this decision. The past can never be erased. But neither should it define the course of the future.

Today we take the first steps towards reconciliation.

entries.zh: 我们决定与$NAME_MSI_country$构成联邦时，质疑声四起。许多人认为与曾经压迫我们的人和解绝不会带来任何好处。在过去这种担忧不无道理。\n\n如今，我们与$NAME_MSI_country_initials$的理事会签订了第一项外交协议，我们应当消除一律。我们要放下成见，平等地一起向前看。
entries.en: When we agreed to form a Federation with $NAME_MSI_country$, there was widespread skepticism. Many among us said no good could ever come from reconciling with our former masters. At the time, such concerns might have been warranted.\n\nToday, as we sign our first diplomatic agreement with the $NAME_MSI_country_initials$ Board of Directors, all doubts should be dispelled. Together, we look to a shared future. Not as adversaries, but as equals.

entries.zh: 在我们发动兵变之后，运奴船的工程舱被迅速重新布置成为一个基础的综合实验室。在适应了[Root.Capital.GetName]上的生活后，我们的工程师对其进行了改进和升级，以更好地满足他们的需求。
entries.en: After the mutiny, the engineering bay of the slaver vessel was rapidly repurposed to serve as a rudimentary lab complex. Having adapted to life on [Root.Capital.GetName] our engineers have made improvements and upgrades to better suit their needs.
The §H£building£ $building_low_tech_research_lab$§! on §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! will be upgraded to §H£building£ $building_research_lab_1$§!.

entries.zh: 在进行最初的几次行动的时候，我们新生的政府就匆忙地将运奴船的几层甲板进行了重新改造，成为一个基本的行政管理中心。现在我们已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上站稳了脚跟，而这些设施也已经得到了升级。
entries.en: In one of their first acts, our fledgling government hastily repurposed several decks of the slaver vessel to serve as a rudimentary administrative hub. Now that we have firmly established ourselves on [Root.Capital.GetName], these facilities have been upgraded.
The §H£building£ $building_low_tech_admin_hub$§! on §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! will be upgraded to §H£building£ $building_bureaucratic_1$§!.
The §H£building£ $building_low_tech_admin_hub$§! on §Y[Root.Capital.GetName]§! will be upgraded to a §H£building£ $building_temple$§!.

entries.zh:
有一座环绕[From.GetName]的观测站，我们将更好地照看我们曾经的母星。这座观测站不仅会促进物质和文化交流，还能帮助我们改善这颗星球上人民的生活。

现在我们必须做出决定：在知道结果的前提下，我们是否愿意帮助我们的同胞走向群星？

毫无疑问，他们配得上在宇宙的舞台上加入我们，但他们真的准备好迈出这一步了吗？正如我们曾经经历过的，急速的社会变革的后果很可能是极端的。
entries.en:
With an observation post built around [From.GetName], we will be able to keep a much better watch on our former home world. Not only will this station facilitate material and cultural exchange, but it could also help us to improve the life of the people on the planet.

A decision must be made: are we willing to help our kin reach the stars, knowing what the results could be?

No doubt they deserve to join us on the galactic stage, but are they truly ready to make the leap? As we have seen firsthand, the consequences of rapid social change can be extreme.

entries.zh: 我们的观测站现在正处于环绕[From.GetName]的轨道上。从这个制高点俯瞰下去，我们可以为同胞们的点点成功感到喜悦，如果有必要的话，还能帮助他们应对挑战。\n\n随着我们的发展，一个新的问题摆在了我们面前：我们是该让他们宁静地繁衍生息，还是让他们走向宇宙？两个选择都会有各自的风险，以及一定的回报。
entries.en: Our observation post is now in orbit around [From.GetName]. From this vantage point, we can celebrate the successes of our kin, and if necessary, help them to mitigate their challenges.\n\nAs we move forward, a new question presents itself: should we leave them in peace, or help them reach the stars? Both choices carry their own risks, and their own rewards.

entries.zh: 我们提升[From.Capital.GetName]使其登上星海舞台的工作取得了巨大的成功。在一个新近统一的政府的领导下，我们的亲族将被称为“[From.GetName]”。\n\n在接下来的几个月和几年里，他们肯定要经历很多挑战。为了帮助它们在一个飘渺不定的星系中正确地前行，我们同意接纳他们作为附庸，至少目前是如此。与之相应地，我们已经交出了对该恒星系的完全控制权，并拆除了我们的观测站。
entries.en: Our work to uplift [From.Capital.GetName] to the galactic stage has been a resounding success. Under a newly unified government, our kin will be known as the "[From.GetName]."\n\nIn the months and years ahead, they are sure to experience many challenges. In order to help them navigate an uncertain galaxy, we have agreed to accept them as vassals, at least for the time being. Accordingly, we have ceded full control of the system and dismantled our Observation Post.

entries.zh: 我们的旧主人毫不重视我们的天赋，对我们的智慧大加贬低。现在，我们中间最活跃的头脑已经可以随心所欲地追求自己的雄心。
entries.en: Our former masters ignored our gifts and downplayed our intelligence. Now, the keenest minds among us are free to follow their ambition.

entries.zh: 作为契约奴隶，他们将工作刻到了自己的骨子里。现在，随着自由的到来，他们有了新的奋斗目标，这是任何奴隶都无法企及的干劲。
entries.en: As assets they were worked to the bone. With freedom has come renewed purpose, and a vigor that no slave could ever hope to match.

entries.zh: 在旧主人的舰船上，这些作为契约奴隶的工程师经常被指派去做最卑贱、最危险的工作。正是这样的经历磨砺了他们的技能。
entries.en: Aboard their masters' vessels, indentured engineers were often assigned the lowliest and most dangerous jobs. This hardship only sharpened their skills.

entries.zh: 固执、粗野、犟得要死，这些一度为契约奴隶的矿工如同废铁片一样坚硬。
entries.en: Stubborn, ill-mannered, indomitable; these former indentured miners are as solid as scrap metal.

entries.zh: 我们前奴隶主管制下的农业星球满是残酷压迫的场景。现在，我们的自耕农们可以自由地享受他们的劳动成果。
entries.en: The agri-worlds of our former masters were scenes of brutal oppression. Now, our homesteaders are free to enjoy the fruits of their labor.

entries.zh: 我们的传教士时刻提醒我们，自由是一项神圣的权利；在信仰上团结一致，我们就能找到共同的力量。
entries.en: Our preachers remind us that freedom is a divine right; united in faith, we find our common strength.

entries.zh: 契约士兵在过去曾经常被当作炮灰；少数幸运的幸存者自愿用生命来保护我们新近夺得的自由。
entries.en: Indentured soldiers were mainly used as cannon fodder; the fortunate few who survived have volunteered to protect our newfound freedom with their lives.

entries.zh: 我们的旧奴隶主将自己帝国每日行政管理的绝大部分都委派给了自己的契约奴隶。其结果就是造就了一批高度受训的后勤保障人员。
entries.en: Our former masters delegated much of their empire's day-to-day administration to indentured assets. The result was a class of highly trained logistics personnel.

entries.zh: 我们的旧奴隶主将自己帝国每日行政管理的绝大部分都委派给了自己的契约奴隶。其结果就是造就了一批高度受训的经理人。
entries.en: Our former masters delegated much of their empire's day-to-day administration to indentured assets. The result was a class of highly trained managers.

entries.zh: 徒手劳作的自耕农场，辛勤耕耘只为微薄的收成。
entries.en: Hardscrabble farmsteads tilling the soil for meager returns.

entries.zh: 小规模的精炼厂，能够充分利用从旧主的飞船上收集而来的废弃金属碎片。
entries.en: A small-scale refinery making use of scrap salvaged from our former masters' ship.

entries.zh: 一套简易搭建的太阳能电池板集合，与我们旧主飞船上的核聚变反应堆相连。
entries.en: A jerry-rigged assemblage of solar cells linked to the fusion reactor in our former masters' ship.

entries.zh: 旧奴隶主飞船上的舰桥，仓促地改造成了一处指挥中心。
entries.en: The bridge of our former masters' ship, hastily refashioned into a command center.

entries.zh: 曾经是工程舱的地方，多个学科的实验都在这里进行。
entries.en: Experiments in multiple disciplines take place in what was once an engineering bay.

entries.zh: 我们前主人飞船的特等客舱和生活舱室，现在被重新改造成为了办公室。
entries.en: The state cabins and living quarters of our former masters, repurposed into offices.

entries.zh: 虽然坠毁产生的碎片七零八落，散落得到处都是，但这艘船还是有相当一大部分保留了下来，搜刮它的零件或许能发现什么有价值得东西。
entries.en: While debris from the crash is scattered across a massive area, enough of the ship has survived that scavenging it for parts may be of value.

entries.zh: 坠毁的运奴船产生的残骸覆盖了一大片区域，阻碍了这颗行星的发展。
entries.en: The debris from the crashed slaver ship covers a massive area, blocking development of the planet.

entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$ §RThis blocker is removed by investigating the §Y$broken_shackles_digsite$§!.§!

entries.zh: 围绕着坠毁的运奴船的残骸，人们建造了公共纪念碑和博物馆。入口处的铭文写道“记忆是自由的摇篮”。
entries.en: A public memorial and museum constructed around the remains of the crashed slaver ship. The inscription over the entrance reads: "Memory is the cradle of freedom.

entries.zh: 我们会在坠毁的运奴船的残骸周围建造一个纪念碑，用于纪念在过去牺牲的先烈。
entries.en: We will commemorate the sacrifices of the past by constructing a memorial site around the remains of the crashed slaver ship.

entries.zh: §Y$d_crashed_slaver_ship$§!替换为§Y$d_crashed_slaver_ship_memorial$§!。\n部分§Y建筑§!和§Y区划§!将会转化为先进基础设施。
entries.en: §Y$d_crashed_slaver_ship$§! is replaced with §Y$d_crashed_slaver_ship_memorial$§!.\nSome §YBuildings§! and §YDistricts§! will be converted into advanced infrastructure.

entries.zh: 坠毁的奴隶船残骸应该被清除，为我们不断扩张的城市化让路。
entries.en: The wreckage of the crashed slaver ship should be removed to make way for our increasing urbanization.

entries.zh: §Y$district_crashed_slaver_ship_plural$§!将会转化为§Y$district_city_plural$§!。\n将移除§Y$d_crashed_slaver_ship$§!及所有的§Y$d_ship_debris_broken_shackles_blocker$§!。
entries.en: §Y$district_crashed_slaver_ship_plural$§! will be converted into §Y$district_city_plural$§!.\nThe §Y$d_crashed_slaver_ship$§! and any §Y$d_ship_debris_broken_shackles_blocker$§! will be removed.

entries.zh: 拾荒者会探索§Y$d_crashed_slaver_ship$§!的废墟，以期找到有价值的东西。
entries.en: Scavengers explore the ruins of the §Y$d_crashed_slaver_ship$§! for anything of value.

entries.zh: 一个世纪以前，在帝国的母星系，其中的一颗行星被一颗古怪的小行星摧毁了。一些人认为这是某个外星物种的恶意攻击。其他人则把这些担忧当作纯粹的妄想症。两类人之间的关系变得愈发紧张，最后无可奈何之下，帝国将一个新近完成地形改造的星球给予这些恐宇派。
entries.en: A century ago, one of the planets in this empire's home system was destroyed by a freak asteroid. Some believed this was a malicious attack by an alien species. Others brushed off these concerns as mere paranoia. The tension between the two groups grew so great that a newly-terraformed planet was granted to the fearmongers.

entries.zh: —$HOME_SYSTEM$曾属于你帝国一部分的分离主义者派系创造的['concept_preftl_civilizations', 前超光速文明]，提供专属事件和增益。
entries.en: - $HOME_SYSTEM$ ['concept_preftl_civilizations', Pre-FTL Civilization] created by a Separatist Faction, formerly part of your Empire, granting events and benefits

entries.zh: 一个世纪以前，被我们称为“大分裂者”的行星发生了爆炸。这便是我们
entries.en: A century ago, the planet we now call "The Divider" exploded. This was the beginning of our

entries.zh:
$START_SCREEN_FEAR_OF_THE_DARK_START$分裂的开端。

起先我们对这颗星球的毁灭不太在意，充其量只是一件怪事罢了，但[GetHomeWorldName]的一些人认为这其实是一场针对我们物种的有预谋的袭击。这些人认定是我们的无线电信号被远处的某些外星人发现了，他们便以这种足以毁灭行星的武器回应我们。这些反对者敦促我们做好应对这些外星人再次来袭甚至摧毁我们的准备。更多的人则认为他们的忧虑是杞人忧天。

两个派别之间的政治割裂日益加深。蔓延全球的内乱最终促成了一项协议，为这些反对者们寻找到一个环境改造候选星球，这样他们就可以在其中隐居，不受我们的干涉。$START_SCREEN_FEAR_OF_THE_DARK_END$
entries.en:
$START_SCREEN_FEAR_OF_THE_DARK_START$dissociation.

At first we brushed off the destruction as a freak occurrence, but there were some on [GetHomeWorldName] who believed it was a premeditated attack on our species. This faction hypothesized that our radio transmissions had been detected by some distant alien race, a race that replied with a planet-cracking projectile. These dissenters urged us to prepare for the day when the aliens would return to finish us off. Many dismissed their concerns as paranoia.

The political division between the two camps continued to grow. Planet-wide civil unrest culminated in the creation of a treaty that granted the dissidents a terraforming candidate, a planet upon which they would be free to reside in seclusion without any interference from us.$START_SCREEN_FEAR_OF_THE_DARK_END$

entries.zh:
$START_SCREEN_FEAR_OF_THE_DARK_START$互相疏远的开端。

在那场事故以后，忧心忡忡的经理们向董事会发来请求，希望能关停所有现存的行星间无线电通讯设施，取消太空探索计划。他们相信大分裂者一定是某种外来的力量在尝试摧毁[GetHomeWorldName]。这项请求当然被否决了。

这些经理们将董事会的决议称为“史诗级误判”，并激活了公民协议中的一项副条款，他们有权公开斥责董事会。为了安抚股东和增强消费者信心，决定向持异议的经理提供一份新合同。作为放弃与 [GetName] 有关的任何权利的交换，他们将获得一颗环境改造候选星球，并且保证他们的财政自主。$START_SCREEN_FEAR_OF_THE_DARK_END$
entries.en:
$START_SCREEN_FEAR_OF_THE_DARK_START$estrangement.

After the incident, worried managers sent requests to our Board of Directors to shut down existing extra-planetary radio infrastructure and cancel our space exploration programs. They believed the creation of The Divider was caused by an external agent attempting to destroy [GetHomeWorldName]. This request was denied.

Calling the Board's decision a "monumental lapse of judgment", these managers activated a sub-clause in their citizenship contracts that granted them the right to publicly rebuke the Board. In an effort to placate share-holders and to bolster consumer confidence, the decision was made to offer the dissenting managers a new contract. In exchange for giving up any rights pertaining to [GetName], they would be provided with a terraforming candidate, and a guarantee of fiscal independence.$START_SCREEN_FEAR_OF_THE_DARK_END$

entries.zh: \n\n随着超光速引擎的出现，一个新的紧张局势出现了：我们渴望拥抱宇宙，但我们的邻居却旗帜鲜明地反对。
entries.en: \n\nWith the advent of the Hyperdrive, a new source of tension has arisen: while we are eager to greet the galaxy, our neighbors stand resolutely in opposition.

entries.zh: 普通恒星系，包含一对双子行星。\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$
entries.en: A regular star system with a pair of Binary Planets.\n\n$system_initializer_DESC$

entries.zh: 一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。\n\n[fotd_Leader.GetName]是[fotd_Leader.GetSpecialization]专家，和[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的任何[Root.GetSpeciesName]享受同等权利。
entries.en: A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].\n\n[fotd_Leader.GetName] is [fotd_Leader.GetSpecialization] specialist, equal to any [Root.GetSpeciesName] on [Root.GetHomeWorldName].

entries.zh: 一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。\n\n我们的首席科学家同[fotd_Leader.GetName]保持了多年的联系，对[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]所作的工作赞不绝口。
entries.en: A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].\n\nOur lead scientists have been in communication with [fotd_Leader.GetName] for many years and are extremely impressed by [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] work.

entries.zh: 一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。\n\n尽管[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]被[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]在[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的同事称为[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]上最后一位偏执狂科学家，但这样的论述并不够全面。
entries.en: A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].\n\nAlthough [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] has been described as the least paranoid scientist on [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] by [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] colleagues on [owner.GetHomeWorldName], this isn't really saying much.

entries.zh: 一名来自[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]的科学家要求加入我们[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]。\n\n[fotd_Leader.GetName]视自己为一名殉道者。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]前来我们“厄运笼罩的星球”，希望拯救我们的科技免受外部势力的摧毁。
entries.en: A scientist from [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] has requested to join us on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName].\n\n[fotd_Leader.GetName] styles themselves something of a martyr. In traveling to our "doomed world" [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] hope to preserve our technology from destruction by outside forces.

entries.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]向我们求助，因为[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]上条件受限的设施阻碍了[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]的研究。我们的科学家已经做了担保，保证这位潜在访客的一切行为都是良好的。
entries.en: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] reached out to us because the limited facilities on [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName] are stunting [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] research. Our scientists have vouched for our potential visitor's good behavior.

entries.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap]的研究已经被[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]的政府定性为危险。他们的损失，是我们的收获。
entries.en: [fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap] research has been classified as dangerous by [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] government. Their loss is our gain.

entries.zh: 出于在学术上的杰出表现，[fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]将获得[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的一个著名奖项。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]也同意在我们这里待上一段时间，就自己的研究举行一系列讲座。
entries.en: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] will be the recipient of a prestigious award on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] for academic excellence. [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] have also agreed to stay with us for a while, holding a series of lectures about their research.

entries.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]会研究当地的[GetStudyTopic]，并试图利用这些来改善[fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName]上的生活。
entries.en: [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] will be studying local [GetStudyTopic] in an attempt to improve life on [fotd_habitants.capital_scope.GetName].

entries.zh: 只要你遵守这个社会的规范 ，那么你就会受到欢迎。
entries.en: You are welcome as long as you abide by the norms of this society.

entries.zh: 将§Y[fotd_Leader.GetName]§!作为§H科学官§!添加到我们的§H$RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$§!。
一位来自[fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName]的指挥官提出要加入我们的海军，担任临时指挥官。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap]的动机尚不清楚，但我们的线人告诉我们，这可能牵涉到一起丑闻。
entries.en: A Commander from [fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName] is offering to join our navy as a temporary commander. [fotd_Leader.GetSheHeCap] motivations are unclear, but our informants tell us that there might be a scandal involved.

entries.zh: [fotd_Leader.GetName]非常急迫地想和我们签署临时合同。[fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName]一直是滋生狡猾和非常规战术的温床。
entries.en: [fotd_Leader.GetName] is eager to sign on with us temporarily. [fotd_habitants.Capital.GetName] has always been a breeding ground for crafty and unconventional tactics.

entries.zh: 由于指挥官[fotd_Leader.GetName]在最近一次联合舰队演习上的出色表现，我们决定扩大此人的权限，让其指挥一支真正的海军舰队。
entries.en: After excelling in a recent joint fleet exercise, we have extended Commander [fotd_Leader.GetName] the opportunity to take command in a real navy.

entries.zh: 因涉嫌将[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]指挥的舰船置于过度危险之中而被暂时调离岗位，不服气的指挥官[fotd_Leader.GetName]请求加入我们的海军。尽管[fotd_Leader.GetName]名声在外，那些曾与[fotd_Leader.GetHerHim]一起服役的人仍然尊重[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]的才能。
entries.en: Placed on temporary leave for allegedly putting the vessels under [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] command in excessive danger, Commander [fotd_Leader.GetName] has requested to join our navy. Despite [fotd_Leader.GetName]'s reputation, those who have served with [fotd_Leader.GetHerHim] still respect [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] talent.
As long as you don't go rogue.

entries.zh: 将§Y[fotd_Leader.GetName]§!作为§H指挥官§!添加到我们的§H$RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$§!。
对于一根松动的鱼雷管来说，你也太胖了！
entries.en: You are too much of a loose torpedo tube!

entries.zh: 在同我们一起生活了许多年之后，[fotd_Leader.GetName]决定返回家乡。一些政府官员反对这一变动，因为[fotd_Leader.GetName]已经成为我们高级领导层不可或缺的一部分。\n\n[GetfotdCoercion]
entries.en: After long years living among us, [fotd_Leader.GetName] has decided to return home. Some in government are opposed to the move, as [fotd_Leader.GetName] has become an integral part of our senior leadership.\n\n[GetfotdCoercion]

entries.zh: 我们必须不惜一切代价留住他们。
entries.en: We need to keep them at any cost.

entries.zh: 最近，[fotd_Leader.GetName]的性格变得越来越孤僻。[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]再次请求允许他回家。[fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap]的同事指出，[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]由于患上了抑郁症一直对他们的工作产生了负面影响，并建议我们批准[fotd_Leader.GetHerHis]离开。
entries.en: Recently, [fotd_Leader.GetName] has grown increasingly withdrawn. Once again, [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] is requesting permission to return home. [fotd_Leader.GetHerHisCap] coworkers note that [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] depression has been affecting their work, and suggest we let [fotd_Leader.GetHerHis] go.

entries.zh: 在过去的几个周期里，人们看到[fotd_Leader.GetName]在喃喃自语，有时在大厅里踱步。今天，[fotd_Leader.GetSheHe]没有来上班。我们的一架逃生飞船也报告失踪。这些事件不太可能是一个巧合。
entries.en: Over the last several cycles, [fotd_Leader.GetName] has been seen muttering to themselves and pacing the halls. Today, [fotd_Leader.GetSheHe] failed to arrive at work. One of our escape shuttles has also been reported missing. It's unlikely these events are a coincidence.

entries.zh: 似乎我们兄弟星球上的科学家已经在[root.fotdGetTech]领域取得了数个全新的、公认的、有见地的突破。尽管他们可以说是目光狭隘，但在这种情况下有一说一，他们的技术已经超过了我们自己取得的成就。\n\n他们愿意与我们分享他们的见解，以换取我们[root.fotdGetTechPrice]——可以肯定的是，这个价格不菲。
entries.en: It seems that the scientists on our partner planet have made several new, and admittedly insightful, breakthroughs into the field of [root.fotdGetTech]. Despite their parochial tendencies, it's fair to say that in this case their technology has outstripped our own achievements.\n\nThey are willing to share their insights with us in exchange for us [root.fotdGetTechPrice] - a steep price, to be sure.

entries.zh: 这会让我们§R10年§!内无法进入§Y虚境§!。
entries.en: This will prevent us from accessing §YThe Shroud§! for §R10 years§!.

entries.zh: 他们疯了吗？我们绝无可能同意这个。
entries.en: Are they mad? We would never agree to this.

entries.zh: 无论是出于工作疏忽、工作人员的无能，还是纯粹的不幸，§Y[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]§!现在深陷[root.GetSeperatistAid]供应危机。如果没有帮助，很可能数百万人将受灾。
entries.en: Whether due to negligence, incompetence, or sheer misfortune §Y[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]§! now struggle with their [root.GetSeperatistAid] supply. Without help it is very likely that millions will suffer.

entries.zh: 那我们又能得到什么回报呢？
entries.en: What do we get in return?

entries.zh: 如果他们需要帮助，他们应该重新加入我们。
entries.en: If they want aid they should rejoin us.

entries.zh: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]似乎从周边某个地方收到了经济援助。现在他们已经准备好防范[root.GetFotDAid]危机中可能出现的最坏的影响了。
entries.en: Economic aid seems to have come from a nearby source. [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] is ready to stem the worst effects of our current [root.GetFotDAid] crisis.

entries.zh: $origin.6025.desc.base$\n\n由于我们先前的支援，他们决定偿还我们的人情，不求回报地向我们提供帮助。
entries.en: $origin.6025.desc.base$\n\nDue to our previous support, they have decided to repay the favor, offering us help free of charge.

entries.zh: $origin.6025.desc.base$\n\n一位沾沾自喜的信使告知我们他们提供帮助的报价是[root.fotdGetTechPrice]。我们有得选吗？
entries.en: $origin.6025.desc.base$\n\nA smug message informed us that the price for their help would be [root.fotdGetTechPrice]. Do we have a choice?

entries.zh: 我们应该独立挺过难关。

虽然确认外星人存在的消息对[Root.GetHomeWorldName]来说并非意料之外，但在[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]上情况就要糟糕得多。他们本来抱着微不足道的希望生活，祈愿大分裂者的毁灭只是一个古怪的事故，但现在他们确信，宇宙是要来对付他们。\n\n“我们需要在这些外星人来这里完成工作之前消灭他们！”这正是[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]媒体上正在播放的那种疯狂的呼喊。
entries.en: While the news confirming existence of aliens was not entirely unexpected for [Root.GetHomeWorldName], it was felt worse on [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. They were living with the minuscule hope that perhaps the Divider's destruction was just a freak accident, but now they are convinced that the universe is out to get them.\n\n"We need to destroy these Aliens before they can come here and finish the job!" is the type of frantic cry being broadcast on [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] media.

entries.zh: 我们生活的星系就是如此。他们很快就会适应的。
entries.en: That's the galaxy we live in. They will adapt soon enough.

entries.zh: 这是无稽之谈，屏蔽他们的传输信号。
entries.en: This is nonsense. Block their transmissions.

entries.zh: 发现外星智能生命的消息已经传到[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]。然而，出乎我们的预期，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]并没有传来恐惧和愤怒的情感，当地反而陷入了沉默。多艘恒星际飞船重新回到了自己的船坞，还有数个旧的超光速驱动器从仓库中挪出。看来他们正准备进行一次远行。
entries.en: News of the discovery of intelligent alien life has reached [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. However, instead of the fear and outrage that we expected to from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName], they have instead gone silent. Multiple inter-system ships have returned to their dockyards, and several old FTL drives are missing from storage. It appears they are preparing for an excursion.

entries.zh: 我们需要知道正在发生的情况。
entries.en: We need to know what's going on.

entries.zh: 进行安管巡查，以应对任何可能的情报泄露。
entries.en: Secure our investigation against any possible leaks.

entries.zh: 在我们与[From.GetName]初步展开沟通后，我们收到了一些令人不安的消息：一支由过时的[Root.GetAdj]飞船组成的攻击舰队已经进入[From.GetSpeciesAdj]的宇域，现在正向他们的恒星基地加速前进。这些战舰以这样的加速度前进，想必舰船内部任何[owner_species.GetBiologicalLithoidLower]现在已经变成了[owner_species.GetLiquidState]状态。
entries.en: After our initial communication with the [From.GetName], we received some troubling news: an attack fleet of outdated [Root.GetAdj] ships has entered [From.GetSpeciesAdj] space, and is now speeding towards their starbase. The accelerating ships are moving at such a rate that anything [owner_species.GetBiologicalLithoidLower] inside them must have been reduced to a [owner_species.GetLiquidState] state by now.

entries.zh: $origin.6045.desc.base$\n\n幸运的是，我们做好了充分的准备。在观察到[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的异常行为后，我们随时都可以在太空中将他们打下来，不让他们击中空间站。
entries.en: $origin.6045.desc.base$\n\nFortunately, we are prepared. Having observed the odd behavior of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] we stand ready to shoot them out of space before they can hit the station.

entries.zh: $origin.6045.desc.base$\n\n我们没有办法阻止这场灾难。这些超规格的导弹将彻底摧毁[target_system.GetName]的恒星基地。我们只能惊恐地看着。除非……
entries.en: $origin.6045.desc.base$\n\nThere is nothing we can do to stop this disaster. These oversized missiles will completely demolish the starbase in [target_system.GetName]. We can only look on in horror. Unless...

entries.zh: 让他们削弱这些外星人，然后把锅扣在[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]上。
entries.en: Let them weaken these aliens, then reprimand [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们的邻国很虚弱。趁着这个机会结果他们！
entries.en: Our neighbors are weak. Use this opportunity to end them!

entries.zh: $origin.6045.starbase_destroyed.tt$\n[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]将会失去§Y5§!艘位于§Y[target_system.GetName]§!星系的护卫舰的控制权。\n将会同§Y[From.GetName]§!进入§R全面战争§!状态。
entries.en: $origin.6045.starbase_destroyed.tt$\n[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] will cede control of §Y5§! corvettes in §Y[target_system.GetName]§!.\nWill enter a §RTotal War§! with §Y[From.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 我们位于§Y[target_system.GetName]§!的恒星基地被一帮子所谓的[From.GetName]“叛逃分子”给摧毁了。我们已经收到了道歉，对方承诺不会再发生这种情况。但谁知道呢？今天是[target_system.GetName]，也许明天就是[capital_star.GetName]。
entries.en: Our starbase in §Y[target_system.GetName]§! has been destroyed by so-called "rogue agents", the [From.GetName]! We have already received an apology and a promise that this will not happen again. But who knows? First it was [target_system.GetName], and perhaps [capital_star.GetName] is next.

entries.zh: 他们威胁到了我们的存续。不是他们死就是我们亡！
entries.en: They threaten our very existence. It's them or us!

entries.zh: 在与[From.GetName]第一次接触后不久，我们在§Y[target_system.GetName]§!的恒星基地就被爆炸摧毁。在系统掉线之前，我们接收到了图像，那是一支采用[From.GetAdj]设计的敌方舰队。\n\n我们现在发现自己卷入了一场事关生死存亡的战争之中。
entries.en: Shortly after first contact with the [From.GetName], our starbase in §Y[target_system.GetName]§! exploded. Before the system went dark, we received images of a hostile armada of [From.GetAdj] design.\n\nWe now find ourselves engaged in a war for our very survival.

entries.zh: 虽然我们尽了全力设法将他们蒙在鼓里，但没过多久，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]就听说我们成为了[owner.federation.GetName]的成员国一事。这种亲外主义的证据引起了我们伙伴世星球的一些极端反响。一夜之间，许多对我们联邦其他成员国的贬义词和标签涌现出来。
entries.en: While we did our best to keep them in the dark, it did not take long for [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] to hear about our membership in the [owner.federation.GetName]. This evidence of xenophilia has elicited some extreme reactions from our partner world. Derogatory terms and labels for our federation members have sprung up overnight.

entries.zh: $origin.6055.desc.base$\n\n公众的愤怒甚至影响到了我们兄弟星球的学术界，他们现在已经结束了我们两颗星球之间的所有合作项目。只能希望我们的新联邦盟友能够理解这一切。
entries.en: $origin.6055.desc.base$\n\nThe public outrage has even reached the academies of our partner world which have now ended all cooperative projects between our worlds. It is to be hoped that our new federation allies will understand.

entries.zh: $origin.6055.desc.base$\n\n[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]已经因为我们先前的外交行动被激怒，而这一次则让他们彻底翻了脸。在我们切断他们的联系之前，他们设法向我们的盟友发送了几条五颜六色的信息，损害了我们之间的关系，其影响也许是永久性的。
entries.en: $origin.6055.desc.base$\n\n[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] was already agitated after our previous diplomatic actions, and this seems to have tipped them over the edge. Before we could cut them off, they managed to send several colorful messages to our allies, damaging our relations, perhaps permanently.

entries.zh: 我们的盟友会把这个视作无意义的闹剧。肯定的。
entries.en: Our allies will see this for the nonsense it is. Surely.

entries.zh: 自[FromFrom.solar_system.GetName]恒星系传来的消息深深震撼了我们的母星。如果像这样的怪物都能够存在，那么在太空深处还可能潜伏着什么样的威胁？在我们的人民中，要求移民到[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的申请已经飙升。然而此时此刻，我们很难责怪他们。
entries.en: The news from the [FromFrom.solar_system.GetName] system has shaken our homeworld deeply. What other threats may be lurking in the depths of space, if monsters like this can exist? Already, applications for immigration to [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have soared amongst our people. At the moment, it is difficult to blame them.

entries.zh: 不！[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]才是错误的！我们必须一起面对这个。
entries.en: No! [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] is wrong! We will face this together.

entries.zh:
当我们向[overlord.GetName]臣服后，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]立马就来讥讽我们。

“任何外星生命本质上都是有敌意的。如果你们当初就留在[home_planet.GetStarName]上，这一切都不会发生！”

不用说，我们的内部人民现在还不是特别团结。
entries.en:
After our submission to the [overlord.GetName], [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] did not waste any time ridiculing us.

"Alien life is inherently hostile. If you all had simply stayed in [home_planet.GetStarName], none of this would have happened!"

Needless to say, our people are not particularly unified right now.

entries.zh: 在收取了一个附庸之后，我们的帝国朝着一个宇宙强权又迈进了一步。然而，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]却不以为然。根据他们的说法，我们只是成功地将外星人的威胁拉近了。为了表示抗议，他们已经停止了与我们的所有研究合作。\n\n假以时日，我们一定会证明他们是错的。
entries.en: In taking a vassal, our empire made a major leap forward as a galactic power. However, [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] is not impressed. According to them, we have only succeeded in bringing the alien threat closer. In protest, they have ceased all research cooperation with us.\n\nIn time, we will certainly prove them wrong.

entries.zh: 我们的属民肯定没有在密谋针对我们！
entries.en: Our subject surely isn't plotting against us!

entries.zh: 在[FromFrom.GetName]的黎明，我们获得了一个意想不到的盟友：来自[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的同志们终于在一个外交问题上与我们达成一致，恳请我们将外星人扫除掉。令人遗憾的是，一旦战争结束，这样的合作就要告一段落了。
entries.en: At the dawn of the [FromFrom.GetName] we have gained an unexpected ally: our comrades from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have finally aligned themselves with us on a diplomatic issue, imploring us to wipe the xenos out. It's a shame that once the war is over their co-operation will end.

entries.zh: 指派人手前往我们的舰船。
他们观测到什么和敌人有关的吗？
entries.en: Have they observed anything about the enemy?

entries.zh: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的住民曾经预言的那一天如今已经到来：随着敌国对我们宣战，星系已经成为一处荒凉、充满敌意的境地。然而，这个故事尚未到结局。我们将挺过这一关。
entries.en: The day the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] predicted has arrived: with war declared against us, the galaxy has become an inhospitable and hostile realm. However, this story's ending is not yet written. We will survive this.

entries.zh: 我们的人民对于这种通过人为手段提升思想水平的经历还很陌生，因此当听说[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们对我们的新升级持有如此激烈的反对意见之后，普遍感到惊讶。这些人警告说，如果我们再“玷污”自己的身体，所有先前的合作努力都将视作无效。
entries.en: Still new to this artificially elevated level of thought, our people were surprised to receive such vehement opposition to our new upgrades from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. They warn that if we "defile" our bodies any further, all collaborative efforts will be canceled.

entries.zh: 对于在这个星系中存活需要付出怎样的代价，他们的理解太肤浅太单纯了。
entries.en: They are too simple to understand what it takes to survive in this galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们决定彻底地转换到合成体的生命形式，作为结果，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们充分履行了当初的承诺：每条通信途径、每个合作研究站和所有形式的媒体现在都被封锁了。\n\n考虑到我们现在已经发展到了如此地步，问题的关键在于，我们是否还需要他们。
entries.en: As a result of our decision to transition to a fully cybernetic form of life, the people of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have made good on their promise: every avenue of communication, every collaborative research station, and all forms of media are now blocked.\n\nThe question is whether or not we still need them, now that we are so much more.

entries.zh: 让他们在黑暗中颤抖吧。
entries.en: Let them cower in the dark.

entries.zh: 第一批合成躯体正从工厂车间滚滚落下，并由其未来的寄居者进行视察。然而，并非每个[Species.GetName]都对这一非凡的发展感到兴奋。[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民已经警告我们，如果我们继续在这条歧路上行进，所有先前的合作努力都将视作无效。
entries.en: The first synthetic bodies are rolling off the factory floor and are being inspected by their future inhabitants. However, not every [Species.GetName] is excited about this remarkable development. The inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have warned us that they will cancel all collaborative efforts if we continue down this route.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的每一名成员都接受了他们新的、机械合成体的形态。然而，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们则选择留在他们的[fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy]凡胎肉体之中。此外，他们已经兑现了先前的威胁，结束了与我们的所有合作关系。
entries.en: Every member of the [Root.GetName] has embraced their new, synthetic forms. However, the population of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] has chosen to stay in their [fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy] vessels. Furthermore, they have made good on their threat to end all collaborative efforts with us.
Unable to see past their [fotd_seperatist_planet.Owner.Species.GetFleshy] Prisons.

entries.zh: 没有必要等待不可避免的[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]评判了。我们已经充分意识到了他们愤怒的想法。在所有的不和谐之音中，想要停止一切合作关系的声音尤其突出。
entries.en: There is no need to wait for the inevitable judgment of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] We are fully aware of their agitated thoughts. Amidst the cacophony, their intention to cease all collaboration is crystal clear.

entries.zh: 我们终于同§H虚境§!内的某个大型实体建立了联系。再一次，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName][GetLamentations]侵扰到了我们；他们正在从我们的网络中断开自己的连接，取消了所有的联合研究行动。
entries.en: At last we have secured access to one of the grand entities of the §HShroud§!. Once again, the [GetLamentations] of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] intrude on us; they are disconnecting themselves from our networks, cancelling every joint research operation.

entries.zh: 只有我们才明白这样的行为实际上有多么无足轻重。有一种更开明的伙伴关系即将诞生。
entries.en: Only we understand how inconsequential such actions truly are. The birth of a more enlightened partnership is at hand.

entries.zh: 这种没有逻辑的行为无足轻重。我们自己的处理能力已经远超他们原始的理解力。
entries.en: Such illogical actions are inconsequential. Our own processing power has ascended beyond their primitive comprehension.

entries.zh: 这种个人主义反常不值得我们关注，无法理解我们开明思想的人在我们中也没有立足之地。
entries.en: Such individualist deviancy is beneath our concern, those who cannot comprehend our enlightened thoughts have no place among us.

entries.zh: 我们的飞升是大势所趋。
自从我们成功地改造了自己的给养来源，[Root.GetSpeciesName]就幻想着基因强化的无限可能性。现在这一天已经到来。缺陷、弱点、不完美——这些都将成为被抛弃的历史遗留物。\n\n唯一持反对意见的是[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民。他们称这种改造是一次堕落，将不可避免地导致一个由基因完善者统治的阶级主义社会。
entries.en: Ever since we successfully modified our source of sustenance, [Root.GetSpeciesName] have fantasized about the limitless possibilities of genetic enhancement. Now the day has come. Defects, weaknesses, imperfections - these are all remnants of a discarded past.\n\nThe only naysayers are the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. They have called such modification a slippery slope, one that will inevitably lead to a classist society ruled by the genetically perfected.

entries.zh: 允许这些瑕疵继续存在是不负责任的。
entries.en: Allowing these flaws to persist would be irresponsible.

entries.zh: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]拒绝一切形式的通讯。当我们破解了如何将外星基因拼接到我们身体构成中这一秘密以后，他们留给我们的只有一条信息：“你已经放弃了作为[fotd_seperatist_planet.owner.GetSpecesName]的意义”。
entries.en: [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] refuses all communication. Once we cracked the secret of splicing alien genetics into our physical makeup, they left us with a single message: "You have abandoned what it means to be [fotd_seperatist_planet.owner.GetSpecesName]"

entries.zh: 将思维狭隘的人抛到身后。
当整个宇宙面临威胁时，即使是我们隐居的邻国也必须站出来采取行动。只要我们能够抵抗即将到来的风暴，我们将会再次成为同一个民族。\n\n我们已被授予[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]舰队的指挥权。
entries.en: When the galaxy is threatened even our reclusive neighbors must act. As long as we can resist the coming storm we will be one people again.\n\nWe have been granted command of the [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] fleet.
We refuse to be snuffed out.

entries.zh: 我们的兄弟行星要求我们对他们的一些发现进行确认。他们再次声称有证据表明，§Y大分裂者§!实际上是被某个满怀恶意的外星实体给摧毁的。这已经变得令人厌烦了；每隔几年，他们似乎都会发现一些新的“证据”。
entries.en: Our partner planet has requested that we confirm some of their findings. Once again, they claim to have evidence that §YThe Divider§! was destroyed by a malicious foreign entity. This has become tiresome; every few years it seems they discover some new "proof".

entries.zh:
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]是对的！

我们多年前所遭受的攻击确实是一个能发射大型钨制弹丸的邪恶实体所为。由于母星系独特的重力场我们才得以幸存。通过分析那个关键夜晚的数据并与这些新的发现进行交叉研究，我们可以定位出这颗小行星大小的钨弹的来源位置。

它来自一个我们在数十年前就已经登记过的格外富矿（但除此之外也没有别的特点）的星系。
entries.en:
[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] were right!

The attack we suffered all those years ago was perpetrated by a malicious entity capable of launching massive tungsten projectiles. Only the unique gravitational features of our home system allowed us to survive. By analyzing the data from that fateful night and cross-referencing it with these new findings, it was possible for us to triangulate the source of the asteroid-sized tungsten round.

It originated from an incredibly mineral-rich (yet otherwise unremarkable) system we have had in our logs for decades.

entries.zh: 给我们的超空间驱动器充能。

曾经侵略过我们的势力所在的恒星系现在是一片不毛之地。虽然一个小行星带缺乏矿物并不罕见，但这个小行星带可以说是已经被剥光了。不仅如此，在应该有富含稀有金属的小行星的地方，我们只发现了灰尘。不管居住在这个恒星系的物种是如何获取他们用于制造子弹的钨的，他们现在已经没有这样的资源了。他们似乎甚至没有能力离开他们的行星。\n\n虽然他们已经尽力保持隐蔽，阻断了所有的无线电信号，甚至限制使用人工照明，但我们还是在该恒星系唯一的宜居行星上探测到了生命。
entries.en: The system of our old aggressors is barren. While it isn't unusual for an asteroid belt to be mineral-poor, this one has been stripped bare. Not only that, but where there should be minor planetoids rich in rare metals, we have found only dust. However the species inhabiting this system managed to gain the tungsten necessary to construct their bullets, they no longer have the resources to do so now. They don't even seem to be capable of leaving their planet.\n\nWhile they have done their best to remain hidden, preventing all radio signals and even limiting the use of artificial lights, we have detected life on the system's lone habitable planet.

entries.zh: 让我们好好拜访一下旧日的梦魇。
entries.en: Let's pay our old nightmares a visit.

entries.zh: 观察§Y菲沃尔人§!的经历对于我们来说相当有启发性。事实上，他们的意识形态与导致我们自己物种分裂的意识形态非常相似。然而，菲沃尔人没有选择自我隔离，而是选择了对他们能够探测到的任何生命迹象进行先制打击的策略。一旦他们耗尽了重金属，这些外星人就只能回到他们的星球，从他们现在贫瘠的家园中拾掇一切来勉强维持生计。虽然我们伙伴星球的领导层正在敦促我们采取与菲沃尔人相同的策略，但如何最好地对付我们的潜在灭绝者，这事并没有我们原以为的那么简单。
entries.en: Observing the §YFevorians§! has been a revelatory experience. In fact, their ideology is remarkably similar to that which produced the split in our own species. However, rather than choosing isolation, the Fevorians opted for a strategy of pre-emptive strikes against any life signs they could detect. Once they ran out of heavy metals, the aliens returned to their world, scraping whatever bare subsistence they could from their now barren home. While the leadership of our partner planet is urging us to adopt the same tactics as the Fevorians, how best to deal with our would-be exterminators is no easy question.

entries.zh: 宇宙中只剩下我们才是安全的。
entries.en: We will only be safe when we are alone.

entries.zh: 我们会加入我们的兄弟行星，为确保星系的安全将其他生命全部抹除。就从这块石头开始。
entries.en: We will join our partner planet in securing this galaxy by expunging all other life. Starting with this rock here.

entries.zh: 我们会向他们表示同情。
衷心希望，他们能够从我们身上学会，不是所有的外星人都要杀个干净。
entries.en: Hopefully, they can learn from us that not all alien life is out to kill them.

entries.zh: 毁灭菲沃尔人竟是……这么容易？又少了一个威胁到我们生存的猎人。我们已经很久没有感觉到与我们的伙伴星球如此同步了。也许他们是对的。这里只有两种类型的生命：静默的和死亡的。
entries.en: Destroying the Fevorians was... easy? One fewer hunter, threatening our existence. We have not felt this in sync with our partner world for a long time. Perhaps they were right. There are only two types of life out here: the silent and the dead.

entries.zh: 我们应当将他们全部静默。
不，我们不会成为侵略者。
entries.en: No, we will not be the aggressors.

entries.zh: §Y菲沃尔卫星§!比我们最初预期的要更重要。整个星系里仅存的重金属原来全部都在这颗卫星内，进一步研究发现这颗卫星其实是一座巨型的质量投射器。错综复杂的投射机构往返盘绕着整颗小行星。粗略计算表明，这个武器可以将在和发射至高亚光速。\n\n最后次发射的数据仍停留在其火控计算机中，目标就是[Root.GetHomeWorldName]。
entries.en: The §YFevorian Moon§! was more important than we first anticipated. The only heavy metals left in the system are found within the moon, which upon closer examination was revealed to be a titanic mass driver. The sprawling launch mechanism encircles the planetoid multiple times. Rough calculations indicate that the weapon could launch payloads approaching the speed of light.\n\nThe data for the final shot is still in its targeting computer, aimed at [Root.GetHomeWorldName].

entries.zh: §Y菲沃尔人§!赢了。我们的人口九死一生，家园支离破碎。\n\n直到这颗行星的最后一刻，跨大气层运输船还在将[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不断运往轨道。而来不及离开的人则在高亚光速炮弹击中的瞬间被产生的高温瞬间化为灰烬。[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]愿意接纳我们的政府并安置难民。
entries.en: The §YFevorians§! have won. Our people are decimated, and our home world desecrated.\n\nInter-atmosphere ships were ferrying [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] into orbit until the planet's final moments. Those who remained on the surface were incinerated the instant the near-lightspeed projectile ignited the atmosphere. [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] has offered to host our government and house the evacuees.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]已经恢复安全了。我们已经成功将钨弹偏转到了足够远的地方，以确保我们自己能够存活下来。尽管经过其漫长的旅途之后，它很可能成为另一个行星的问题。
entries.en: [Target.GetName] is safe. We have managed to divert the tungsten projectile far enough to ensure our own survival, though over the course of its long journey, it may very well become another planet's problem.

entries.zh: 我们的科学家孜孜不倦地针对“§Y菲沃尔问题§!”进行攻关，目前已经提出了四种截然不同的解决方案。如果我们迅速应对，他们相信我们有相当的机会对这个恐怖事物进行偏转。
entries.en: Our scientists have been working tirelessly on the "§YFevorian Problem§!" and have come up with four distinct solutions. If we act quickly, they believe we have a fair chance to deflect this terror.

entries.zh: 由于[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]组织的抗议活动在[From.GetAdj]大使馆的正门前发生了骚乱，本应是对多样性和友谊进行庆祝的庆典活动，最后却在酸楚中结束。抗议者并不羞于表达自己的观点，他们喊出了“[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]滚回垃圾站！”这样丰富多彩的口号。\n\n毫不意外的是，这次事件俨然成为了两国之间外交关系紧张的导火索。
entries.en: What should have been a celebration of diversity and friendship ended on a sour note as a protest organized by [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] broke out in front of the [From.GetAdj] embassy. The protestors were not shy about their views, shouting such colorful slogans as "[From.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] belong in the recycling plant!"\n\nUnsurprisingly, this has increased diplomatic tensions between our empires.

entries.zh:
[FromFrom.GetName]战争将会被永远铭记，在这一刻我们与[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]并肩作战，携手抗击外来威胁。

面对这一最新的威胁，我们本以为会从[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的人们那收到嘲笑的信息。但他们的回复却是这样的：

“有哪里需要帮助吗？”
entries.en:
[FromFrom.GetName] war will forever be remembered as the moment that we and [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] stood together, unified against an existential threat.

Confronted by this latest terror, we expected another dismissive message from the people of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]. Instead, they responded with five words: 

"Where do you need us?"

entries.zh: 我们需要建造更多的舰船！
entries.en: We need to build more ships!

entries.zh: 我们的舰队需要更多的军官！
entries.en: We need more officers in our fleets!

entries.zh: 把我们敌人的所有一切都告诉我们。
entries.en: Tell us everything about our enemy.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不适应[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]上的条件。但得益于细致的环境改造，严苛的环境终将成为历史。\n\n尽管[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]还残留着一些更加困难的环境，但这颗星球的居住者们已经让[From.Target.GetClassAdj]环境彻底成了历史。
entries.en: Conditions on [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have always been inhospitable to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. But thanks to diligent terraforming, extreme hardship will become a thing of the past.\n\nWhile [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] remains a somewhat challenging environment, the inhabitants of the world have left their [From.Target.GetClassAdj] past behind.

entries.zh: 希望他们喜欢这些改变。
他们完成了。\n\n我们有些人之前说，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民简直是疯了才会在那种鬼地方定居。而如今，他们已经将那里改造成了第二个[home_planet.GetName]，吸引着每一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]。
entries.en: They have done it.\n\nSome of our people called the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] mad for settling a world with such horrendous conditions. Yet, now they have fashioned a more than adequate facsimile of [home_planet.GetName], attractive to any [Root.GetSpeciesName].

entries.zh: 似乎我们的星球已经不是唯一在[from.Target.GetStarName]有吸引力的地方了。
entries.en: It seems ours is not the only attractive world in [from.Target.GetStarName] anymore.

entries.zh: 也许是受我们自己在环境改造方面所取得成功的启发，[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的居民已经将他们的星球塑造成了一件真正的美丽之物。之前就很丰饶的[From.Target.GetClassName]现在已经成为一个盖亚星球。居民们可以继续在天堂里躲避宇宙的威胁。
entries.en: Perhaps inspired by our own successes in terraforming, the inhabitants of [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] have sculpted their world into a thing of true beauty. The previously bountiful [From.Target.GetClassName] has become a Gaia World. The inhabitants can continue to hide from the galaxy in paradise.

entries.zh: 来自[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]的消息令人惭愧：当地居民已经突破了[home_planet.GetName]的发展界限。他们摒弃了[From.GetClassName]的形态，成功打造出一颗盖亚星球。面对近在咫尺的理想家园，我们的民众开始质疑：为何还要继续留在这里生活？
entries.en: Humiliating news from [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]: the inhabitants have managed to transcend the limits of [home_planet.GetName]. By discarding the form of a [From.GetClassName], they have created a Gaia World. Many of our own people question why they should continue to live here, when a paradise exists on their doorstep.

entries.zh: 想要改善自己的家园，这是非常自然的想法。
entries.en: It's only natural to want to improve one's home.
