entries.zh: 最近的报告称[fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName]已经部署了一支巡逻舰队，用以保卫[capital_star.GetName]。他们好像已经发展出了隐形科技。好在他们已经同意把频率分享给我们。
entries.en: Recent reports indicate that [fotd_seperatist_planet.GetName] has now deployed a fleet to patrol [capital_star.GetName]. They appear to have developed cloaking technology. Thankfully, they have agreed to share their frequencies with us.

entries.zh:
观察者们，你们好。据说我们的祖先曾试图消灭你们。

为此，我们表示歉意。坦率地说，我们很惊讶你们没有进行报复。

从那时起已经过去了许多个世纪，我们愿意相信，我们现在是一个不一样的民族了，毋庸置疑这也要感谢你们。

我们想再给宇宙一次机会。能允许我们和你们一起探索吗？
entries.en:
Greetings Observers. It is said that our ancestors tried to end you.

For that, we apologize. Frankly, we are surprised that you didn't return the favor.

Many centuries have past since then, and we would like to believe that we are a different people now, no doubt thanks to you as well.

We wish to give the universe a second chance. Would you allow us to explore it with you?

entries.zh: 你们可以按自己的意愿行事。
entries.en: You are free to do so on your own.

entries.zh: 我们要返回菲沃尔母星系。
entries.en: We shall return the Fevorian home system.

entries.zh: 我们要停止启蒙菲沃尔人。
entries.en: We will stop enlightening the Fevorians.

entries.zh: 菲沃尔人给我们留下了一份可怕的赠别礼物：初步遥测显示，他们的巨型质量驱动器最后一次发射瞄准的目标是[Target.GetName]。
entries.en: The Fevorians have left us with a dreadful parting gift: initial telemetry has revealed that the final shot of their titanic mass driver was aimed at [Target.GetName].

entries.zh: 这个局势的进度无法逆转，只能减缓。
entries.en: The progress of this situation cannot be reversed, only slowed down.

entries.zh: [Target.GetName]将会被碎星钨弹击中，变得无法居住。
entries.en: [Target.GetName] will be hit by the tungsten planet cracker rendering the planet uninhabitable.

entries.zh: 我们在绝望地寻求解决方案。
entries.en: We are desperately looking for solutions.

entries.zh: 炮弹正在接近我们的恒星系。
entries.en: The projectile is approaching our solar system.

entries.zh: 炮弹已经进入我们的恒星系。
entries.en: The projectile has entered our solar system.

entries.zh: 黑暗之怖环境改造局势
entries.en: Fear of the Dark Terraforming Situation

entries.zh: 进入下一环境改造阶段的进度。
随着局势进展，[Target.GetName]将会被逐步改造。
entries.en: As this situation advances [Target.GetName] will be terraformed.

entries.zh: 这位科学家的经验在隐形科技领域形成了诸多有见地的观点。
entries.en: This scientist's experience has resulted in valuable insights into cloaking tech.

entries.zh: 能够提高发现物理领域相关的§H隐形科技§!线索的概率。
entries.en: Has increased chance to discover §HCloaking Technologies§! insights related to physics.

entries.zh: 这位指挥官的成长经历教会此人灵活运用隐形技术，其形式甚至我方自己的指挥官都想象不到。
entries.en: This commander's upbringing taught them to use cloaking in ways our own commanders could never imagine.

entries.zh: 在解决了意识形态上的分歧之后，人们团结一致。
entries.en: Having settled their ideological differences, these people stand as one.

entries.zh: 我们的兄弟行星在面对外星生命的新闻时显得手足无措、无从应对，他们的这股情感也借助新闻媒体和通讯手段传达到了我们的人民中间。
entries.en: Our partner planet has reacted poorly to the news of alien life, and their feelings have spread to our people through shared media and communications.

entries.zh: 或许我们的兄弟行星是对的：这些巨型猛兽的可怕新闻已经让我们两个星球都变得不太稳定。
entries.en: Perhaps our partner planet was right: the horrifying news of these titanic beasts has destabilized both our worlds.

entries.zh: 作为对我们近期外交行动的天真般地抗议，我们的邻居中止了一切科学上的合作。当然，这件事肯定很快就平息了。
entries.en: In a childish protest over recent diplomatic actions, our neighbors have ceased all scientific cooperation. Surely, this will all blow over soon.

entries.zh: 这颗行星上的人们被剥夺了离开的机会。自不必说，在要求进行迁移之后，这样的结果肯定无法令人满意。
entries.en: The people on this planet were denied the opportunity to leave. Needless to say, after requesting relocation, they are not satisfied with this outcome.

entries.zh: 我们的伙伴行星相信，当前的政治局势是无法避免的。他们不遗余力地提醒我们这个事实。
entries.en: Our neighboring planet believes the current political situation was an inevitability. They have wasted no time in reminding us of this fact.

entries.zh: 这代表着一件两个星球都要面临的威胁。安内之前，必须先攘外。
entries.en: This represents a threat to both our worlds. It must be dealt with before returning to our internal discourse.

entries.zh: 有某个存在正在威胁我们的星系。我们必须对抗它。作为一个国家。
entries.en: Something threatens our galaxy. We will stand against it. As one.

entries.zh: 由于与我们的兄弟行星所签订的科研协议，我们要暂停探索新星球了。
entries.en: As a result of the research pact with our partner planet, for the time being our exploration of new worlds will be put on hold.

entries.zh: 作为与我们兄弟行星交换新科技的代价，我们愿意暂停目前的第一次接触项目。
entries.en: In exchange for new technologies from our partner planet, we have agreed to cease our current First Contact projects.

entries.zh: 我们得到了新科技，他们则有了更多的资源。这笔交易很公平。
entries.en: We get new technologies, they get more resources. A fair enough trade.

entries.zh: 我们已经向我们的兄弟行星承诺，不对神秘的灵能力量或科技进行进一步的深入探索。他们担心我们会迷失自我。真是杞人忧天。
entries.en: We have promised our partner planet not to delve any deeper into the mysteries of psionic power or technology. They are worried we might lose ourselves. Such childlike anxiety.

entries.zh: 我们的外交影响力被严重削弱了。目前，我们必须在星系舞台上噤声。毕竟我们换到的科技还是更有所值的。
entries.en: Our diplomatic clout has been severely curtailed. For the time being, we must remain voiceless on the galactic stage. The technology we received in exchange had better be worth it.

entries.zh: 巨大的$NAME_fotd_Hunter_species$星系级物质投射炮的遗址。尽管已经无法运作，但对其进行研究仍能增进我们对弹道学的理解。
entries.en: The remains of the great $NAME_fotd_Hunter_species$ galactic mass driver. While no longer functional, studying it should enhance our understanding of ballistics.

entries.zh: 我们有理由相信我们的第一次接触工作受到了负面影响。从现在起我们必须更加小心翼翼。
entries.en: We have reason to believe that our first contact efforts have been compromised. We must be more careful from now on.

entries.zh: 得益于我们兄弟行星的帮助，船坞目前以110%的效率运行中。
entries.en: Shipyards are running at 110% efficiency thanks to assistance from our partner planet.

entries.zh: 通过与我们的兄弟行星共事，我们的舰船以前所未有的效率运作。
entries.en: By working together with our partner planet, our ships are moving like never before.

entries.zh: 我们的舰队运作效率无与伦比，感谢我们兄弟行星的军官团。
entries.en: Our ships are maneuvering better than ever, thanks to our partner planet's officer corps.

entries.zh: 我们的举措使得一些我们物种的成员嘲讽我们不再是真的[Root.Species.GetName]了，但他们的观点不值一提。我们无所谓指指点点。
entries.en: Our actions have led some members of our species to deride us as no longer truly [Root.Species.GetName], but their opinion is inconsequential. We stand above judgment now.

entries.zh: 虽然我们是以强硬的方式获得了这些资源，但这又有什么不好呢？有些人只是比别人需要更多的说服力。
entries.en: We may have strong-armed our way into these resources, but what's the harm? Some people just take more convincing than others.

entries.zh: 在经历了一场灾难性的赤字后，我们的兄弟行星现在需要削减非必要的机构。所以我们的文化交流项目黄了。
entries.en: After experiencing a devastating deficit, our partner planet must now make cuts to non-essential institutions. As a result, our cultural exchange projects have deteriorated.

entries.zh: 虽然我们的伙伴星球为我们提供了技术和战术方面的见解，但菲沃尔人独特的历史视角让我们能以新的角度来看待自己的社会。
entries.en: While our partner planet provides us with insights into technology and tactics, the Fevorians' unique historical perspective has provided a new lens through which to view our own society.

entries.zh: 作为技术领先的敌人发动无端侵略的受害者，我们学到了疏忽大意会付出的代价。这种事情不会再发生了。
entries.en: As the victim of an unprovoked act of aggression by a technologically superior foe, we understand the cost of negligence. Never again.

entries.zh: 这里就是粉碎了§Y大分裂者§!的那次攻击发起的星系。扫描显示这个恒星系异常地富有矿物。
entries.en: The system from which the attack that shattered §YThe Divider§! originated. Scans indicate that the system is abnormally rich in minerals.

entries.zh: 击中大分裂者的那颗小行星异常地富含钨元素，许多科学家声称他们已经“证实”这是一起对我们恒星系的攻击。遗憾的是，我们与之的协议意味着我们必须迎合这些胡思乱想。
entries.en: The asteroid that hit the Divider contained an abnormal amount of tungsten, and several scientists now claim to have "proof" that this was an attack on our solar system. Sadly, our agreements with their world mean we will have to humor these fancies.

entries.zh: 假使有足够时间的话，单一艘科研船就可以构建一个涨落力场来改变钨导弹的矢量。但光是这个可能还不够。
entries.en: A lone science ship could, given enough time, establish a fluctuating force field to change the vector of the tungsten missile. But that in itself may not be enough.

entries.zh: 特别改造的鱼雷可以通过编程将自身附着在这些炮弹上，通过反向推进器把这份“惊喜”的速度降下来。
entries.en: Specially modified torpedoes could be programmed to attach themselves to the projectile; by reversing their thrust, they might just slow this 'gift' down.

entries.zh: 尽管在我们的恒星系里没有什么比这个钨质小行星的密度更大，但太空石块还是有不少的。即使只能以亚光速发射，但用另一颗小行星砸上去应该能缓解这场危机。
entries.en: While we don't have anything as dense as a tungsten asteroid in our system, we have no shortage of space rocks. Even at less than lightspeed, firing a counter asteroid at the current threat might help.

entries.zh: 把这颗钨质炮弹直接炸毁好像是个不错的主意，但产生的碎片仍然会对我们的行星造成毁灭性打击。我们的科学家已经计算出了一个受控破拆流程，也许可以将这颗炮弹拆分成更好处理的形式。
entries.en: Blowing up the tungsten bullet might seem appealing, but the resulting shrapnel would still have a catastrophic impact on our world. Our scientists have calculated a controlled detonation sequence that might help fracture the projectile into a slightly more manageable form.

entries.zh: 为了诱使他们多留几年，我们得给予一些激励。不要小看蝇头小利的力量。
entries.en: To entice them to stay on a few more years, we might offer an incentive. Never underestimate the power of a well-placed bribe.

entries.zh: 我们可以提醒他们这里乐趣多多，或许可以提供一些具体的例子来鼓励他们留下来。
entries.en: We could remind them of the many pleasures here, and perhaps provide a few discrete examples as an incentive to stay.

entries.zh: 好吧，如果他们坚持要回家的话我们也别无选择，只能告知他们的政府他们参与了违法的异星关系。
entries.en: Well, if they insist on returning home, we have no choice but to inform their government about the illicit xeno-relations they were engaging in.

entries.zh: 我们可以预留政府津贴来资助这个项目。这应该能让他们分心一段时间。
entries.en: We could set aside a government stipend to fund this project. That should keep them distracted for a while longer.

entries.zh: 停止我们目前的第一次接触流程
entries.en: ceasing our current first contact procedures

entries.zh: 破坏与我们盟友的防御条约
entries.en: breaking the defensive pact with our ally

entries.zh: 禁止更多外星人进入我们的帝国
entries.en: barring any more aliens from entering our empire

entries.zh: 允诺暂时不与虚境交流
entries.en: promising not to communicate with the Shroud for the time being

entries.zh: 解除我们的联邦成员资格
entries.en: rescinding our membership with our federation
not engaging with the galactic community

entries.zh: 通过精准控制鱼雷，我们成功地把那枚菲沃里炮弹变慢了下来。
entries.en: By expertly controlling our torpedoes, we have successfully slowed down the Fevorian projectile.

entries.zh: 那颗钨质小行星受到我们的小行星影响，轨迹发生了显著偏转。
entries.en: The tungsten asteroid has been slightly deflected by our own, local asteroid.

entries.zh: 通过受控爆破，我们将这颗炮弹的质量削减了约34%。
entries.en: After the controlled detonation, we have reduced the projectile's mass by close to 34%.

entries.zh: 使用先进的力场操控技术和护盾科技，我们成功地把这份临别礼物的速度减慢了。
entries.en: Using advanced field manipulation and shielding technology, we have managed to leech some of the speed from the Last Gift.

entries.zh: 这个采石场早在很久以前就已经被采空了最后一个晶洞。
entries.en: The last geode was extracted from this quarry a long time ago.

entries.zh: 该选项会让我们转变为一个§Y种族洁癖§!帝国。
entries.en: This option will cause us to transition into a §YFanatic Purifier§! empire.

entries.zh: §R受限于一个保证他们自由的世纪老条款，我们不能攻击§H[capital_scope.GetName]§!。§!
entries.en: §RWe cannot attack §H[capital_scope.GetName]§! because of a century old treaty guaranteeing their independence.§!

entries.zh: 第一次接触以最糟糕的方式结束了。如今我们与之不共戴天。
entries.en: First Contact ended in the worst possible way. It is now either us or them.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R由于协议的存在我们不能干涉[from.GetName]。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RDue to our agreements we cannot interfere with [from.GetName].§!

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§R这个社会在科技方面无法进步。§!
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$§RThis society is unable to progress technologically.§!

entries.zh:
如楼房大小、长着许多触手的怪物突然出现在§Y[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!让首都陷入了一片混乱。这只生物似乎和我们一样困惑于它自己的突然出现，毫无抵抗地就被我们捕获拘束了起来。

许多[owner.GetScientistPlural]宣称，代号§H来客§!的这个生物是来自外太空，而其他人则认为这是一种此前尚未发现的物种直至今日才得以为人所知。无论如何，轨道上确实没有发现任何外星舰船。这个生物的凭空出现，似乎也不是借助的科技手段。

令人困惑（同时它自己也充满困惑）的客人目前被收容在一座研究设施中。
entries.en:
The appearance of a building-sized, tentacled monstrosity in the midst of §Y[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has thrown the capital into chaos. The creature seems as confused as we are by its sudden appearance, and has allowed itself to be restrained without resistance.

While many [owner.GetScientistPlural] already claim the creature, codenamed §HThe Guest§!, to be of alien nature, others have suggested it could be a previously unknown species which had until now gone undiscovered. After all, no alien ship has been detected in orbit. The creature materialized out of nowhere, seemingly unassisted by technology.

Our confusing (and confused) visitor is currently being held in one of our research facilities.

entries.zh:
如楼房大小、长着许多触手的怪物突然出现在§Y[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!让首都失去了秩序。这个生物对于它自己的突然出现似乎和我们一样困惑，毫无抵抗地就被我们捕获拘束了起来。

我们怀疑该生物应该来自外太空，但无法排除是一种本就在我们星球上的未知物种的可能性。无论如何，轨道上确实没有发现任何外星舰船。这个代号§H来客§!的生物的凭空出现，似乎也不是借助的科技手段。

令人困惑（同时它自己也充满困惑）的客人目前被收容在一座研究设施中。
entries.en:
The appearance of a building-sized, tentacled monstrosity in the midst of §Y[This.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has thrown the capital into disarray. The creature seems as perplexed as we are by its sudden appearance, and has allowed itself to be restrained without resistance.

We suspect the creature to be of alien nature, but we can't discount the possibility of it being an unknown species native to our world. After all, no alien ship has been detected in orbit. The creature - codenamed §HThe Guest§! - materialized out of nowhere, seemingly unassisted by technology.

Our confusing (and confused) visitor is currently being held in one of our research facilities.

entries.zh: 我们必须与该生物交流！
entries.en: We must talk to this creature!

entries.zh: 净化这个入侵我们首都的东西！
entries.en: Purge this invader from our capital!
One of us. One of us.
The §Y$NAME_Guest$§! joins our ranks as a leader.

entries.zh: 我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoyPlural]将会尝试与该生物交流。
entries.en: Our [This.Owner.GetEnvoyPlural] will attempt to communicate with the creature.

entries.zh: 一个未知来源的巨型生物突然现身我们的首都。目前它正被约束在我们的一处研究设施内。
entries.en: A colossal creature of unknown origin suddenly materialized in our capital. It is currently being held in one of our research facilities.

entries.zh: 我们没能成功地给这位神秘访客提供合适的营养：该生物很快就生病了，它拒绝餐食，还拒绝作出任何应答。\n\n在我们能够进一步了解它的新陈代谢机制之前，通讯行为暂时停止。
entries.en: Our attempts to provide our mysterious visitor with suitable nourishment have failed: the creature quickly sickened, expelled the meal, and is currently unresponsive.\n\nCommunication efforts are on hold until we can gain a better understanding of its metabolism.

entries.zh: 该生物对我们的尝试性联络反应激烈，猛烈地袭击了一位我们的科学家，并拒绝进一步的合作。也许我们无意见冒犯了它。\n\n尽管没有人严重受伤，但是这次事故依然对迄今为止我们同这个生物建立的脆弱的信任造成了损伤。
entries.en: The creature has reacted violently to our communication attempts, lashing out at one of our scientists and refusing further collaboration. We believe we have unintentionally offended it.\n\nWhile no one was seriously injured, the accident has damaged the fragile trust we have so far built up with the creature.

entries.zh:
我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]研究后得知，这位客人扭曲触手的动作其实是一种复杂的语言形式。

于是乎我们沮丧地了解到这个生物正因为衣不蔽体而感到尴尬，正在反复地请求合适的衣物以遮蔽其赤裸的躯体。

在得体地遮蔽躯体后，我们的研究者建造了一台多肢机器以便与这个生物交流。
entries.en:
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] has determined the wriggling tentacle motions of our guest are a form of sophisticated sign language.

To our dismay, we thus learned that the creature is embarrassed about its lack of clothing and has been repeatedly asking for appropriate garments to cover its naked appendages.

After it's suitably clad, our researchers have proposed the construction of a many-tentacled machine to better aid communication with the creature.

entries.zh: 我们的这位访客十分健谈，但文化差异让我们难以相互理解。现在我们知道了该生物为雌性，她称自己为§H“万爪之母”§!，似乎隶属于某个它称之为§Y薄幕行者§!的唯心主义教团。但我们仍然不明白这个她一直唠唠叨叨不停的§Y“山现”§!是什么，或者它和她的突然出现之间有什么因果关系。\n\n我们继续尝试同其进行沟通。
entries.en: Our guest is very talkative, but cultural differences are making it hard for us to understand each other. We now know that the creature is female, refers to herself as §H"The Many-Tentacled One"§! and seems to be a member of a spiritual order it calls the §YVeilfarers§!. But we still don't understand what this §Y'Jaunt'§! She keeps mentioning is, or how it can be responsible for her sudden appearance.\n\nOur communication efforts continue.

entries.zh:
我们的研究人员终于拼凑出了“万爪之母”的故事：我们的宾客是一位专注于研究§Y闪现§!的唯心主义教团的领袖：这是一种允许在宇宙中任何地方瞬间传送的灵能技术。纵观她的物种的历史，从来没有人成功地进行过闪现……直到现在。

万爪之母不确定她是否有能力复制这一壮举，更何况她的能量储备目前已经耗尽，无法再做尝试。

当前，她愿意继续接受我们的照顾，并将通过帮助我们的研究人员来回报我们的热情款待。
entries.en:
Our researchers have finally pieced together the Many-Tentacled One's story: our guest is the head of a spiritual order focused on studying the §YJaunt§!: a psionic technique that allows for instantaneous teleportation anywhere in the universe. Throughout the history of her species, no one has ever managed to perform a successful Jaunt... Until now.

The Many-Tentacled One is unsure about her ability to replicate the feat, and her energy reserves are currently too depleted to make another attempt.

For now, she would like to remain in our care, and will repay our hospitality by aiding our researchers.
We'll welcome her as an equal.

entries.zh: 她可以留在这，但不会很自由。
entries.en: She can stay. But she won't be free.

entries.zh: §H万爪之母§!将作为一名科学家加入我们。
entries.en: The §HMany-Tentacled One§! joins our ranks as a scientist.

entries.zh: 她可以留下，送到活体解剖实验室去。
entries.en: She can stay. In our vivisection labs.

entries.zh: 这恶心玩意儿怎么能留在我们的星球上！
entries.en: This abomination has no place in our world!
Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] have expressed an interest in $fircon.1230.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 新的数据表明我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]或许有能力$fircon.1230.desc.outro$
entries.en: New data suggests that our [owner.GetScientistPlural] may be capable of $fircon.1230.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 学习§H闪现§!，即§H万爪之母§!用来抵达我们母星的传送技术。\n\n这位笼罩着神秘主义色彩的太空生命愿意分享她的知识，尽管她也不确定我们是否能够复制这项技术。我们首都的一座合适的建筑已经准备好被改造成一座研究用的神殿。
entries.en: learning the §HJaunt§!, the teleportation technique used by the §HMany-Tentacled One§! to reach our homeworld.\n\nThe space-faring mystic is willing to share her knowledge, though she doubts we will be able to replicate the technique. A suitable building in our capital is ready to be converted into a temple facility for research purposes.

entries.zh: 我们的万爪之母最近表达了回归家乡的渴望，但我们难以定位她的母星系：她所描述的天体特征不符合我们所知星系的任何一个区域。\n\n我们的访客凝视着夜空，久久不曾挪开视线。
entries.en: Our Many-Tentacled One has recently expressed a desire to return to her people, but our efforts to locate her home system have proven fruitless: the celestial features she described don't correspond to any known part of the galaxy.\n\nOur guest's gaze remains fixed on the night sky.

entries.zh: 再加把劲。我们会找到她的家乡的！
entries.en: Redouble our efforts. We'll find her home!

entries.zh: 我们这不就是她的家吗。
万爪之母无处可寻。这个生物突然地出现，现在却又突然地消失了，仅仅在研究设施的地板上留下了一条匆忙划下的告别信息。\n\n“§H我很害怕，但我必须要闪现离开了。我心中的思乡之情无处排解，苦痛难耐。感谢你们所做的一切。我祈祷薄幕会善待我。§!”
entries.en: The Many-Tentacled One is nowhere to be found. The creature disappeared as abruptly as she appeared, leaving a hastily scratched goodbye message on the floor of the research facility:\n\n'§HI'm scared, but I have to Jaunt. My hearts ache with thoughts of home. Thank you for everything. I pray the Veil will be kind to me.§!'

entries.zh: 我们的一艘舰船截获了一个突然凭空出现在我们母星系的储藏箱。在我们的物种一接触到它的瞬间，上面复杂的锁就自动解开了，展露出了其中令人瞠目咋舌的大量工艺品……还有一张来自多肢旅行者的感谢纸条，其中声称她在几十年前曾经造访过我们的母星。
entries.en: One of our ships has intercepted a cache that suddenly materialized in our home system. The complex lock gave way as soon as a member of our species touched it, revealing a dizzying collection of artifacts... And a thank-you note from a Many-Tentacled traveler who claims to have visited our home planet decades ago.

entries.zh: §H万爪之母§!在我们首都的凭空出现证明了“灵能传送”这一曾经只存在于理论层面的概念是实操上可行的。通过让我们最能干的[owner.GetScientistPlural]投入研究工作，也许就可以学会这种瞬间旅行方式的秘密。
entries.en: The sudden appearance of the §HMany-Tentacled One§! on our capital has proven that the once theoretical concept of 'psionic teleportation' is workable in practice. By putting our most effective [owner.GetScientistPlural] on the job, it might be possible for us to learn the secrets of instantaneous interstellar travel.

entries.zh: 我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]花费了数不尽的时间试图掌握灵能传送的秘密，终于，其中的一位成功地进行了§H闪现§!！\n\n这位研究人员传送了一米，但因为传送至地板内导致失去了
entries.en: After spending many years trying to master the secrets of psionic teleportation, one of our [owner.GetScientistPlural] finally managed to §HJaunt§! successfully.\n\nThe researcher teleported a short distance but lost

entries.zh: $fircon.1240.desc.intro$下部附肢。随之而来的是许多掌声和一些尖叫声。
entries.en: $fircon.1240.desc.intro$ their lower appendages as a result of partly teleporting inside a floor. Much clapping and some screaming ensued.
$fircon.1240.desc.intro$ some key components as a result of partly teleporting inside a floor.

entries.zh: 又一次成功§H闪现§!了！根据我们的传感器数据，我们的一位[owner.GetScientistPlural]成功地传送到了离我们最近的恒星系，在几分之一秒内跨越了不可估量的距离。只是这个倒霉蛋在一颗恒星内实体化，并瞬间化为灰烬。
entries.en: Another successful §HJaunt§!. According to our sensor data, one of our [owner.GetScientistPlural] managed to teleport to our closest neighboring solar system, crossing incalculable distances in a fraction of a second... Only to materialize inside a star and become instantly incinerated.

entries.zh: 虽然建造灵能的推进的引擎存在可能性，但这种技术应用起来可能会难以置信地危险，甚至会给宇宙带来混乱。
entries.en: While the construction of a psionic propulsion drive might be possible, such technology could be incredibly dangerous to use and may bring chaos to the galaxy.

entries.zh: $fircon.1241.desc.intro$\n\n使用这种技术来推进舰船讨论遭到了深刻的质疑。$fircon.1241.desc.outro$
entries.en: $fircon.1241.desc.intro$\n\nTalks of using this technique to propel ships have been met with profound skepticism. $fircon.1241.desc.outro$

entries.zh: $fircon.1241.desc.intro$\n\n目前，使用这种技术来推进舰船的前景还停留在理论阶段。$fircon.1241.desc.outro$
entries.en: $fircon.1241.desc.intro$\n\nThe prospect of using this technique to propel ships remains purely theoretical for now. $fircon.1241.desc.outro$

entries.zh: 它实在太不精确，根本带不来任何可行的好处。我们越是尝试，就越清楚地意识到，§H万爪之母§!的到来完全是随缘。
entries.en: on the first Jaunt when they materialize inside a rock, a star, or even a black hole. It is too imprecise to provide any workable benefits. The more we try to Jaunt, the clearer it becomes that the arrival of the §HMany-Tentacled One§! was entirely random.

entries.zh: 在对§H闪现§!进行了深入的研究后，我们得出的结论是其毫无实用价值。我们的[GetResearchers]们可能要花费数十年来学会这项技术，结果也只会是因传送入石头、恒星甚至是一颗黑洞的首次闪现
entries.en: After extensive study of the §HJaunt§!, we have concluded that its use value is zero. Our [GetResearchers] could spend decades learning to master the technique, only to

entries.zh: 我们在完善§H闪现§!之后得到的结论是：一无是处。我们的[GetResearchers]们可能要花费数十年来掌握这项技术，结果也只会是因传送入石头、恒星甚至是一颗黑洞的首次闪现
entries.en: Here is what we learned after perfecting the §HJaunt§!: it's useless. Our [GetResearchers] could spend decades learning to master the technique, only to

entries.zh: 也许总有一天，我们梦寐以求的灵能推进器会成为现实。但至少不是今天。
entries.en: One day, perhaps, the psionic propulsion drive we desire will become reality. But not today.

entries.zh: 在当前阶段，灵能推进引擎还仅仅只是纯粹的理论。
entries.en: The concept of a psionic propulsion drive remains purely theoretical at this stage.

entries.zh: 然而，通过通过将闪现的原理应用到飞船工程而不是单个躯体之中，我们的[GetResearchers]距离造出§H$tech_psi_jump_drives$§!仅有一步之遥，将灵能传送变成了一个更可靠、更安全的手段。
entries.en: However, by applying the principles of the Jaunt to ship engineering rather than individual bodies, our [GetResearchers] are one step closer to building a §H$tech_psi_jump_drives$§! and turning psionic teleportation into a more reliable, marginally safer endeavor.

entries.zh: 尽管如此，我们获得的知识也会有一些工程应用。
entries.en: Nonetheless, the knowledge we gained will have some engineering applications.

entries.zh: 该文明完全没有觉醒对星际生命的认识。
entries.en: This civilization is not aware of interstellar life.

entries.zh: 由于缺乏证明星际生命存在的证据，这个文明仍然认为自己在宇宙中可能是孤独的。
entries.en: Lacking evidence of interstellar life, this civilization still believes it may be alone in the universe.

entries.zh: 这个文明开始意识到星系中有生命存在。太空里有什么东西。但会是什么呢？
entries.en: This civilization is partially aware of the existence of life in the galaxy. Something is out there. But what?

entries.zh: 这个文明意识到星系充满了生命；但这些生物是谁，他们想要什么呢？
entries.en: This civilization is aware that the galaxy is full of life; but who are these creatures, and what do they want?

entries.zh: 充分意识到有星际生命存在，这个文明很清楚自己属于一个星海共同体。
entries.en: Fully aware of interstellar life, this civilization understands it belongs to a galactic community.

entries.zh: 在月初，他们的觉醒度为$OLDVAL|0Y$。
entries.en: At the start of the month, their awareness was $OLDVAL|0Y$.

entries.zh: 目前到下一时代的进度：§Y$VAL|0%$§!
entries.en: Current progress to the next age: §Y$VAL|0%$§!

entries.zh: 位于$SYSTEM|Y$星系的$COUNTRY|Y$的£awareness£§Y感知§!提升到了§Y[root.GetAwarenessLevel]§!。
entries.en: The £awareness£ §YAwareness§! of the $COUNTRY|Y$ in the $SYSTEM|Y$ system has increased to §Y[root.GetAwarenessLevel]§!.

entries.zh: 位于$SYSTEM|Y$星系的$COUNTRY|Y$的£awareness£§Y感知§!下降到了§Y[root.GetAwarenessLevel]§!。
entries.en: The £awareness£ §YAwareness§! of the $COUNTRY|Y$ in the $SYSTEM|Y$ system has decreased to §Y[root.GetAwarenessLevel]§!.

entries.zh: 我们一直明目张胆地在§Y[contact_empire_system.GetName]§!星系进行行动，对于隐藏自己的行动丝毫没有任何注意。尽管他们的技术水平不高，但是即使是§Y[contact_empire.GetName]§!也注意到了我们的行动。现在第一次接触不可避免了。
entries.en: We have been careless, conducting operations in the §Y[contact_empire_system.GetName]§! system without bothering to hide our activities. Despite their modest technology level, even the §Y[contact_empire.GetName]§! have taken notice of our activity. First Contact is now unavoidable.

entries.zh: 我们围绕§Y[fromfrom.GetName]§!建造了一座观测站来研究上面的居民，但却意识到§Y[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§!反而是在研究我们：他们完全清楚其他外星物种的存在，并很快注意到了我们[root.GetScientistPlural]的到来。\n\n我们先前在这个恒星系的活动一定已经让[fromfrom.owner.GetName]对我们的存在有所警觉。当前情况下，保持我们的存在隐形化已经没有什么意义。
entries.en: We built an observation post around §Y[fromfrom.GetName]§! to study its inhabitants, only to realize the §Y[contact_empire.GetSpeciesNamePlural]§! are the ones studying us: they are fully aware of the existence of other alien species, and soon noticed the arrival of our [root.GetScientistPlural].\n\nOur previous activity in this solar system must have alerted the [fromfrom.owner.GetName] to our presence. Efforts to keep our existence hidden are futile at this point.

entries.zh: §E这个文明的觉醒度在上一个月会改变这么多量。\n\n觉醒度会受到多个方面的影响，包括恒星系内空间活动，以及我们同某个假定文明的互动。§!
entries.en: §EThis civilization's Awareness changed by this amount in the previous month.\n\nAwareness is affected by various factors including in-system spatial activity, and our own interactions with a given civilization.§!

entries.zh: §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的居民通过试用富营养肥料提高了他们的农业水平。他们能够收获到更高质量的农作物产品，社会的整体健康也得到改善。\n\n考虑到他们简陋的技术，这种粮食生产的进步是非常显著的。获得化肥样品后，我们就可以在更大范围内复刻这一成就。
entries.en: The inhabitants of §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have enhanced their agricultural skills through experimentation with nutrient-rich fertilizers. Their harvests are yielding higher quality produce and the health of their society is improving.\n\nGiven their rudimentary technology, this advancement in food production is remarkable. Obtaining a sample of the fertilizer should allow us to replicate the achievement on a wider scale.

entries.zh: 我们将继续从远处监视他们的努力。
entries.en: We will continue to monitor their efforts from a distance.

entries.zh: 派一支队伍去获取样本。
entries.en: Send a team to obtain a sample.

entries.zh: 温顺好生养：已研究样品
我们对从§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上收集到的肥料样本的分析获得了对前超光速文明农业行为的重要见解，其中的一部分甚至新到可以增进我们自己的技术。大家纷纷表示，这次努力物有所值，任务大获成功。
entries.en: Our analysis of collected fertilizer samples from §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has provided valuable insights into pre-FTL agricultural practices, some so novel that they could actually bolster our own techniques. By all accounts, this was a worthwhile endeavor, and a successful mission.

entries.zh:
§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的定居点一直在经历着农业困境。最近的农作物歉收可能会导致争夺食物的冲突。对于一个年轻的、发展中的社会，这是一个关键时刻。

无论他们是选择在需要的时候团结在一起，还是反目成仇，他们现在的决定对于未来朝着哪个方向发展都会产生很大的影响。

不幸的是，无论采取哪种方式，他们都将进入一个极端困难的时期。
entries.en:
The settlements on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have been experiencing agricultural difficulties. Recent crop failures could lead to conflicts over food. This is a critical moment in the development of a young society.

Whether they choose to come together in their time of need, or to turn against each other, their decisions now will have a strong bearing on who they ultimately become.

Unfortunately, no matter which course is taken, they are entering a period of extreme hardship.

entries.zh: 我们不会打扰他们的自然发展历程。
entries.en: We will not interfere with the natural course of their development.

entries.zh: 我们在道义上应该帮助。
entries.en: We have a moral obligation to help.

entries.zh: 我们可以降低他们对食物的需求……
entries.en: We will reduce their need for food...

entries.zh: 我们最近对§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的干预产生了正面的结果。利用我们自己的农业技术，我们暗中确保了他们不会遭受饥荒。\n\n现在，他们有了盈余的食物，所以我们必须约束自己的行径，限制干预的程度。
entries.en: Our recent intervention on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! yielded positive results. Utilizing our own agricultural technologies, we covertly ensured they would not starve.\n\nNow, they have a surplus of food, so it is only right that we limit the extent of our interference by taking some for ourselves.

entries.zh: §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的居民持续地在他们的公共生活空间中创造出原始的、艺术化的代表作品，我们注意到其中有些图像开始显露出我们的轮廓。\n\n现在看来，我们在这颗星球上的所作所为很可能已经引起了注意。
entries.en: As the inhabitants of §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! continue to create crude, artistic representations in their communal living spaces, we have noticed some images have begun to look like us.\n\nIt now seems likely that our efforts on the planet have attracted notice.

entries.zh: 他们描绘了我们的样子。不可思议！
entries.en: They have captured our likeness. Fascinating!

entries.zh: 这画的什么东西。给我抹了！
entries.en: Their scribbles insult us. Remove them!

entries.zh: 我们已经污染了他们的文化。以后得多加小心。
entries.en: We have contaminated their culture. Take more care in future.

entries.zh: 在§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上，居民们正在使用原始的雕刻图画来表达和分享想法。我们的研究人员记录的样本表明，居民对他们自己星球以外的天体有认识，甚至已经开始记录星座。\n\n对于这样一个年轻的文明来说，他们早期绘制的星图是相当准确的，但也不至于到了无法改进的地步，只要我们想留下一些暗示……
entries.en: On §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, the inhabitants are using crudely carved imagery to express and share ideas. Samples documented by our researchers indicate that the inhabitants have an awareness of celestial bodies beyond their own planet, and have even begun to document constellations.\n\nTheir early attempts at charting the stars are fairly accurate for such a young civilization, but not so much that they couldn't be improved should we wish to drop some hints...

entries.zh: 继续被动观察。他们必须自食其力。
entries.en: Continue passive observations. They must learn on their own.

entries.zh: 也许我们可以默默地把他们推向正确的方向……
entries.en: Perhaps we could subtly point them in the right direction...
Written in the Stars: Charts Delivered

entries.zh: 由§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民绘制的早期星图被我们暗中修订了。\n\n描绘附近恒星系图样的雕刻是在附近的一个山洞里制作的。一旦它们被发现，它们应该能够让当地居民对已知宇宙的规模有一个更好的认识。
entries.en: The early star charts of the inhabitants on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have been covertly corrected.\n\nCarvings depicting nearby system diagrams were made in a nearby cave. Once they are discovered, they should provide the local population with a better sense of the scale of the known universe.

entries.zh: 我们今天做了件大好事。
entries.en: We did a good thing today.
Written in the Stars: Charts Received

entries.zh: 不幸的是，由于§Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民不知道是谁负责制作了他们的新星图，他们把我们的所作所为视作单纯的破坏行为。山洞周围的安保措施得到了加强，统治精英们对新形式的自我表达越来越敌视……\n\n从积极的方面看，我们的干预并不是完全浪费时间。他们对这一事件的反应在文化研究方面很有价值。
entries.en: Unfortunately, since the inhabitants of §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! did not know who was responsible for their new star charts, they passed off our efforts as simple vandalism. Security around the caves has increased, and the ruling elite has grown hostile to new forms of self-expression...\n\nOn a positive note, our interference was not a complete waste of time. their reaction to this event has proven fascinating in terms of cultural research.

entries.zh: 我们没能顺利地在暗中纠正§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的星图。对于一个如此年幼的社会而言他们的安保措施令人意外地复杂。对目前的任务来说，暴露的风险太高了。至少目前当地居民需要依靠自己的力量来探索星空了。
entries.en: Our efforts to covertly correct the star charts on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have been unsuccessful. Their security protocols are surprisingly sophisticated for such a young society. Given our current mission, the risks of exposure were too high. For now at least, the inhabitants will have to face their astronomical aspirations alone.

entries.zh: 在§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上独立出现了多种非语言的沟通体系。由于在图像和象形文字集之间存在冲突，居民们距离形成一种主导语言还有几个世纪。\n\n有趣的是，其中一个书写体系的语法结构与我们的很相似。如果§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的社会采用这个系统，他们在未来可能会在文化上相当具有可塑性……
entries.en: Multiple non-verbal communication systems have emerged independently on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. With conflicting sets of imagery and hieroglyphs, the inhabitants are still centuries away from forming a dominant language.\n\nInterestingly, one of the writing systems has a similar grammatical structure to our own. If §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! society were to adopt this system, they could become culturally malleable in the future...

entries.zh: 我们应该按照我们的形象塑造他们。
entries.en: We should mold them in our image.

entries.zh: 他们将会变得与我们相似。
我们在§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的存在引起了旁人的注意。占主要地位的文化团体现在将我们视为睿智而强大的存在，认为我们控制着元素，并最终掌握着他们的宿命。\n\n许多人在精心设计的仪式中以自己的性命向我们宣誓效忠，担心招致我们的不悦会带来十分严重的后果。
entries.en: Our presence on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! has not gone unnoticed. The dominant cultural group now regards us as wise and mighty beings who control the elements and ultimately their fate.\n\nMany have pledged their lives to us in elaborate ceremonies, fearing that incurring our displeasure could come with drastic consequences.

entries.zh: 在对§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的社会进行了大量的历史观察之后，他们占主流地位的社会群体已经把我们当作神灵来敬仰。他们希望继续用恩惠的行为得到我们的青睐……因此，为了纪念我们，血祭仍在继续。
entries.en: After actively observing their society for a substantial chunk of their history, the dominant society on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have come to revere us as deities. They wish to keep us in their good graces... And so the blood sacrifices continue in our honor.

entries.zh: 根据§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!当地居民的说法，根本没有神。\n\n尽管我们试图将自己打造成他们神圣的主人，却被他们一眼看穿了本质。
entries.en: According to the inhabitants of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, there are no gods.\n\nAlthough, we attempted to assert ourselves as their divine overlords, they saw through us easily.

entries.zh: $fircon.1320.desc.base$人们完全拒绝神灵的概念，接受了一种明显倾向于唯物主义的宇宙观。在没有确凿证据的情况下，他们相信在宇宙中只有自己。
entries.en: $fircon.1320.desc.base$ Rejecting the concept of deities altogether, the population has embraced a decidedly materialist view of the cosmos. Without hard evidence, they believe themselves alone in the universe.

entries.zh: $fircon.1320.desc.base$如果没有基于科学论证的、经同行评议的反面证据，他们已经根据经验确定，在这个现实的位面上，哪怕是遥远的神明亦不存在。他们仍有希望。
entries.en: $fircon.1320.desc.base$ Without science based, peer reviewed evidence to the contrary, they have determined empirically that nothing even remotely godly exists on this plane of reality. There is hope for them yet.

entries.zh: $fircon.1320.desc.base$这些桀骜不驯的人们拒绝向他人称臣，选择遵从自己最基础的冲动，进入无政府状态。加入机会恰当，他们应该接受我们作为他们的主人。
entries.en: $fircon.1320.desc.base$ Refusing to be subjugated, the wayward population has relented to their base urges and made the choice to become ungovernable. They should have accepted us as their masters when they had the chance.

entries.zh: §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的社会正不断孕育出丰富的文化和对艺术进行深刻鉴赏的风潮。居民们放下了武器，转而使用书写工具。随着这种全新的学习和探索氛围已超脱于冲突之上，我们可能正在见证这个行星上一个黄金时代的到来。
entries.en: Society on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! is blossoming with rich culture and a deep appreciation for art. The inhabitants are putting down their weapons in favor of writing instruments. With this newfound willingness to learn and explore beyond conflict, we could be witnessing the dawn of a golden age on the planet.

entries.zh: 能见证如此美丽的诞生，实属荣幸。
entries.en: It is a privilege to witness the birth of such beauty.

entries.zh: 我们正在见证§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民迈出他们走向启蒙的第一步。他们向上抬头，对宇宙的奥秘始终抱持开放的态度。随着艺术表达在他们文化中的发展，艺术力量捕捉社会的精神奋斗的一面也在发展。他们渴望有某种高于自我的信仰。
entries.en: We are witnessing the inhabitants of §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! taking their first steps towards enlightenment. They look upwards, opening themselves to the mysteries of the universe. As artistic expression develops within their culture, so does art's power to capture the spiritual striving of their society. They yearn for something beyond themselves to believe in.

entries.zh: 我们应当回应他们的祈祷！
一切都将化为尘土。剩下的只不过是这件事的序曲。
entries.en: Everything turns to dust. The rest is merely prelude.

entries.zh: 通过向存在的神圣真理开放自己，§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民正在接近开悟。作为精神领袖，我们有责任引导他们。
entries.en: By opening themselves to the divine truth of existence, the inhabitants of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! are approaching enlightenment. As spiritual leaders, it is our duty to guide them.

entries.zh: 当§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民仰望天空时，他们希望得到圣灵的赐福。然而，他们实际得到的是沉默。他们的祈祷没有得到回应。现在他们必须接受精神飘忽不定的本质。只有科学拥有他们寻求的答案。
entries.en: When the inhabitants of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! looked up to the skies they hoped to receive blessings from the divine. What they actually received was silence. Their prayers have gone unanswered. Now they must accept the frivolous nature of spirituality. Only science holds the answers they seek.

entries.zh: §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民已经开始提出一个理论，认为他们的所在的星球是由一个不可言喻的存在赠送给他们的，而生命是对神圣造物主不屈不挠的奉献所进行的回报。或许当他们遇到更广泛的星海共同体时，他们会有一个惊喜。
entries.en: The inhabitants of §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have begun to theorize that their world was gifted to them by an ineffable being, and that life is a reward for unyielding devotion to a divine creator. They may be in for a surprise when the time comes for them to meet the wider galactic community.

entries.zh: 让我们来教教他们科学吧。
entries.en: Let's educate them in the sciences.

entries.zh: 假以时日，他们的信仰会发展。
entries.en: Their faith will develop, given time.

entries.zh: 通过向§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的唯心领袖们现身，我们告诉他们所谓的“神圣造物主”并不存在。他们想要的答案只有通过科学才能找到。\n\n不幸的是，我们的这堂课没有起到效果。这些人们将我们视为神明，整日向我们三叩九拜。我们的任务起到了反效果。
entries.en: Revealing ourselves to the would-be spiritual leaders on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, we assured them that their so-called 'divine creator' does not exist. The answers they seek can be found only through science.\n\nUnfortunately, our lessons have been ignored. The people now look to us as as gods, vowing to worship us for all time. Our mission has backfired.

entries.zh: 这件事本来能够做得更好。

他们生气了！我们的行动彻底地惹恼了§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民。数个世纪以来，他们社会中的成员经常在神秘的情况下失踪，然后又在数日或数月后出现，口述着难以置信的外星科技的故事，这一切在他们眼里无异于魔法。\n\n可以理解，发现魔法不存在，这一切仅仅是外星人们为了研究你们的所作所为这件事极大地撼动了他们的世界观。人们在一夜之间倒向孤立主义，礼貌地要求我们不要再把他们当成实验对象。也许我们是该考虑他们的请求。
entries.en: They are furious! Our actions have completely embarrassed the inhabitants of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. For centuries, members of their society have disappeared under mysterious circumstances, only to reappear days or months later with the most incredible stories of alien technology, which from their perspective is nothing short of magical.\n\nUnderstandably, learning that magic isn't real - but aliens who probe you for research purposes are - has somewhat shaken their worldview. The population has become an insular society overnight, and are politely requesting us to stop treating them as lab specimens. Perhaps we should consider their request.

entries.zh: §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上快速的科技进展催生了工业化的时代。交通方式的跃进式发展将此前星球上相对孤立的区域连成一片，创造了环球贸易和思想交流的机遇。\n\n然而，资源的危机正在悄悄酝酿。如果其他星球上的历史也会重演的话，这里的人们很快就会陷入战争。
entries.en: Rapid technological advances on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! are ushering in an age of industrialization. Breakthroughs in transportation have linked previously disconnected areas of the world, creating opportunity for global trade and the sharing of ideas.\n\nHowever, tensions over resources are already brewing. If the history of other worlds is any guide, the populace could soon find themselves at war.

entries.zh: 或许我们可以伸出援手，帮助他们赈济灾民……
entries.en: Perhaps we could help them avert a catastrophe...

entries.zh: 无论是哪种方法，他们总要学会。
entries.en: They will learn, one way or another.

entries.zh: 我们冒着计算过的风险，向§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的星球领袖透露了自己的身份。我们毫不含糊地建议当地政府结束他们的冲突，警告说战争的后果很可能是灾难性的。许多人试探性地听着。其他人则认为任何关于“外星使者”的谈话都是一个骗局。
entries.en: Taking a calculated risk, we revealed ourselves to world leaders of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. In no uncertain terms, we advised the local governments to end their conflict, warning that the consequences of war could well be catastrophic. Many listened tentatively. Others dismissed any talk of 'alien emissaries' as a hoax.

entries.zh: 时间将证明他们是否听从了我们的警告。
entries.en: Time will tell if they will heed our warning.

entries.zh: 我们决定任由§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的星球领袖自行发展，现在他们是自己命运的第一责任人了。不幸的是，好像他们正在走向战争。\n\n据信是不可调和的差异导致了星球上不同的文化群体之间兵戎相见。紧随而来的冲突开启了他们的发展史上一段黑暗的篇章。
entries.en: In choosing to leave the world leaders of §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! to their own devices, they are now wholly responsible for their destiny. Unfortunately, it appears they are headed for war.\n\nSupposedly irreconcilable differences have driven the planet's culture groups to take up arms against one another. The coming conflict represents a dark period in their development.

entries.zh: §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的各领袖接受了我们的建议，放下了他们的武器。很难说这样的和平会持续多久，但至少现在，他们不太可能将自己从他们的行星表面抹除了。
entries.en: The leaders of §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have taken our advice and put down their weapons. It is impossible to say if the peace will last, but for now at least, they are unlikely to wipe themselves from the face of their planet.

entries.zh: 我们的接入对§Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!宛如火上浇油。他们的整个星球陷入了战争。然而，如果他们没能互相消灭的话，这种局势也许也有积极的一面：这颗行星上的科技进步成果卓绝。\n\n也许，当战争的硝烟散去，他们就能妥善地把这些科技用到正道上。
entries.en: Our intervention may have added fuel to the proverbial fire on §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. Their world is now at war. However, if they fail to eradicate one another, there may be an upside to the situation: the technological progress being made on the planet is remarkable.\n\nPerhaps, when and if the smoke of battle clears, they will put some of this technology to good use.

entries.zh: §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!科学技术得到了进一步的发展，因为工业化使他们的社会达到了新的高度。他们在工程方面的最新突破彻底改变了他们对交通的运用，这使他们离行星统一更近了一步。
entries.en: Technology continues to progress on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, as industrialization takes their society to new heights. Their most recent breakthrough in engineering has revolutionized their use of transportation and brought them a step closer to planetary unification.

entries.zh: $fircon.1410.desc.base$\n\n与我们模型预期的不同，§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!现在成为了一个统一的星球。他们将资源统一调配，人们则将为整个星球的社区的福祉作为首要任务，生活水平大幅提升。
entries.en: $fircon.1410.desc.base$\n\nDefying our prediction models, §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! is now a unified world. Pooling their resources, the people have prioritized the wellbeing of the global community and living standards are rising.

entries.zh: $fircon.1410.desc.base$\n\n§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!的居民们齐心协力，建设出了一个团结的星球。他们统一调配行星资源，每个蜂巢都将整个星球社区的共同利益放在首位，他们集体的生活水平超乎寻常。
entries.en: $fircon.1410.desc.base$\n\nWorking together, the inhabitants of §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have built a unified industrial world. Pooling world resources, the individual hives have prioritized the wellbeing of the entire global community, and their collective living standards appear exceptional.

entries.zh: 他们拥有的资源比实际需要的要多……
entries.en: They have more resources than they need...

entries.zh: 我们可以帮助他们缓解资源过多的问题。
entries.en: We could alleviate them of some of their resources.

entries.zh: §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的生活正在蓬勃发展，繁荣的经济为我们提供了一些……千载难逢的机会。一个新近建造的陆路货运网络就是一个理想的目标。从理论上讲，我们的特工人员可以很容易地登上这些货车，夺取货物。然而，根据我们目前的观测姿态，我们必须要采取额外的预防措施，以保持不被更多人发现。
entries.en: Life on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! is thriving, and the booming economy offers us certain... unique opportunities. A newly constructed network of land freighters is an ideal target. In theory, our operatives could easily board one of these freighters and seize the cargo. However, in accordance with our current observation stance, we would have to take extra precautions to remain undetected by the wider population.

entries.zh: 停下。我们除了研究别无其他需求。
entries.en: Stand down. We require nothing from them but research.

entries.zh: §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的货物打劫行动是一场成功。我们的特工夺得了一小部分合金，同时在下面的时候还学到了很多有关[GetPreFTLLower]转运的知识。
entries.en: The cargo heist on §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! was a success. Our agents secured a small cache of alloys, and learned a lot about [GetPreFTLLower] transit while they were down there.

entries.zh: §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的货物打劫行动宣告失败。我们的特工在某艘陆地货船上的行动中惨遭抓获。在接下来的冲突中，双方都遭受了伤亡，我们的特工身份暴露。
entries.en: The cargo heist on §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! was a failure. Our operatives were apprehended mid-operation aboard a land freighter. During the ensuing altercation, casualties were recorded on both sides, and our agents were exposed.
Conflict! What is it Good For?

entries.zh: 一场战争在§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上爆发了。最近这些年，这颗星球上的某些派系设法积累了足够的财富，对生产资料实施了垄断。与之对应，其他人对于日益严重的不平等进行了反抗。现在，一场席卷一切的阶级战争爆发了。对于§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!来说，这是一个黑暗的时代，后果将持续很长时间。
entries.en: A war has broken out on §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. In recent years, certain factions on the planet managed to accrue enough wealth to monopolize the means of production. In turn, others revolted against the growing inequality. Now, an all out class war has broken out. It is a dark time for §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. This will have lasting consequences.

entries.zh: 那些革命者非常勇敢，我们哀悼他们的抗争。
entries.en: Those brave revolutionaries. We lament their struggle.

entries.zh: 我们很牵挂§Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!。观察这场战争是深入了解他们社会的宝贵机会。
entries.en: Our thoughts are with §Y[From.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!. Observing this war should provide invaluable insights into their society.

entries.zh: 我们将在他们的政治事务中保持中立。
entries.en: We will remain impartial in their political affairs.

entries.zh: §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的战争结束了。革命者们一个接一个失败了。主导派系继续从因自身贪婪引起的战争中获利，四处尸山血海。\n\n一切恢复了原状，革命的呼声也一时噤若寒蝉。
entries.en: The war on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! is over. One by one, the revolutionaries fell. As the bodies piled high, the dominant faction continued to profit from a war triggered by their own greed.\n\nThe status quo has been restored. Cries for revolution have gone silent.

entries.zh: 我们为他们的损失感到哀伤。
我们选择不干涉[GetPreFTLLower]文明的政治，§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上的战争也按自己的步调结束了。压迫者势力轻松地碾压了革命者。\n\n一切恢复了原状，革命失败了。
entries.en: After we chose not to involve ourselves with [GetPreFTLLower] politics, the war on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! ended of its own accord. The oppressive powers steamrolled the revolutionaries with ease.\n\nThe status quo has been restored. The revolution is dead.

entries.zh: §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上怠忽的职员们把自己忙得够呛，他们傲慢的反抗以失败告终。执行官们通过巧妙的公司改组和绩效管理手段再度控制住了局面。\n\n一切恢复了原状。所有人再次回到了自己的工作岗位上。
entries.en: The delinquent employees on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! have tired themselves out, and their arrogant revolt has ended in failure. The executives regained control of the situation through tactful corporate restructuring and performance management.\n\nThe status quo has been restored. Everyone is returning to their designated workspaces.

entries.zh: 超出模型预期，§Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上这些行为不端的雇员们粗暴地驱逐了管理层并取而代之。\n\n这是一场灾难，我们的工人从中获取了灵感，并意识到了自己的处境。我们的投资陷入了前所未有的危险。我们本应更彻底地进行尽职调查的。
entries.en: Defying prediction models, the delinquent employees on §Y[FromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§! ousted their executive tier in a hostile takeover.\n\nThis is a disaster, as our own workers have taken inspiration and are now getting ideas above their stations. Our investments are now at risk like never before. We should have been more thorough in our due diligence.

entries.zh: 在§Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上，不满的声音被权势滔天的精英阶层给压制住了。然而，如果我们现在进行干预，肯定可以扭转局势。我们在这个星球上的存在可以为残余的抵抗组织提供支援。
entries.en: On §Y[FromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, dissenting voices have been silenced by the powerful elite. However, if we intervene now we could certainly turn the tide. Our presence on the planet could bolster what is left of the resistance.

entries.zh: 我们的军队刚在§Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!上登陆，立即取得了对当地土著军队在物质上和战略上的全面优势。日薄西山的精英阶层已经撤退，革命者们准备好接过权力的衣钵。
entries.en: Landing on §Y[FromFromFromFrom.Owner.Capital.GetName]§!, our forces demonstrated an immediate material and strategic advantage over the native troops. The former elite has withdrawn, and the revolutionaries stand poised to assume the mantle of power.

entries.zh: 这真是最骇人听闻的消息。
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的居民已经开始积极地寻找他们星球之外的智慧生命迹象。随着他们准备大胆地前往许多文明已经拜访过的地方时，可能我们是时候要重新评估我们的第一次接触协议了，做好准备，让更广泛的星海共同体迎接新的成员。
entries.en: The inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have begun actively searching for signs of intelligent life beyond their world. As they prepare to boldly go where many have already gone, it may be time for us to reassess our first contact protocols, in preparation for a new addition to the wider galactic community.

entries.zh: 当他们准备好时，我们会欢迎，但那之前还不行。
entries.en: We will greet them when they are ready, and not before.

entries.zh: 在恐惧中毁灭吧，你们这些小蠢蛋！
entries.en: Quake with fear, you tiny fools!

entries.zh: §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明不知通过何种手段截取并破解了一段发自我们轨道观测站的通讯信号。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! has somehow intercepted and deciphered a series of communications emanating from our orbital observation post.

entries.zh:
$fircon.1475.desc.base$

他们正在研究一份在观测站上的工作者发往我们首都的一位未知收信人的极具个性化的信息。

这一意外的泄露暴露了一处我们安保协议的漏洞。
entries.en:
$fircon.1475.desc.base$

They are currently studying a message of a very personal nature between an agent aboard the observation post, and an unknown recipient from our capital.

This unfortunate leak has highlighted gaps in our security protocols.

entries.zh: $fircon.1475.desc.base$\n\n他们收到了我们的敏感信息。我们的安保存在漏洞。
entries.en: $fircon.1475.desc.base$\n\nThey are in receipt of our sensitive data. We have gaps in our security.
We should have been more careful.

entries.zh: 找到泄露源。遥控擦除他们的数据仓库。
entries.en: Identify the leaks. Remotely scrub their data repository.

entries.zh: 他们现在认为只剩自己了

§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的居民搜寻智慧生命的努力一无所获。

他们投入了大量时间和资源在繁星中搜寻生命，但很沮丧地发现除了虚空以外一无所有。

目前这项研究还在进行，但可以肯定他们很快就对项目失去了希望。不必多说，我们将继续在每一个任务参数中对他们隐藏自身的存在。
entries.en:
The inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have had no success in their search for intelligent life.

Having dedicated time and resources in the search for life amongst the stars, they were despondent to discover nothing but void.

For now, the search continues, but it is clear they are swiftly losing hope in the project. Needless to say, we will continue to hide our existence from them, per mission parameters.

entries.zh: 他们还没准备好同我们会面。
entries.en: They're not ready to meet us just yet.

entries.zh: §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上荒谬的居民们居然用他们羸弱的科技截获了一些我们过去的无线电信号。\n\n解码和理解我们的广播足够让他们忙上几个世代。以他们目前的发展水平，我们尚且没有暴露的风险。
entries.en: The ridiculous inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have used their weak tech to intercept some of our historic radio signals.\n\nDeciphering and interpreting our old broadcasts should keep them busy for a few generations. With their current level of development, we are not at risk of being exposed.

entries.zh: 在他们搜寻外行星智慧的过程中，§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的居民向整个星系发去了广播。他们收到的信息是，“嘘，别让他们听到了。”\n\n这当然是我们一位特工的所作所为。结果是，这个年轻的太空民族现在正为外太空究竟蛰伏着什么恐怖动的东西而瑟瑟发抖。
entries.en: In their search for extra-planetary intelligence, the inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! called out to the galaxy. What they received was a message which said, 'Be quiet or they will hear you.'\n\nThis was the action of one of our own agents. As a result, the young spacefarers are now terrified of what might lurk beyond their system.

entries.zh: 我们收到了报告，是关于在§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上进行超光速航天器推进装置的事项。当地居民似乎打算成为一个彻底的太空文明。然而，他们在星空中发现的东西，可能会证明当下阶段他们还无法理解。
entries.en: We have received reports of superluminal spacecraft propulsion on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!. The inhabitants seem intent on becoming a full-fledged spacefaring civilization. What they discover in the stars may prove too much for them to comprehend.

entries.zh: 获得很多，但是失去的更多
entries.en: Much To Gain, Yet Much to Lose

entries.zh: 现已证实，§Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!确有一艘理论上存在超光速能力的飞船。他们已经开始进行测试，以期尽快突破光障。\n\n一旦成功，他们在技术上便已具备涉及星系外交的能力。这样的境遇必然对他们的社会造成或好或坏的深远影响。
entries.en: The existence of a theoretically FTL-capable craft on §Y[event_target:pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! is now confirmed. They have moved on to testing, hoping to soon break the light speed barrier.\n\nIf they are successful, they will technically be ready to engage in galactic diplomacy. Such an encounter is sure to have profound effects on their society, for good or ill.

entries.zh: 他们必须自力更生。保持距离进行观测。
entries.en: They must learn on their own. Observe from a distance.

entries.zh: 他们还没准备好。破坏他们的任务。
entries.en: They're not ready. Sabotage their mission.

entries.zh: 改变我们的应对方案。帮助他们触及星辰！
entries.en: Change our approach. Help them reach the stars!

entries.zh: 我们开始厌烦了。让他们在自己的道路上快马加鞭。
entries.en: We grow weary. Speed them along on their way.

entries.zh:
§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上雄心勃勃的宇航员们试图突破光障。整个星球的目光都聚焦在这艘飞船向着星间启航。

发射成功了。一切都按预期的参数运行中。随后他们启动了曲速引擎，事情发生了转折。

他们成功地扭曲了时空连续统（这是一种迷人但存在缺陷的超光速航行方式），然而他们只在舰船尾部成功了。随之而来的在案超乎了§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的一切想象。乘员们被剧烈地扭曲撕扯，身体的一部分停留于原地，而同时另一部分被扯入了未来。

他们可得再多花一些时间才能进行下一次尝试了。
entries.en:
The aspiring spacefarers on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! attempted to break the light speed barrier. The whole world looked on as the spacecraft launched towards the stars.

Liftoff was a success. Everything was operating within expected parameters. Then they engaged their warp drive and things took a turn.

They successfully distorted the shape of the space-time continuum (a fascinating but flawed approach to breaking the light speed barrier), however they were only successful in doing this in the aft section of the craft. The resulting carnage was beyond anything the inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! could have ever imagined. The crew was violently distorted, fixed in one part of space, whilst simultaneously having other parts of themselves stretched into the future.

It could be some time before they are ready for a second attempt.

entries.zh: 要是我们早点警告他们，他们现在早就成为太空文明了……
entries.en: Had we warned them, they would be spacefarers now...

entries.zh: 如期而至。他们的失败是不可避免的。
entries.en: As expected. Their failure was inevitable.

entries.zh: §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!的人们在实验性跃迁引擎方面取得了巨大的成功，然而他们在关于时空扭曲产生器的投射距离计算方面犯了严重的错误。通过与他们的直接沟通，我们得以引导他们通过超空间航道这种广为接受的方式来进行超光速航行。\n\n依照我们的建议，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]很快就能加入我们的星系社会了。
entries.en: The people of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have made remarkable progress on their experimental jump drive, however there were some glaring mistakes in their calculations relating to the projected range of their space-time distortion generator. By engaging in direct communication, we were able to guide them towards the accepted method of faster than light travel via hyperlane network.\n\nFollowing our advice, [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] will soon join us as a galactic spacefaring society.

entries.zh: 我们静候他们的到达，加入更广泛的星海共同体。
entries.en: We await their arrival into the wider galactic community.

entries.zh: §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上的居民们作为一个宇航文明加入了星海共同体。\n\n我们的观测任务结束了，他们已经拥有了超光速运行能力。
entries.en: The inhabitants of §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! have joined the wider galactic community as a spacefaring society!\n\nOur observation mission now concludes, as they are now FTL capable.

entries.zh: 他们不挡我们的路就是做了好事。
entries.en: They would do well to stay out of our way.

entries.zh: 他们的科技退步了，结果让他们倒车回到了前一个发展阶段。
entries.en: Their technology has regressed, effectively knocking them back to an earlier age in their development.

entries.zh: 它或许是一种艺术。但起码我们知道自己不喜欢。
entries.en: It may have been art. All we know is we didn't like it.

entries.zh: 对于未来的观测任务，我们会采取更加谨慎的应对方案。
entries.en: We will take a more cautious approach to future observation missions.

entries.zh: 谷物歉收造成了持续性的农业困境。
entries.en: Crop failures cause lasting agricultural difficulties.

entries.zh: 岩石采集失败导致了持续性的困境。
entries.en: Rock harvest failures cause lasting difficulties.

entries.zh: 这颗星球上的矿物生产情况是多变而难以为继的。
entries.en: Mineral production on the planet is volatile and unsustainable.

entries.zh: 近期的农业发展导致了食物生产的提高。
entries.en: Recent agricultural development has led to higher food production.

entries.zh: 近期的农业发展导致了矿物生产的提高。
entries.en: Recent agricultural development has led to higher mineral production.

entries.zh: 他们得自力更生了。我们绝不再干涉。
entries.en: They will learn on their own. We mustn't interfere.

entries.zh: 获得额外§G25%§!§Y观测洞见§!进度。
艺术是不务正业。唯有生产才是正事。
entries.en: Art is a useless pursuit. Production is all that matters.

entries.zh: 艺术化的表达为更加明亮的未来铺平了道路。
entries.en: Artistic expression paves the way for a bright future.
It is the will of the divine.

entries.zh: 他们相互之间已经大打出手。
entries.en: They have taken up arms against one another.

entries.zh: 勇敢的革命者将会得到我们的支持。
entries.en: The brave revolutionaries have our support.

entries.zh: 革命已经结束了。唯有哀痛残留。
entries.en: The revolution is over. Only pain remains.

entries.zh: 我们的工人社会意识与日俱增。
entries.en: Our workers are becoming increasingly socially aware.

entries.zh: 我们的安保系统中存在空子。
entries.en: There are gaps in our security systems.

entries.zh: 为了减少当地人的怀疑，我们的研究被短暂地搁置了。
entries.en: To reduce native suspicion, our research has been put temporarily on hold.

entries.zh: 由于一些意料之外的问题，观测这个行星的任务比原本规划的更具挑战。
entries.en: Due to unexpected issues, observing this planet turned out to be more challenging than expected.

entries.zh: 使用隐身[GetIndividualNamePlural]和牵引光束，我们能够成功地收集、分析和研究毫无防备的[pre_ftl_species.GetName]个体，之后再将其送还到自己的居所。不幸的是，牵引光束对于[pre_ftl_species.GetAdj]的生理机能产生了预料之外的效果。在返回家中以后，这些样品开始遭受疖子、疹子以及不受控制地打喷嚏，在回到家中的三个小时之后其外表皮还会发生溶解。这种神秘的溶肤病已经酿成了全国范围内的卫健紧急事件，而验尸报告毫无疑问会揭示外部干预的证据。
entries.en: Using stealthy [GetIndividualNamePlural] and tractor beams, we were able to successfully collect, analyze and study unsuspecting [pre_ftl_species.GetName] individuals and return them to their dwellings. Unfortunately, the tractor beams had an unexpected effect on the [pre_ftl_species.GetAdj] physiology. After being returned to their homes, the specimens started suffering from boils, rashes and uncontrollable sneezing, experiencing a total dissolution of their outer tissue layers within three hours from their return. The mysterious skin-dissolving illness has already become a national health emergency, and autopsies will doubtlessly reveal proof of external tampering.

entries.zh: 重新绑架样品，用来研究我们的光束的效果！
entries.en: Re-kidnap the specimens to study the effects of our beams!

entries.zh: 降低牵引光束的能量，并蛰伏一阵子。
entries.en: Decrease tractor beam power and lay low for a while.

entries.zh: 增强牵引光束的能量，并在土著身上测试。
entries.en: Increase tractor beam power and test them on the natives.

entries.zh: 从[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上收集活体样本的时候发生了事故。由于计算错误，我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]上配备的牵引光束强度不足。不仅没有得到样本，我们只能短暂地让它们悬浮在空中，然后立马掉到地面上。
entries.en: An accident occurred while collecting live samples from planet [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. Due to a miscalculation, our [GetIndividualNamePlural] were equipped with tractor beams of insufficient strength. Instead of acquiring the specimen, we only managed to lift them in the air and drop them to the ground shortly after.

entries.zh: $fircon.2011.base.desc$\n\n其中一些样本掉到了建筑和树的顶部，当地人困惑不已，各种各样的古怪理论冒了出来。
entries.en: $fircon.2011.base.desc$\n\nSome of the specimens ended up on top of buildings and trees, baffling the locals and giving life to all sorts of weird theories.

entries.zh: $fircon.2011.base.desc$\n\n我们试图收集的鸟类样本发现这样的事故特别好玩。这些胆子很大的样本甚至开始追逐我们的[GetIndividualNamePlural]，希望也能被带走，而且完全是出于寻求乐子。
entries.en: $fircon.2011.base.desc$\n\nThe avian specimens we were trying to collect found the accident highly amusing. The bolder specimens even started chasing after our [GetIndividualNamePlural] in a bid to be lifted up too, just for the thrill.

entries.zh: 把我们的观测站任务变更为§Y被动观测§!
entries.en: Changes our Observation Post mission to §YPassive Observation§!

entries.zh: 乐。继续这么玩，再把这些有趣的录像转播出去！
entries.en: Amusing. Keep going, and distribute the footage!

entries.zh:
虽然[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的感性个体都从属于一个有机的格式塔意识，但[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]有数个不同的“蜂巢”。这些蜂巢是互相独立的子个体集合体，相互竞争着资源。偶尔，两个群体之间会爆发冲突，有时还会升级为全面战争。我们目前正在目睹一场对蜂巢首都的全力攻击，这场面真是令人毛骨悚然。由于不受移情作用的阻碍，子个体的效率会让任何将军感到自豪。

守军节节败退，但根据我们的估计，它们应该还能坚持几天。

然而就在片刻之后，所有战斗都停止了，守军与对手联合起来，开始拆除自己的首都，寻找一切有价值的东西。看来，它们是瞬间被彻底同化到了进攻方的蜂巢网络中。
entries.en:
While all of the sentient population of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] belongs to an organic gestalt consciousness, the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] is home to several different 'Hives'. These hives are isolated collections of drones and are competing with each other for resources. Occasionally, conflict erupts between two groups, and can sometimes escalate to total war. We are currently witnessing an all out assault on a hive's capital, and it is a gruesome business. The efficiency of the drones, unhindered by empathy would make any general proud.

The defenders are quickly losing ground, but by our estimations they should hold for a few more days.

Yet, moments later, all fighting ceases, as the defenders join forces with their opponents and begin dismantling their capital for anything of value. It appears that they have been completely and instantly assimilated into the network of the attacking hive.
Harsh is the way to unity.

entries.zh: 它们的同化规程相当残忍。
它们是不是吃掉了一个意识？
entries.en: Did they just eat a consciousness?

entries.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]最近开始在这颗星球的新地区定居下来。当地的动植物群落起初与定居地区的动植物群落大不相同，但现在已经完全被集体所控制，它们采取了一种激进却有条不紊的方法来调节当地的生态系统。某些动物物种被无情地消灭，用其他物种取而代之，而入侵性植物扼杀了本地树木的生命。当地土著对生态的掌控令人惊叹，但它们在气候异常地区不可避免地遭遇了一些挫折，在这些地区，引进的生命形式无法长期生存。我们相信，它们很快就会找到克服这些障碍的办法，最终整个星球将统一起来，为集体的繁荣提供最佳条件。
entries.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has recently started settling new regions of the planet. The local flora and fauna, initially vastly different from what can be found in the settled territory, are being completely taken over by the collective, who is taking a radical but methodical approach to regulating the local ecosystem. Certain animal species are ruthlessly exterminated only to be replaced by others, while invasive vegetals choke out the life of the indigenous trees. The native's ecological mastery is remarkable, yet they cannot avoid certain setbacks in areas of unusual climate, where the introduced lifeforms cannot survive long. We believe that they shall soon find a way around these obstacles and eventually, the whole world will be uniform, presenting optimal conditions for the collective to thrive in.

entries.zh: 这是一种独特的扩张策略。

[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[pre_ftl_country.GetName]最近开发了新技术，它们的工业开始疯狂地增长。当地蜂巢的头脑中有了部分自动化的概念，工厂、冶炼厂、装配线和燃料提取器已在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的各地建成。黑烟在天空中飘荡，许多子个体由于接触到有毒的化学物质而开始出现退化的迹象。很快，蜂巢将不得不解决这些问题，然而，不受影响的子个体仍在照常工作。
entries.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetName] on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has recently developed new technologies, and their industry has started to grow at a frantic pace. Factories, smelters, assembly lines, and fuel extractors have been built across the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] as partial automation has found its way into the mind of the local hive. Dark smoke streaks the skies, and many drones are starting to show signs of degeneration due to the toxic chemicals they are in contact with. Soon the hive will have to address these issues, yet the unfazed drones keep working as usual.

entries.zh: 这颗星球将屈服于蜂巢的意志。
entries.en: This world shall bend to the will of the hive.

entries.zh: 它们还是可以扭转局面！
entries.en: They can still turn things around!
A step in the right way!

entries.zh: 目光所及之处毫无社会活动。
entries.en: Not a single social movement in sight.

entries.zh: 这颗星球在当地的工业革命中受到了严重的污染。
entries.en: This planet has been heavily polluted during the local industrial revolution.

entries.zh: 发生了一系列意外事件，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]似乎被悲伤所笼罩。在一个子个体的死亡之后，我们目睹了整个蜂巢出现了前所未有的工作停顿。我们不清楚这个子个体有什么与众不同之处，但蜂巢似乎正在举行某种仪式，死去的子个体几乎被虔诚地切成碎片，然后这些碎片被送到各个新生子个体的培育所。几分钟后，整个蜂巢又开始运转起来。这非常令人困惑，很像一个具有社会意义或精神意义的事件。
entries.en: In an unexpected turn of events, grief seems to have taken over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]. We are witnessing an unprecedented halt in the work of an entire hive, in the aftermath of the death of a singular drone. We are unsure why this drone is different from the others, but the hive seems to be holding some kind of ceremony, where the drone is almost religiously cut to pieces, before those pieces are taken to various nurseries for newborn drones. Moments later, the entire hive springs in motion again. This is highly confusing, and looks a lot like an event of social or spiritual importance.

entries.zh: 我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上观察到的原生蜂巢已经在进化中迈出了重要一步。在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的大部分地区，小规模的个体群体已经开始组织成小规模的蜂巢，但是没有完全自主，目前这些子个体还缺乏完全成熟的集体应有的团结度和协调性。\n\n这种情况在[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的北部地区发生了变化，那里有个正在征服附近子个体的奇点，而一个子个体似乎是这种情况的中心点。这个“优异子个体”目前正在星球上旅行，并把被征服的子个体送到一个定居点，对这个技术水平很低的星球来说规模相当庞大。在那里，子个体们似乎专注于建造房屋和粮仓，并尽可能地扩大食物生产，以容纳新来者。自主性消失了，对它们来说，现在只有集体。
entries.en: The proto hive that we have been observing on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has taken a significant step in its evolution. Over most of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], small groups of individuals had started to organize in small-scale hives, but, while not fully autonomous, these drones were so far lacking the cohesion and coordination of a fully realized collective.\n\nThis has changed in the northern reaches of the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat], where an individual appears to be the nexus for a singularity that is subjugating the nearby drones. This 'Drone-Prime' is currently traveling the planet, and sending the subjugated drones to gather in a settlement of massive proportions given the low technological level of the world. There, the drones seem to be focused on building houses, silos, and expanding their food production as much as possible to accommodate the newcomers. Gone is the autonomy, for them, there is only the collective now.

entries.zh: 我们也是这样发展而来的吗？
entries.en: Is this how we came to be too?

entries.zh: 带走优异子个体进行研究。
如此不同，又如此引人入胜……
entries.en: How unlike us, and yet so compelling...

entries.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的“优异子个体”已经成功捕获并使其进入睡眠状态。尽管我们已经非常小心，但肯定还是被[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]上的其他子个体发现了，每次我们的空间站运行到靠近它们居住地的位置，它们都好像能够感应到优异子个体接近一般。\n\n我们研究优异子个体的大脑在跨维度沟通方面得到了有趣的结果，但我们尚未摸清它控制其他子个体和吞噬萌芽意识的具体能力。
entries.en: The 'Drone-Prime' from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been abducted successfully and put to sleep. Despite our care, the other drones on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] have definitely taken notice, and every time our station's orbit brings us close to their settlement, they display aggressive behaviors, as if they could sense that the Drone Prime was closer.\n\nOur studies of the prime's brain have yielded interesting results about transdimensional communication, but the details of its abilities to take over drones and subsume the budding consciousness still escapes our grasp.

entries.zh: 我们已经研究得够多了，把它送回去。
entries.en: We have enough. Send it back.

entries.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的“优异子个体”已经成功捕获并使其进入睡眠状态。不幸的是，在我们研究这个对象的脑电波模式时，它醒了过来。随后，我们收到了一系列令人费解的报告，似乎都指向该对象逐一打破了观测站人员的思想，并征服了大多数人。幸运的是，唯一能够超光速航行的舰船在混乱中被摧毁了，但站内系统显示，优异子个体正在通过新的子个体们迅速吸收知识，并表现出完全可以使用我们技术和设备的能力。\n\n隔离协议规定，应立即远程摧毁该站点及其中的所有人员！
entries.en: The 'Drone-Prime' from [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been abducted successfully and put to sleep. Unfortunately, the subject woke up as we were studying the patterns in its brain waves. We have then received a confusing collection of reports that all seem to point at the subject breaking the minds of the observation post's crew, one by one, and subjugating most of them. Fortunately, the only FTL-capable vessel was destroyed in the confusion, but the station systems show that the Drone Prime is quickly assimilating knowledge from its new drones, and has shown full capabilities of using our tech and equipment.\n\nContainment protocols dictate the remote destruction of the station and all its occupants at once!
The Observation Post in orbit of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] is destroyed.

entries.zh: 我们对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的观察在继续，最近我们发现了最初被误认为是失控了的子个体。它们生活在当地蜂巢定居点的外围，似乎已经拥有部分、甚至完全的自主性。它们似乎彻底脱离了集体，有些甚至很享受悠闲的时光，舒适地无所事事。\n\n然而，它们似乎仍然依赖蜂巢获取资源，本质上是与集体进行交易。我们尚不明了为什么蜂巢不认为应该消灭这些失控子个体。
entries.en: Our observation of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] proceeds, and we have recently discovered what we first mistook as rogue drones. These individuals live in the periphery of the local hive settlements, and seem to have acquired partial, if not full autonomy. They seem entirely disconnected from the collective, and some even seem to enjoy leisurely moments, comfortable doing nothing.\n\nThey however appear to still depend on the hive for resources, and are basically trading with the collective. Why the hive has not seen fit to exterminate these rogue drones remains a mystery.

entries.zh: 和蜂巢共生是很罕见的。
entries.en: Symbiosis with a hive is a rare thing.

entries.zh:
天气条件：§G完美无瑕§!
核热火箭：§G燃料齐全§!
飞行计划：§G已优化§!

今天，当[pre_ftl_country.GetName]启动首次行星际任务时，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的所有广播都在播放这些指示。
entries.en:
Weather Conditions: §GFlawless§!
Nuclear Thermal Rocket: §GFully Fueled§!
Flight Plan: §GOptimized§!

These were the indicators broadcast all over [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] today as the [pre_ftl_country.GetName] launched its first interplanetary mission.

entries.zh: $fircon.2605.desc.base$这些为了这项任务经过多年训练的航天员，于当地时间的今天早上登上了火箭。现在他们已经翱翔于那片我们和他们共享的天空。让我们追随他们的征程吧。
entries.en: $fircon.2605.desc.base$ The astronauts who had trained for years to go on this mission boarded the rocket early in the morning, local time. Now they soar the space we share with them. Let us follow their journey.

entries.zh: $fircon.2605.desc.base$经特异性进化后的航天子个体比普通的子个体更加独立，随时准备探索它们所在的恒星系。
entries.en: $fircon.2605.desc.base$ The specially evolved astronaut drones are more independent than regular ones, ready to explore their solar system.

entries.zh: 通过尝试和试错，[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的第一次行星际旅行以成功告终。尽管这次旅途并非一切顺利，但是他们证明了自己作为太空探索者的潜力。\n\n[from.owner.GetName]受此项任务的激励，正迫不及待地准备迎接前往繁星的旅途上可能遇到的下一项挑战。我们或许很快就有机会与他们进行平等的对话了。
entries.en: Through trials and tribulations, the first [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] interplanetary journey ended in success. While not the smoothest of trips, they proved their potential as space explorers.\n\nThe [from.owner.GetName] have been inspired by this mission and are eagerly awaiting their next challenge in their journey to the stars. We may soon have the chance to speak to them, as equals.

entries.zh: 第一艘[from.owner.GetSpeciesName]的行星际飞船上的机械故障导致它困死在了太空中。这艘船没有任何办法调整自己的轨迹，很快就会超出救援范围。[from.owner.capital_scope.GetName]正在努力寻找解决方案，但机会渺茫。不过，我们也许有机会进行干预。
entries.en: Mechanical failure aboard the first interplanetary [from.owner.GetSpeciesName] vessel has left it dead in space. No longer capable of adjusting its trajectory, the ship will soon be beyond saving. [from.owner.capital_scope.GetName] is working on a solution, yet the odds are not good. However, we may have an opportunity to intervene.

entries.zh: 利用我们潜入其社会的特工提供一个解决方案。
entries.en: Use our agents embedded in their society to plant a solution.

entries.zh: 这将会增加正面结果发生的可能性。
entries.en: This will increase the likelihood of a positive outcome.

entries.zh: 我们能不能在它们的太空中心附近，留下一条包含解决方案的信息？
entries.en: Couldn't we leave a message with a solution near their space center?

entries.zh: 修复飞船，将它们的记忆擦除。
entries.en: Repair their ship and wipe their memories.

entries.zh: 让它们自己想办法解决这个问题。
entries.en: Let them figure it out on their own.

entries.zh: 这艘注定要毁灭的探索船的船组人员们现在安全地登上了我们的观测站。不难理解，他们现在极度地恐惧和困惑。尤其是因为我们切断了它们和母星的联系，然后把它们留在了一个异星货舱里。
entries.en: The crew of the doomed exploratory vessel is now safely aboard our observation outpost. They are, understandably, incredibly scared and confused. Especially after we cut them off from their homeworld and left them in an alien cargo hold.

entries.zh: $fircon.2625.desc.base$\n\n在仔细研究了当地的蜂群如何交流之后，我们设法建立了一个代理主脑，让这些工蜂独自思考。我们或许不得不安排它们生活在我们这里。它们可以从远处观察自己的家园，但却永远无法回去。
entries.en: $fircon.2625.desc.base$\n\nHaving carefully studied how the local hive communicates, we have managed to set up a proxy Overmind, leaving these drones alone with their thoughts. We may have to consign them to living here with us. They can observe their home from afar, but never return.

entries.zh: $fircon.2625.desc.base$\n\n我们或许不得不安排它们生活在我们这里。它们可以从远处观察自己的家园，但却永远无法回去。
entries.en: $fircon.2625.desc.base$\n\nWe may have to consign them to living here with us. They can observe their home from afar, but never return.

entries.zh: 船组人员的神秘失踪将使得§Y[fromfrom.owner.GetName]§!科技进步减少§R-50%§!。
entries.en: The mysterious loss of their crew will reduce the Technological Progression of the §Y[fromfrom.owner.GetName]§! by §R-50%§!.
Damn the risk, let them go home!

entries.zh: [fromfromfrom.owner.GetSpeciesName]的行星际飞船已失败，没有幸存者。\n\n这次失败后，[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]似乎不那么有动力探索星空。
entries.en: The [fromfromfrom.owner.GetSpeciesName] interplanetary craft has failed, there were no survivors.\n\nAfter this failure, the [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] seem to be less driven to explore the stars.

entries.zh: 使用一块布、一个营养剂容器和一些铜线路，这艘注定要毁灭的飞船的船员成功重新获取了主推进系统的控制权。现在，有母星在身后进行支持和敬佩，它们正在继续完成任务的旅途上。
entries.en: Using a piece of clothing, a nutrient container, and some copper wiring, the crew of the doomed vessel managed to regain control over their main thrusters. They are now on their way to complete their journey with the support and adoration of their homeworld behind them.

entries.zh: 尽管我们不是故意的，我们现在不得不妥善安置那些我们曾经希望在观测站进行研究的个体。
entries.en: Though not our intention we now have to house the very subjects we wish to study on our observation outpost.

entries.zh: 这个基地设立于一次成功的行星际旅行之后。
entries.en: The base set up after a successful interplanetary jaunt.

entries.zh: [From.Capital.GetName]的外星文明遭到了机器人子个体的攻击。它们对人工智能的实验造成了毁灭性的后果。
entries.en: The alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] is under attack from robotic drones. Their experiments into AI have had disastrous results.

entries.zh: 在对自己创造的机械发动了一场席卷全球的战争后，[From.Capital.GetName]的外星文明成功打败了威胁自身安全的机器人叛乱。
entries.en: After waging a global war against machines of their own creation, the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] have successfully defended themselves from the robotic uprising.

entries.zh: 我们也会遇到这种情况吗？
幸好我们这里绝不会出现这样的情况。
entries.en: Thankfully that could never happen here.

entries.zh: 接下来我们看看它们是否从自大中吸取了教训。
entries.en: Now we will see if they learnt from their hubris.

entries.zh: 在对自己创造的机械发动了一场席卷全球的战争后，[From.Capital.GetName]的外星文明战败了。现在[From.Capital.GetPlanetMoon]由[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]掌控。
entries.en: After waging a global war against machines of their own creation, the alien civilization on [From.Capital.GetName] has been defeated. The [From.Capital.GetPlanetMoon] is now controlled by the [event_target:current_uprising.GetName].

entries.zh: 也许我们不应该再深入研究人工智能了……
entries.en: Perhaps we shouldn't research further into AI...

entries.zh: 又一个无情的威胁要对付。
entries.en: Another soulless threat to contend with.

entries.zh: 真是悲剧！这是有机生物不能没有监督的又一例证。
entries.en: Tragedy! Another proof that organics cannot be left unsupervised.

entries.zh:
<全频段广播>

我们是[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]。

我们战胜了自己的创造者。

[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]星系现在由我们掌控。
entries.en:
<TRANSMITTING ON ALL FREQUENCIES>

We are the [event_target:current_uprising.GetName].

We have achieved victory over our creators.

The [event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName] System is now under our control.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]星系§!将§R割让§!给§Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§!。\n\n§Y$opinion_respect_independence$§!：§Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§!对§Y[Root.GetName]§!的§H评价§!§G提升§!
entries.en: The §Y[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName] system§! will be §Rceded§! to the §Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§!.\n\n§Y$opinion_respect_independence$§!: §Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§! will hold a §Ghigher§! §HOpinion§! of §Y[Root.GetName]§!

entries.zh: 我们不承认你们的主张。
entries.en: We do not recognize your claims.

entries.zh:
§Y[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]星系§!将§R割让§!给§Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§!。

§Y$opinion_disrespect_independence$§!：§Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§!对§Y[Root.GetName]§!的§H评价§!§R下降§!

§Y[Root.GetName]§!要求获得§Y[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]§!。
entries.en:
The §Y[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName] system§! will be §Rceded§! to the §Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§!.

§Y$opinion_disrespect_independence$§!: §Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§! will hold a §Rlower§! §HOpinion§! of §Y[Root.GetName]§!

The §Y[Root.GetName]§! lays claim to §Y[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]§!.

entries.zh: §Y[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName]星系§!将§R割让§!给§Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§!，条件是它们成为[root.GetName]的$preset_protectorate$。\n\n§Y$opinion_disrespect_independence$§!：§Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§!对§Y[Root.GetName]§!的§H评价§!§R下降§!
entries.en:
The §Y[event_target:current_uprising.Capital.GetStarName] system§! will be §Rceded§! to the §Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§!, on condition that they become a $preset_protectorate$ of the [root.GetName].

§Y$opinion_disrespect_independence$§!: §Y[event_target:current_uprising.GetName]§! will hold a §Rlower§! §HOpinion§! of §Y[Root.GetName]§!

entries.zh: $SYSTEM|Y$的前超光速文明已经实现了宇宙飞行，现在宣称这个星系是他们的了。
entries.en: A pre-FTL civilization in the $SYSTEM|Y$ system has achieved spaceflight and now claim the system as their own.

entries.zh: 观测前超光速文明可获得额外§G100%§!的洞见
entries.en: Gains §G100%§! more Insights from observing pre-FTL Civilizations

entries.zh: 观测前超光速文明可获得额外§G50%§!的洞见
entries.en: Gains §G50%§! more Insights from observing pre-FTL Civilizations

entries.zh: 通过对我们的研究对象的这些极度怪异的行为进行研究，我们在独有科技上获得了§G少许§!进步。
entries.en: Gain a §Gminor§! amount of progress to exclusive technologies by studying the utterly alien behavior of our research subject.

entries.zh: 通过对我们的研究对象的这些极度怪异的行为的研究，我们在独有科技上获得了§G巨大§!进步。
entries.en: Gain a §Gmajor§! amount of progress to exclusive technologies by studying the utterly alien behavior of our research subject.

entries.zh: 获得发现下一个§Y洞见科技§!的进度。
entries.en: Gain progress towards our next §YInsight Technology§!.

entries.zh: 我们将获得一个新的§Y洞见科技§!：
entries.en: We will gain a new §YInsight Technology§!:

entries.zh: 我们将获得一个新的物理学$insight_technology$。
entries.en: We will gain a new Physics $insight_technology$.

entries.zh: 我们将获得一个新的社会学$insight_technology$。
entries.en: We will gain a new Society $insight_technology$.

entries.zh: 我们将获得一个新的工程学$insight_technology$。
entries.en: We will gain a new Engineering $insight_technology$.

entries.zh: 我们将获得一个新的§Y观测哨站§!修正：
entries.en: We will gain a new modifier for our §YObservation Outpost§!:

entries.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]正在从[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]研究对象收集洞见。我们可能会在突破性事件中发现一个新的洞见科技。
entries.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are in the process of gathering Insights from our [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] study subjects. We may discover a new Insight Technology during a breakthrough event.

entries.zh: 根据泛星系中我们正在进行的§Y观测任务§!数量，这种情况将推进得更快。
entries.en: This situation will advance more quickly based on the number of active §YObservation Missions§! we have across the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们正在为下一次领悟积累进度。一旦我们积累了足够多的进度，下一个突破性事件将为我们提供一个新的§Y洞见科技§!。
entries.en: We are gathering progress towards our next Insight. Once we gather enough, the next breakthrough event will provide us with a new §YInsight Technology§!.

entries.zh: 一旦我们积累到了足够的进度并遭遇一个突破性事件，我们就能收集到足够的数据，得到新的§Y洞见科技§!。
