entries.en: Once we gather enough Insights and encounter a breakthrough event, we will have collected enough data for a new §YInsight Technology§!.

entries.zh: 我们正在从各个[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]星球积极收集洞见线索。
entries.en: We are actively gathering Insights from [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] worlds.

entries.zh: 我们正在将更多的资金投入到获取洞见中，影响了我们的观测任务。
entries.en: We are investing more into gaining Insights at the cost of our Observation Missions.

entries.zh: 我们正在将更多的资金投入到观测任务中，影响了我们的领悟。
entries.en: We are investing more into our Observation Missions at the cost of our Insights.

entries.zh: 我们已经收集到了足够的信息来创造新的§S洞见科技§!以进行进一步探索。下一次我们拥有一项能够推进洞见的观察事件，会获得一个新的研究选项。
entries.en: We have gathered enough information to create a new §SInsight Technology§! to explore further. The next time we have an observation event that would advance our Insight, we will gain a new Research Option.

entries.zh: §R§Y[pre_ftl_country.GetName]§!会不信任我们，在一段时间内拒绝与我们沟通。§!
entries.en: §R§Y[pre_ftl_country.GetName]§! will distrust us and refuse to communicate for a time.§!

entries.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName]担心穴居人可能会发动一场入侵。这样的担忧是毫无根据的，但是提供额外的部队能够帮助我们赢取他们的信任。
entries.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesName] are worried about a possible subterranean invasion. It's a baseless fear, but providing additional troops will help us gain their trust.

entries.zh: 尽管武器简陋，但它们精通地下战斗，并以不屈的意志保卫自己的家园，因而成为了强大的防御者。
entries.en: Though armed with crude weapons, their mastery of subterranean warfare and unyielding resolve make them formidable defenders of their homeland.

entries.zh: 这颗行星上的居民不信任我们。
entries.en: The inhabitants of this planet don't trust us.

entries.zh: 这个文明不会参与外交。
entries.en: This civilization won't engage in diplomacy.

entries.zh: 即使在会面之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]依然拒绝接受外星人存在的事实。他们宣称我们并非星际访客，而是穴居人，想要从地上的某个洞穴里面钻出来占领行星的地面。他们的行星，[non_believers_planet.GetName]，被认为是中空的，并且他们坚信我们使用自己的宇宙飞船在中央的空穴中飞来飞去。\n\n这些令人困惑的信仰阻碍了我们的外交工作。任何我们说的或者做的都遭到了彻底的怀疑。
entries.en: Even after meeting us, the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] refuse to accept the existence of extraterrestrial life. They claim we're not interstellar visitors, but subterranean dwellers who climbed to the planet's surface through a hole in the ground. Their planet, [non_believers_planet.GetName], is thought to be hollow, and they believe we fly inside this central cavity using our spaceships.\n\nThese baffling beliefs are hindering our diplomatic efforts. Everything we say or do is met with the utmost suspicion.

entries.zh: $fircon.6000.desc$。\n\n虽然事实上就是他们错了，但是解释只会让局势变得进一步复杂。
entries.en: $fircon.6000.desc$.\n\nWhile technically they're not wrong, explaining the matter would only complicate things further.

entries.zh: 将他们最偏激的怀疑论者带到太空。
entries.en: Bring their most influential skeptics to space.

entries.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]才不是中空的！给他们看计算结果！
entries.en: [non_believers_planet.GetName] is not hollow! Show them the calculations!

entries.zh: 承认我们就是地底入侵者。
结果[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]并不相信太空，或者说：他们认为天空是一块镶嵌着镜子的穹顶，群星是太阳光束折射到镜子上形成的，其他天体同理。\n\n哪怕我们将他们带到了我们的首都，他们可能也会宣称自己从未离开过母星，或者其他同样离谱的事情。
entries.en: Turns out the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't believe in space, either: they think the sky is a glass dome filled with mirrors: stars are rays of sunlight reflected from the mirrors, as are the other celestial bodies.\n\nEven if we were to bring them to our capital, they would probably claim they had never left their home planet, or something equally absurd.
There must be a way to sway them...

entries.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来纷乱的新闻：尽管[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]不再认为我们是来自他们[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]地底中心的访客，他们现在坚信自己的星球是平的，像我们这样的人是住在吊篮一样的城市里，位于[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地壳下面。
entries.en: Mixed news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: while the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] don't think we are visitors from the center of their [non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon] anymore, they are now convinced their world is flat, and people like us live on hanging cities beneath [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s crust.

entries.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]出于我们的诚实向我们表达感谢。当然他们尚未完全相信我们，因为他们认为我们是来自中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的入侵者，但是至少他们理解我们没有敌意，希望他们能同我们开展合作。
entries.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] thank us for our honesty. Of course they can't fully trust us yet, since they still believe we are invaders from the Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], but at least they understand we wish them no harm and are looking forward to collaborating with us.

entries.zh: 在下定决心认为我们是中空的[non_believers_planet.GetName]的秘密住民之后，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始担忧[non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]的地表之下到底还藏着什么东西。军队开始在洞穴、喷泉和火山口的附近驻扎，随时准备用武力对抗任何从地下涌现出来的入侵者。
entries.en: After having determined we are the secret inhabitants of Hollow [non_believers_planet.GetName], the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have started worrying about what else may be lurking under the surface of [non_believers_planet.GetPlanetMoon]. Military forces have been stationed near caves, faults and volcanoes, poised to meet any further underground invaders with force.

entries.zh: 一起玩呗。给他们提供军事支援。
entries.en: Play along. Offer them military support.

entries.zh: [non_believers_planet.GetName]传来难以置信的消息：真的有人藏在地表之下。属于某个先前未知物种的地下军队从洞穴里面涌现了出来，他们正在进攻[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。这是一场全面的入侵！
entries.en: Incredible news from [non_believers_planet.GetName]: someone really was hiding under the surface! Subterranean armies of a previously unknown species are pouring out of caves, and they're attacking the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It's a full-scale invasion!

entries.zh: 在经历了一场残酷的世界大战之后，[non_believers_country.GetName]被住在[non_believers_planet.GetName]地表下面的穴居物种彻底消灭。新近成为主导的物种注意到了我们的存在，出于某种混乱的好运，他们显然没有认为我们是来自他们行星的中心。
entries.en: After a vicious world war, the [non_believers_country.GetName] has been annihilated by the subterranean race living under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface. The newly dominant species is aware of our presence, and in something of a mixed blessing, obviously does not believe we come from the center of their planet.

entries.zh: 终于，新邻居能够讲道理了。
[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]有理由感到害怕：尽管这颗行星的核心不是任何地下物种的家园，但是熔融的核心结果是十分危险的。
entries.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] were right to be afraid: while not home to any underground race, the molten core of their planet has proven dangerous enough.

entries.zh: 某个表面看上去已经死寂的火山突然喷发，摧毁了这个区域的基础设施。然而，幸亏我们的军队就出现在事发点附近，大多数受灾群众都被安全地撤离。
entries.en: The sudden eruption of a seemingly extinct volcano was devastating to the region's infrastructure. However, thanks to our military presence near the scene, most of the affected population was evacuated safely.

entries.zh: 某个表面看上去已经死寂的火山突然喷发，正在摧毁一切，[non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]绝望地寻求帮助。
entries.en: The sudden eruption of a seemingly extinct volcano was devastating, and the [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are desperate for help.

entries.zh: 至少他们现在信任我们了。
entries.en: At least they trust us now.

entries.zh: 地底入侵防御部队的士兵驻扎在最大的洞穴和火山口旁边，他们报告称完全没有任何东西从地表下面冒出来。或许这是最好的情况，但是其中一些士兵明显十分失望。
entries.en: The Subterranean Invasion Defense Force troops stationed near the biggest caves and volcanoes report that absolutely nothing has emerged from beneath the surface. It's probably for the best, although some of the soldiers look visibly disappointed.

entries.zh: [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]希望向我们表达感谢，以及正式的道歉。他们现在明白我们，事实上，并不是地底穴居人，而是来自另一个地方，那里是：
entries.en: The [non_believers_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] would like to offer us their thanks, as well as an official apology. They now understand we are not, in fact, subterranean dwellers, but we come from another place entirely:

entries.zh: 他们对于宇宙奥妙的掌握还是不够完美，但至少他们准备相信我们了。
entries.en: Their grasp of cosmology is still less than perfect, but at least now they are ready to trust us.

entries.zh: 从社会学角度来看，很有趣；从精神上来看，真是精疲力竭的体验。
entries.en: A sociologically interesting but mentally exhausting experience.

entries.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，我们的联合部队战胜了地底入侵者，将他们赶回了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
entries.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, our combined forces triumphed over the subterranean invaders, forcing them back under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

entries.zh: 经过一场漫长的、难解难分的战斗，[non_believers_country.GetName]迫使地底入侵者撤退回到了[non_believers_planet.GetName]的地表之下！
entries.en: After a long, hard-fought battle, the [non_believers_country.GetName] forced the subterranean invaders to retreat under [non_believers_planet.GetName]'s surface!

entries.zh: 今天，§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上传来了令人意想不到的消息，一张熟悉的面容向我们问好：那是一张我们自己的脸。\n\n最近，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj]似乎迷上了我们的外表。我们的[Species.GetEarNamePlural]似乎让他们联想到了他们的幼体。事实上，他们形容我们非常“可爱”。一种长着夸张[Species.GetEarNamePlural]的填充玩具在他们的城市里已经成了一等一的抢手货。
entries.en: Unexpected news from §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! today as a familiar face greets us: our own.\n\nRecently, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesAdj] have become captivated by our form. Something about our [Species.GetEarNamePlural] seems to remind them of their young. In fact, they say that we are 'Cute.' Already, stuffed toys with exaggerated [Species.GetEarNamePlural] have become a wide-spread commodity in their cities.

entries.zh: 但是——嗯——我们不——没有人曾经……
entries.en: But- um- a- we are not- no one has ever...

entries.zh: 我们……我们能拥有一个吗？
对任何使用我们形象的东西都要征收版税。
entries.en: We will impose royalties on any use of our likeness.

entries.zh: §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!上正在发生有趣的社会变革。\n\n由于他们只有我们作为参考，那里的人们开始相信宇宙中的所有生命都像我们一样：互相连接、合而为一。在别无其他参照的情况下，[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]急切地希望我们的[root.GetIndividualNamePlural]能进入他们的机构。他们的误解给予我们提升他们文明的良机。然而，如果得知了外面世界的真相（包括非格式塔物种的存在），他们必定会降低对我们的信任。
entries.en: Intriguing sociological changes are taking place on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!.\n\nGiven they have only ourselves as a reference, the people there have come to believe that all life in the universe must be as we are: connected. One. Without another frame of reference, the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are more than willing to allow our [root.GetIndividualNamePlural] access to their institutions. Their misunderstanding could enable us to advance their civilization considerably. However, if the truth about the wider galaxy (and the existence of non-gestalt species) were to become known, they might become less trusting of us.

entries.zh: 确认。你们是一个个的个体。

entries.en: [pre_ftl_country.GetName] will advance to their next technological age.

entries.zh: [pre_ftl_country.GetName]挺进到新的科技等级的速度要快§G25%§!。
entries.en: [pre_ftl_country.GetName] will advance towards their future technological ages §G25%§! faster.

entries.zh: 告诉他们我们自己还不确定。
entries.en: Tell them we aren't sure ourselves.

entries.zh: 由于我们近期的行动，$COUNTRY|Y$对我们显示出了不信任，因此封锁了外交通道一段时间。
entries.en: Due to our recent actions the $COUNTRY|Y$ has become distrustful of us, blocking diplomacy for a time.
Teach a Hive How to Craft

entries.zh: 我们希望能够促进对蜂巢的教育计划，这一举措取得了成功，我们计划继续教他们一些基本的化学知识。差不多是立刻，他们就推导出了基于这些原理的最具破坏的应用，我们前脚还没离开他们的大气层，后脚他们就开始对邻近的蜂巢发动战争。现在，数以百万计的子个体正在死亡。
entries.en: After the success of our educational initiative with the hive we wish to promote, we proceeded to teach them some basic chemistry. Almost immediately, they extrapolated the most destructive applications of these principles, and started waging war against a neighboring hive before we had even left their atmosphere. Now, millions of drones are dying.

entries.zh: 我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]在§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!进行的任务取得了成功。$fircon.7510.desc.base$
entries.en: Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] were successful with their task on §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!. $fircon.7510.desc.base$

entries.zh: 我们的科学家十分动摇地离开了§Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§!。$fircon.7510.desc.base$
entries.en: Our scientists left §Y[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]§! today in a shaken state. $fircon.7510.desc.base$
That is the nature of progress.

entries.zh: 一个仿照我们形象的填充玩具，使我们充满决心。
entries.en: A stuffed toy made in our likeness. It fills us with determination.

entries.zh: 根据我们同[freeport_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的贸易协议，我们在他们的主要定居点附近建造了一个小型太空港。我们的商人不受规定约束，能够赚取巨额利润，但是禁止离开那片特区。\n\n结果是，走私贩和有组织的帮派建立了一个繁荣的黑市经济。到目前为止，[freeport_species.GetAdj]选择睁一只眼闭一只眼，但是如果任由其发展，这个自由港将不可避免地被犯罪给拖垮。
entries.en: Per our trade agreement with the [freeport_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural], we have established a small spaceport near one of their major settlements. Free from regulation, our merchants are reaping massive profits, but are forbidden of leaving the complex.\n\nAs a result, smugglers and organized gangs have established a thriving black market economy. So far, the [freeport_species.GetAdj] have turned a blind eye, but if things continue, the freeport will inevitably be overrun by criminals.

entries.zh: 要求开放额外的自由港。
我们什么事情都没做错。
对走私贩出硬招，出狠招。
一片专门用于同[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]进行跨星系贸易的区域。
entries.en: An area dedicated to intergalactic trade with [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] countries.

entries.zh: 走私贩在星球上横行无阻。
entries.en: Smugglers are loose all over the planet.

entries.zh: 我们在与[sweet_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的经贸往来中向他们出口一种可口的普通美食，至少对于我们来说是这样的。不过，已经被证实的是，这种普通的甜品对于[sweet_species.GetName]来说居然能产生精神方面的影响。它具有高度成瘾性，而且非常危险。无良的商人们以高价大量出口这种商品，以至于许多当地居民陷入昏迷乃至死亡。
entries.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary food. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerful psychotrope for the [sweet_species.GetName]. It is highly addictive, and extremely dangerous. Unscrupulous merchants have been moving absurd quantities of the product at exorbitant prices. As a result, many of the locals are plunging into stupor, and in the worst cases, death.

entries.zh: 我们在与[sweet_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的经贸往来中向他们出口一种可口的普通矿物香料，至少对于我们来说是这样的。不过，已经被证实的是，这种普通的调味品对于[sweet_species.GetName]来说居然能产生精神方面的影响。它具有高度成瘾性，而且非常危险。无良的商人们以高价大量出口这种商品，以至于许多当地居民陷入昏迷乃至死亡。
entries.en: One of the commodities we have been trading with the [sweet_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] is tasty, but very ordinary mineral-based spice. At least to our species. However, this basic sweetener has proven to be a very powerful psychotrope for the [sweet_species.GetName]. It is highly addictive, and extremely dangerous. Unscrupulous merchants have been moving absurd quantities of the product at exorbitant prices. As a result, many of the locals are plunging into stupor, and in the worst cases, death.

entries.zh: 禁止贸易，设置一道封锁线。
entries.en: Forbid trade and set up a blockade.

entries.zh: 我们必须提供医疗援助！
人命由天。但生意就是生意。
entries.en: People die everyday. Business is business.

entries.zh: 我们调拨了医疗资源，用于治疗[sweet_planet.GetName]上的成瘾病症。
entries.en: We have pledged our medical resources to the treatment of addiction on [sweet_planet.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们调配了资源对[sweet_planet.GetName]实行全域静默，方便打击猖獗的毒品贸易。
entries.en: We have diverted resources to the blockade of [sweet_planet.GetName] to fight the rampant drug trade.

entries.zh: [landgrab_planet.GetName]传来了令人担忧的经济报告，我们的贸易商正在此地同[landgrab_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]进行贸易。当条约签署的时候，我们采取了一些措施来保障当地人的国家主权，但是我们中的一些人绕过法律，从当地的草场人手中购买了大片的土地。以目前的速率，要不了一代人[landgrab_planet.GetName]就会完全被私人贸易商给买空了。
entries.en: Concerning economic reports from [landgrab_planet.GetName], where our merchants have been trading with the [landgrab_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]. When the deal was signed, measures were put in place to ensure the sovereignty of the locals, but some of our own people are skirting the law to buy up vast quantities of land through local strawmen. At the current rate, within a generation [landgrab_planet.GetName] will be wholly owned by private traders.

entries.zh: 撤回这些交易，对罪犯进行罚款。
entries.en: Revoke the sales and fine the culprits.

entries.zh: 一个发财致富的好机会……
这些土地是由外星投资者购买的，土著居民再也无法进入。
entries.en: Purchased by off-world investors, these lands are no longer accessible to the indigenous population.

entries.zh: 这些土地是从土著人口那里获得的，现在在轨道上进行管理。
entries.en: These parcels of land have been acquired from the indigenous population, and are now managed from orbit.

entries.zh: 我们同[fruitful_coop_country.GetName]签署的贸易协定带来了累累硕果。双方都遵守协定条款，贸易正在流通。一些商人呼吁在规章制度方面进一步放宽，但总体来说协定给双方都带来了益处。
entries.en: The trade deal we signed with the [fruitful_coop_country.GetName] has proven extremely lucrative. The terms of the deal are being respected and trade is flowing. Some merchants continue to call for more relaxed regulation, but overall the deal has proven beneficial for both parties.

entries.zh: 或许我们可以重新商议……
正在进行的贸易对当地人群确乎大有好处。
entries.en: The ongoing trade is proving beneficial for the local population.

entries.zh: 对某个[root.GetAAnPreFTLLower]国家施加经济压力果然是有好处的。对我们来说。
entries.en: Applying economic pressure on [root.GetAAnPreFTLLower] [root.GetPreFTLLower] country has proven advantageous. For us.

entries.zh: 我们自[space_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：肆无忌惮的奴隶贩子伪装成商人，正在滥用我们的贸易协定，降落到该星球上大肆绑架当地人。当一大批[space_slavers_species.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]出现在某个地下奴隶贸易市场上的时候，我们才了解到这一行径。
entries.en: Disturbing reports from the [space_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: posing as merchants, unscrupulous slavers have been abusing our Trade Deal to land on the planet and abduct the local population. We only learned of the practice when a large group of [space_slavers_species.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] was listed on an off-grid slave market.

entries.zh: 如果他们想要我们的奴隶，那就得交税。
entries.en: If they want our slaves, there's a tax!

entries.zh: 我们自[preftl_slavers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]收到了令人动摇的报告：在这颗星球的偏远地区，有几个太空旅商，主要是走私贩，连同飞船一起消失了。通过谨慎的调查，我们发现他们被迫在矿井里工作，远离窥探的视线。\n\n令人重视的是，[preftl_slavers_country.GetName]当局并不对此负责，这些事情是由当地的几个军阀和犯罪头子干的，此外所有被绑架的个体都违反了我们同[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]签订的协议。
entries.en: We have received disturbing reports from the [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural]: in remote regions of the planet, several spacefaring merchants, mainly smugglers, have disappeared along with their ships. A discreet investigation revealed that they were pressed into work in the mines, far from view.\n\nIt is important to note that this was not done by the [preftl_slavers_country.GetName] authorities, but rather a few local warlords and criminals, and that all of the abducted individuals were in violation of the treaties we signed with the [GetPreFTLUpperPlural].

entries.zh: 他们得到了他们应得的。
不可接受。保障他们的自由。
[preftl_hagglers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]用行动证明了自己是天生的贸易商。我们自己的商人通过艰难的教训认识到当地人是如此有悟性、能说会道，当然他们对此不是很高兴。\n\n另一方面，我们的数名经济学家相信[GetPreFTLUpperPlural]的这些行为是可以效仿的。
entries.en: The [preftl_hagglers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] have proven to be incredibly adept traders. Our own merchants are learning the hard way that the locals are both savvy and persuasive, and they are not happy about it.\n\nOn the other hand, several of our economists are convinced that the behavior of the [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] could be learned from.

entries.zh: 对[preftl_hagglers_country.GetName]施加以得到更有利的交易。
这名领袖来自一个[Owner.GetPreFTLUpper]国家，在商业方面显示出了极其敏锐的头脑。
entries.en: Coming from a [Owner.GetPreFTLUpper] country, this leader has displayed an exceptionally keen mind for business.

entries.zh: 我们对[preftl_hagglers_country.GetName][GetPreFTLUpperPlural]开展的研究，以及他们侵略性的贸易手段，帮助我们建立了许多令人信服的经济模型。
entries.en: Our studies of the [preftl_hagglers_country.GetName] [GetPreFTLUpperPlural] and their aggressive trading practices have produced some compelling economic models.

entries.zh: 为了促进善意，我们同意与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享我们的物质复制技术。当然，我们希望它们用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但现在我们收到的报告显示，这项技术被武器化了。\n\n居民们有了一个大胆的想法，那就是反转复制单元的功能，这样它就不是组装预编程的物质，而是在原子水平上拆解生命体。
entries.en: To foster good will, we agreed to share our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. Of course, we expected them to use it to reduce resource scarcity, but now we are receiving reports that the technology is being weaponized.\n\nThe inhabitants have arrived at the bold idea of reversing the functionality of a replication unit so rather than assembling pre-programmed matter, the device can now be used to disassemble living beings at the atomic level.

entries.zh: 我们与[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]的居民分享了我们的物质复制技术。它们本来应该用它来缓解资源匮乏的问题，但它们愚蠢地把它武器化了。它们反转了复制单元的功能，开始制造一个可以用来在原子水平上拆解生命体的装置。
entries.en: We shared our matter replication technology with the inhabitants of [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]. They were supposed to use it to reduce resource scarcity. But they're foolishly trying to weaponize it. By crudely reversing the functionality of a replication unit, they have started building a device which can now be used to disassemble living beings at the atomic level.

entries.zh: 没收这项技术，不能相信它们会正确使用它。
entries.en: Confiscate the tech. They cannot be trusted to use it correctly.

entries.zh: 它们决定如何使用这项技术与我们无关。
entries.en: What they choose to do with the tech is not our concern.

entries.zh: 我们的特工到达时，[preftl_misusers_species.GetName]正好在完成它们的手持式原子分解器。我们的人明确告知，赠送物质复制装置不是为了让它们这样使用的。\n\n不出所料，它们不愿意放弃这项技术。当地政府火冒三丈，将我们的没收称作侵略行为。
entries.en: Our agents arrived just as the [preftl_misusers_species.GetName] were finalizing their hand-held atomic disintegrator. They were told in no uncertain terms that this was not the intended use for the matter replication unit we gifted them.\n\nAs expected, they were reluctant to part with the technology. Tempers flared, and the local government has labeled the confiscation an aggressive act.

entries.zh: 通过对我们的物质复制技术进行逆向工程，[preftl_misusers_species.GetName]成功地制造了一个手持式原子分解器，并利用它大肆摧毁[preftl_misusers_planet.GetName]。\n\n在启动进一步的贸易协议之前，我们最好记住它们的毁灭倾向。
entries.en: By reverse engineering our matter replication technology, the [preftl_misusers_species.GetName] have successfully built a hand-held atomic disintegrator, and are using it to wreak havoc upon [preftl_misusers_planet.GetName].\n\nWe'd do well to remember their destructive tendencies before initiating further trade deals.

entries.zh: 这颗行星上的居民以滥用科技而闻名。
entries.en: The inhabitants of this planet have been known to abuse technology.

entries.zh: 他们不同意我们的选择。
他们因我们的信任而尊重我们。
entries.en: They respect us for trusting them.

entries.zh:
从最近一次外交访问[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的[preftl_invasives_species.GetName]返回时，我们发现了一些不寻常的偷渡者。我们的穿梭机上出现了一群无翅的、蠕动的小型节肢动物。

它们移动速度很快，而且很小，我们的传感器无法探测到它们。由于它们繁殖十分迅速，控制它们的入侵变得越来越困难。

不幸的是，对[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的人们来说，这个物种是富足的象征。我们的应对方式可能会影响我们与[preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural]的关系。
entries.en:
When we returned from a recent diplomatic visit with the [preftl_invasives_species.GetName] of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName], we discovered we'd picked up some unusual stowaways. An infestation of small, wingless, wriggling arthropods had found their way aboard our shuttle.

They move fast, and are tiny enough that our sensors can't detect them. Given their rapid breeding, it has become increasingly difficult to contain the invasion.

Unfortunately, the species is a symbol of plenty to the people of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]. How we respond to this could affect our relations with the [preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural].

entries.zh: 通知该星球的统治者，我们要灭掉这些害虫。
entries.en: Inform the planet's rulers that we will be exterminating the infestation.

entries.zh: 悄悄处理掉这一情况，没必要侮辱它们。
entries.en: Deal with this quietly. We need not insult them.

entries.zh: 我们把正在进行中的节肢动物入侵事件告知了[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]的外交官。虽然我们的直率令它们吃惊，但它们最终还是感谢了我们的诚实。\n\n它们为净化过程中的疏忽而道歉，并提供给我们一种经过试验和测试的人道驱虫剂，在[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]很受欢迎。
entries.en: We confronted the [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName] diplomats regarding the ongoing arthropod infestation. While taken aback by our directness, they ultimately appreciated our honesty.\n\nThey apologized for not being more thorough in their decontamination processes, and offered us a tried and tested cruelty free pest repellent, popular on [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName].

entries.zh:
由于不想引起外交争端，我们试图悄悄地处理最近[preftl_invasives_planet.GetName]害虫泛滥的问题。

由于这种生物繁殖快速，并且它们喜好吃非有机物质，这项工作并不轻松。

当我们的外交官穿着被虫蛀得破烂不堪的衣服出现在一个会议上时，[preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural]一眼就知道发生了什么。

它们似乎为这种生物感到尴尬，于是给我们提供了一种人道的驱虫剂。
entries.en:
Not wishing to cause a diplomatic issue, we attempted to quietly deal with the recent infestation of [preftl_invasives_planet.GetName] pests.

This has not been a simple task given the rapid breeding of the creatures, and their penchant for eating through non-organic materials.

When our diplomats turned up to a conference in tattered, bug-eaten attire, the [preftl_invasives_species.GetNamePlural] knew exactly what had happened.

Seemingly embarrassed about introducing the creatures, they provided us with a cruelty-free pest repellent.
We tell it as it is.

entries.zh: [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]震惊地发现，我们的政府组织形式与他们的政府不同。令人难以置信的是，纵观整个行星的历史，当地人从未经历过这种权力结构。显然，人们对于我们是否具备开展有效外交的能力产生了担忧。
entries.en: The [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] were shocked to learn that our government differs from their own. Incredibly, throughout the planet's history, its people have never experienced such a power structure. Obviously, this raises concerns regarding our ability to engage in effective diplomacy.

entries.zh: $fircon.8531.base.desc$\n\n他们不知道民主带给了我们什么样的好处，也不知道自由的真正味道。
entries.en: $fircon.8531.base.desc$\n\nThey know nothing of the benefits that democracy can bring, or the true taste of freedom.

entries.zh: 将我们的三观传授给他们。
$fircon.8531.base.desc$\n\n他们必须了解是什么让我们雄伟和强大的国度如此的雄伟强大。他们尚未品尝过帝国主义的滋味。
entries.en: $fircon.8531.base.desc$\n\nThey must learn what makes our great and powerful domain so great and powerful. They have yet to experience the taste of empire.

entries.zh: $fircon.8531.base.desc$\n\n我们应该将他们从这种愚行中解放出来。独裁政权的滋味将让他们重新放飞自我。
entries.en: $fircon.8531.base.desc$\n\nWe ought to liberate them from such folly. The taste of dictatorship shall set them free.

entries.zh: $fircon.8531.base.desc$\n\n将权力集中在精心挑选的一小部分人手中是统治的唯一方法。他们是如何意识不到这一点的，这真是一个谜。
entries.en: $fircon.8531.base.desc$\n\nConcentrating powers among a select few is the only way to rule. How they have not come to realize this on their own is a true mystery.

entries.zh: 在将我们的政治哲学传授给他们之后，[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]沿袭我们的方式，开始了政体改革。\n\n这些计划正在全球范围内推广，迎来[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]的一个新时代。为了纪念这一政治意义上翻天覆地的巨大变革，新的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]政府举行了一场向我们致敬的游行。
entries.en: After instructing them in our political philosophy, the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] have taken steps towards reforming their government along the lines of our own.\n\nThese initiatives are taking place on a planetary scale, ringing in a new era for the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]. To mark this dramatic political overhaul, the new [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] government held a parade in our honor.

entries.zh:
在学习了我们如何运用权力之后，[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]选择维持[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的现状，认为这才是最好的进步方式。

他们已经宣誓要守住自己的本心，绝不因外部势力的影响而动摇。

外交仍然在继续进行，但毫无疑问，他们不像之前那么信任我们了。
entries.en:
Having learned of our approach to power, the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] maintain that status quo on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName] remains the best way forward.

They have vowed to stand their ground, and not be swayed by external forces.

Diplomacy continues, but there can be no doubt they trust us less.

entries.zh:
相较于向对方施加压力，我们更乐于冷静地向[preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName]上的[preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural]解释我们的政体权力制度背后的相关理论。

他们深深地折服于我们就不同形式政府模式所阐述的观点，对于我们不曾尝试强迫他们服从这一点，他们表示了感激。

双方各自的外交官已经缔结了长期的联系纽带，一同庆祝一场共享的宴会。基于互惠的条款，外交持续推进。
entries.en:
Rather than applying any pressure outright, we calmly explained the theory behind our governing authority to the [preftl_different_flavors_species.GetNamePlural] on [preftl_different_flavors_planet.GetName].

They were intrigued by the insights we provided into alternative styles of government, and were vocal in their appreciation that we made no attempt to force them into compliance.

Our respective diplomats have formed lasting ties, celebrating together over a shared banquet. Diplomacy continues on good terms.

entries.zh: 尊重是一条双向的超空间航道。
entries.en: Respect is a two way hyperlane.

entries.zh: 这些人对自己的过往骄傲不已，牢牢地坚持传统的政府结构。
entries.en: Proud of their past, these people hold fast to their traditional structure of government.

entries.zh: 他们很欣赏我们的外交手段。
在一个有趣的跨文化交流例子中，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上相当数量的年轻人对[owner.GetAdj]的所有事物产生了消费性的兴趣。这些充满激情的年轻人急切地争抢与我们文化相关的任何东西，现在他们构成了这颗星球上一个充满活力和不断发展的亚文化群体。\n\n我们甚至得知即将到来的粉丝大会将举办一场服装大赛。
entries.en: In an amusing example of cross-cultural exchange, a significant number of young people on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have developed a consuming interest in all things [owner.GetAdj]. Eagerly snatching up anything even remotely connected to our culture, these passionate youngsters now comprise a vibrant and growing subculture on the planet.\n\nWe've even been told that an upcoming fan convention will feature a costume contest.

entries.zh: 够了，我们的文化只属于我们。
entries.en: Enough of this. Our culture is our own.

entries.zh: 假冒者们令人作呕，叫停他们。
限制这一情况一定会激起[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]人的反应。
entries.en: Restricting this event is sure to precipitate a response from the people of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName].

entries.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]大会取得了令人振奋的成功！人们不分老幼都聚集在这颗星球上最大的城市，欢庆[owner.GetName]的一切事物。除了大会带来的好意以外，它还为当地经济提供了急需的推动力。\n\n最精彩的也许是扮装比赛，大奖颁发给了我们[owner.GetRulerTitle][owner.GetRulerName]的死忠粉丝。
entries.en: The [owner.GetAdj] convention on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been a rousing success! Young and old alike gathered in the planet's largest city to celebrate all things [owner.GetName]. Apart from the good will the convention generated, it also provided a much needed boost to the local economy.\n\nBest of all perhaps was the costume contest, in which the grand prize was awarded to a particularly devoted fan of our own [owner.GetRulerTitle] [owner.GetRulerName].

entries.zh: 在我们利用影响力遏制了[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上蓬勃发展的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝群之后，那里的人们都团结起来以传统方式表达自己的文化。因此，艺术和文化部门的产出有了明显的改善。
entries.en: After we used our influence to curtail the burgeoning [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName], the people there have rallied around traditional expressions of their own culture. Accordingly, output in the arts and culture sectors has markedly improved.

entries.zh: 我们对[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[owner.GetAdj]粉丝采取的强硬态度引起了巨大的反弹。这颗星球上的许多人开始推崇自己的文化和传统，激烈反对[owner.GetAdj]。\n\n这将如何影响两颗星球的外交关系，还有待观察
entries.en: Our hardline approach to the [owner.GetAdj] fandom on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has precipitated a significant backlash. Rallying around their own culture and traditions, many on the planet have grown virulently anti-[owner.GetAdj].\n\nHow this may impact diplomatic relations between our worlds remains to be seen

entries.zh: 我们不需要他们的喜爱。
自己在宇宙中并不孤单，这一发现让[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]上的许多人感到震惊。毫不奇怪，这一事件产生了严重的经济影响。随着整颗星球上的金融机构暴跌不止，生活水平明显下降。
entries.en: The revelation that they were not alone in the universe came as a shock to many on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]. Not surprisingly, the event has had severe economic effects. With financial institutions across the planet in free-fall, there has been a marked decrease in the planet's standard of living.

entries.zh: 我们为[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]提供的金融刺激措施已经得到了丰厚的回报。他们的传统货币和经济机构在我们的支持下，终于稳定了下来。\n\n也许更重要的是，公众对我们继续留在该星系中的支持度空前高涨。
entries.en: The financial stimulus we provided to [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has paid off handsomely. With their traditional currencies and economic institutions bolstered by our support, conditions have finally stabilized.\n\nPerhaps more importantly, public approval for our continued presence in the system has never been higher.

entries.zh: 我们对市场仁慈的信任得到了丰厚的回报。\n\n摆脱了令人窒息的监管，[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]的金融机构已经稳定下来。那里的人们知道自己的经济前景一片大好，可以放心了。
entries.en: Our trust in the benevolence of the market has paid off handsomely.\n\nFreed from the imposition of stifling regulations, financial institutions on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] have stabilized. The people there can rest secure in the knowledge that their economic future is assured.

entries.zh: 我们对[pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName]市场自我纠正的信任变成了一场灾难，实在令人费解。事实上，星球上的状况前所未有的糟糕，人们吵着要政府加强对金融部门的监督。
entries.en: Inexplicably, our trust in the market to right itself on [pre_ftl_country.Capital.GetName] has been a disaster. In fact, conditions on the planet have never been worse, and the people there are clamoring for increased government oversight in the financial sector.

entries.zh: 成熟经济体有责任在危机时期支持那些不走运的人。
entries.en: It is the responsibility of mature economies to support the less fortunate in times of crisis.

entries.zh: 今天的投资就是明天的增长，这笔资金是必要的成本。
entries.en: Today's investment is tomorrow's growth; these funds are a necessary cost.

entries.zh: 与智慧生命的首次接触使这个社会的市场暴跌不止。
entries.en: First contact with intelligent life has sent this society's markets into a freefall.

entries.zh: 这颗星球的经济已经成功得到支撑。
entries.en: This planet's economy has successfully been bolstered.

entries.zh: 没有人能够预测到这种经济衰退。
entries.en: No one could have predicted this type of economic downturn.

entries.zh: 在[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]地表进行外交访问时，有一个孤独的[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]接近了我们。虽然[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural]是一个格式化的物种，但这个子个体认为自己是一个个体，现在向我们请求庇护。\n\n它看到我们后显然是受到了启发，希望融入我们的社会。当被询问时，它反复说自己无法融入蜂巢，并声称自己生来就一直拥有独立的意识。
entries.en: While on a diplomatic visit to the surface of [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName], we were approached by a lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]. Although the [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural] are a gestalt species, the drone in question identifies as an individual, and is now requesting asylum.\n\nApparently inspired by what they have seen of us, they wish to integrate themselves into our society. When questioned, they repeatedly stated that they are unable to fit in within the hive, and claim to have possessed an individual consciousness all their life.

entries.zh: 我们现在承担不起激怒蜂巢的后果。
entries.en: We cannot afford to antagonize the hive.

entries.zh:
我们拒绝了孤独的[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]子个体的庇护请求。我们认为这对双方都是最好的。

没有得到我们的合作，[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName]回到了同胞身边，乞求得到独立。

[preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural]向我们保证这只是一个反常子个体，它后来恢复了理智，并回到了集体中。这个所谓的个体不会再出现在我们面前。

与[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]的外交继续进行。
entries.en:
We refused the lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName] drone's request for asylum. We believed it was in the best interest of both parties.

Without our cooperation, the [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName] returned to their people, to plead for their independence.

The [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetNamePlural] have assured us this was merely a deviant drone who has since seen sense, and has returned to the collective. We won't hear from the so-called individual again.

Diplomacy with [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName] continues.

entries.zh: 起初，来自[preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName]的孤独子个体被巨大的转变所吓倒。然而，在最初的文化冲击消退后，子个体现在正在适应作为个体的生活。也许具有讽刺意味的是，它已经变得像我们一样了。
entries.en: At first, the lone [preftl_lone_drone_species.GetName] drone from [preftl_lone_drone_planet.GetName] was overwhelmed by the scale of the transition. However, after the initial culture shock subsided, the drone is now adjusting to life as an individual. Perhaps ironically, they have become like us.

entries.en: A new §HScientist§! is added to our §H$RECRUITABLE_LEADERS$§!.

entries.zh: 一座环绕着§Y[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]§!的废弃观测站。从中可以一窥在这个行星上的前超光速的§Y$NAME_Charynoi$§!文明的起源。
entries.en: An abandoned observation outpost orbits §Y[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]§!. It may shed some light on the origins of the pre-FTL §Y$NAME_Charynoi$§! civilization on the planet below.

entries.zh: [From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]上的废弃观测站似乎在报废前不久被改为他用。尽管上面还有用于监视行星居民的设备的证据，但看来大部分都改成了$NAME_Charynoi$的历史博物馆。奇怪的是，明明这是一个好斗的物种，但是关于暴力的主题被刻意回避了，展品主要集中在一些关于和平和生育的仪式上。\n\n在中控室发现了一系列数据水晶。显然这就是我们想要找的东西。
entries.en: The abandoned observation post above [From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName] appears to have been repurposed shortly before it was abandoned. Though there is equipment to surveil the inhabitants of the planet in evidence, most of it seems to be dedicated to a museum of $NAME_Charynoi$ history. Curiously for such a warlike species, subjects relating to violence seem to have been avoided, and exhibits appear to show various rituals of peace and fertility.\n\nA series of data crystals have been left in the control room. It is evident that we were supposed to find them.

entries.zh: 第一块数据水晶已经完成了翻译。其封面上写着“这是$NAME_Charynoi$民族的记录，系女先知伊蒂卡里奥斯所留，这样那些可能找到它的人能原谅我们的罪过。”\n\n其后是一份历史、哲学和艺术工作的合辑，可能是由一个比较标准但稍微好斗的晚工业革命社会所创。我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]将其发回[Owner.Capital.GetName]以进行进一步研究。
entries.en: The first crystal has been translated. It is prefaced with the words "This is the record of the $NAME_Charynoi$ people, left behind by the Prophetess Ithikarios, so that those who might find it may forgive us our sins."\n\nWhat follows is a collection of historical, philosophical and artistic works as may have been created by a fairly standard, if somewhat belligerent, late industrial society. Our [Owner.GetLinguists] have sent it back to [Owner.Capital.GetName] for further analysis.

entries.zh:
“现在我将叙述一切是如何走向错误——我们最初陷入傲慢罪恶的地方，”伊蒂卡里奥斯宣称。

第二颗晶体记录了$NAME_Charynoi$是如何逐渐揭开太空飞行的奥秘，似乎比[Root.Owner.GetName]早了大约一百年。他们在自己的星系中发现了两颗美丽的行星，并得出结论认为这些行星是神灵留给他们的产业，是他们与生俱来的权利，他们现在正在索取这些权利。

伊蒂卡里奥斯用惊恐的语气讲述了这些早期探索的黑暗面：在他们的新殖民地中，初生的文明并不愿意放弃他们的家园。他们被打败并被奴役，最终逐渐消亡，死于$NAME_Charynoi$不屑于治疗的疾病。

我们的[Owner.GetLinguists]正在努力翻译第三个也是最后一个数据晶体。
entries.en:
"Now I shall recount where it all went wrong - where we first fell to the sin of arrogance," declaims Ithikarios.

The second crystal recounts how the $NAME_Charynoi$ gradually uncovered the mysteries of space flight, seemingly about a hundred years before the [Root.Owner.GetName]. They found two beautiful planets in their own system, and concluded that those had been bequeathed to them by the Gods as their birthright, which they were now claiming.

In horrified tones, Ithikarios recounts the darker side to these early exploits: nascent civilizations on their new colonies had not willingly yielded their homes. Beaten into submission, they were enslaved and eventually dwindled, falling to diseases the $NAME_Charynoi$ did not care to cure.

Our [Owner.GetLinguists] are hard at work translating the third and final data crystal.

entries.zh:
最终，我们耗尽了我们所拥有的空间。我们知道虫洞的存在，但是它们无法被我们研究。我们的领土物产丰富景色优美，很容易让我们相信自己是天之选民。虫洞是一种考验，只要通过了考验，我们就能将自己的种族传遍整个星系，这是我们的神圣使命。

我曾经是那些试图履行这个职责的首领之一。当灵感降临在我身上——我意识到掌握了打开虫洞的钥匙——我便在祖先神社中祈祷了几天。最终得到了启示：我们不配。如果我们穿过虫洞，我们只会找到痛苦。$NAME_Aspharelle$将被清除，作为我们所犯罪行的惩罚。我决定销毁我的研究，并寻找一条不同的路。

要找到可以信任的人很难。如果我们被发现了，我们肯定宁可快速死亡。虽然我比以往任何时候都更加坚信我们是正确的，但我们会被视为叛教者。最终，我们启动了一个大胆的计划：在假装盲目飞越虫洞的愚蠢尝试的掩护下，我们建造了一艘方舟船，航行到未知的地方，朝着一个遥远的星球。我们经历了多年穿越空旷的太空，直到我们到达目的地。现在，我们只希望被留在和平中过上品德高尚的生活，以证明并非所有$NAME_Charynoi$都是邪恶的。

伊蒂卡里奥斯为她的兄弟们对我们造成的任何伤害深表歉意，她提到她试图在[From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName]周围竖起一个坚不可摧的盾牌，这样她的人民就不会再受到诱惑去寻找星辰。她失败了，但是我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]已经能够解决她的问题。现在，如果我们愿意，我们现在就可以竖起这个盾牌。
entries.en:
"Eventually, we exhausted the confines of the space we had been bequeathed. We knew of the existence of the Wormhole, but it defied our study. Our realm was so bountiful, so full of beauty, that it was not hard to convince ourselves that we were the Chosen. That the Wormhole was a test, and once we were worthy, it would be our Holy Purpose to spread our kind across all the galaxy.

"I was once chief amongst those seeking to fulfill this duty. When inspiration came to me - when I realized I held the key to the opening of the Wormhole - I prayed for days at the Shrine of my Ancestors. And eventually: Revelation. We were not worthy. If we went beyond the Wormhole, we would find only pain. $NAME_Aspharelle$ would be scoured, out of punishment for the crimes we had committed. I resolved to destroy my research and seek a different path.

"It was hard to find those who I could trust. If we were discovered, we would surely have longed for a quick death. Though I am more convinced than ever that we are right, we would have been seen as apostates. Eventually, we launched a daring plan: under the guise of making a fool attempt to fly the wormhole blind, we built an arkship to sail into the unknown, towards a distant star. Many years, we traveled through empty space, until we came to our destination. Now we wish nothing more than to be left in peace to live virtuous lives, so that we may prove that not all $NAME_Charynoi$ are evil."

Apologizing profusely for any harm done to us by her brethren, Ithikarios mentions her attempts at erecting an impenetrable shield around [From.Planet.MoonOf.GetName], so that her people would never again be tempted to seek the stars. She failed, but our [Owner.GetResearchers] have been able to work out where she went wrong. We could erect the shield now, if we so desire.

entries.zh: 我们可以随心所欲处置它。
entries.en: We can do with it as we please.

entries.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]应该可以完成伊蒂卡里奥斯想要用来包围§Y[This.GetName]§!的护盾，只需要提供足够的资源就行。
entries.en: Our [Owner.GetResearchers] should be able to complete the shield Ithikarios attempted to erect over §Y[This.GetName]§!, if we can provide them with sufficient resources.

entries.zh: 得益于我们[Owner.GetResearchers]的努力，伊蒂卡里奥斯想要用来包围[FromFrom.GetName]的护盾完成了。她的$NAME_Charynoi$子民终于可以得到安宁。
entries.en: Thanks to the efforts of our [Owner.GetResearchers], the shield Ithikarios attempted to erect over [FromFrom.GetName] has been completed. Her $NAME_Charynoi$ descendants can now find peace.

entries.zh: 由于我们的行动，沙莱诺伊女先知为她的人民寻求救赎的绝望努力被挫败了。他们的同类不会得到宽恕！
entries.en: By our actions, the desperate efforts of the Charynoi prophetess to find redemption for her people were thwarted. No forgiveness shall be shown to their kind!

entries.zh: 我们帮伊蒂卡里奥斯建成的护盾让夏瑞诺伊，或者说部分的夏瑞诺伊，可以得到救赎。
entries.en: Our completion of Ithikarios' shield has allowed the Charynoi - or at least some of them - to find redemption.

entries.zh: 尽管该居住站完全是人工建成，但其中的空气散布着田园的气息，让无论再天差地别的所有感性生物都能想起自己的家乡。
entries.en: Although this habitat is completely artificial, the air carries an idyllic quality that reminds any sentient creature - no matter how alien - of home.

entries.zh: 我们被困在虫洞里面太久了。但等等！终于，上天的恩赐帮助我们我们突破了施加于身上的桎梏。我们终于通过了考验。星系的其他地区都在等待着我们去征服。\n\n不要反抗。从长远来看，这样会更好。
entries.en: For too long have we been trapped behind the wormhole. But behold! Finally, we have breached the restrictions placed upon us by our celestial heritage. Now, at last, we know we are worthy. The rest of the galaxy is ours to claim.\n\nDo not resist. It will be better in the long run, that way.

entries.zh:
什……？你……突破了虫洞？怎么做到的？我们的科学家已经研究了很多年都没有成功。这肯定哪里出问题了。

……
……
……

这肯定是场考验。我不信任你们！我们必须从星系中清除你们这些东西！
entries.en:
Wha-? You... breached the wormhole? But how? Our best scientists have been working on it for years, without success. There must be some kind of mistake.

...
...
...

This must be a test. You are not to be trusted! We must cleanse our stars of your kind!

entries.zh: 开局拥有2艘§H$explorer_vessel_plural$§!，以及一艘配备§H亚空间引擎§!的§H$engineer_vessel$§!，这使它们无法进行超空间旅行，但能提供有限的跃迁引擎能力。\n提升§H超光速旅行§!科技的发现概率。
entries.en: Start with 2 §H$explorer_vessel_plural$§! and an §H$engineer_vessel$§! equipped with §HSubspace Drives§!, making them incapable of Hyperlane travel but granting limited Jump Drive abilities.\nGain an increased chance to discover §HFTL Travel§! Technologies

entries.zh: $CHALLENGING_CIVIC$出于对星空的渴望，这个文明在好几个发展阶段都加速了进程，比大多数国家更早地达到了探索星海的时代。
entries.en: $CHALLENGING_CIVIC$Yearning for the stars, this civilization sped through several stages of development, reaching the age of galactic exploration far earlier than most.

entries.zh: $CHALLENGING_CIVIC$多年来，这个文明被告知超空间引擎几乎就要完成了。他们耐心地等待着，然而一直以来，负责该项目的子公司都在悄悄地将资金转入他们自己的私人账户。当欺诈行径最终被揭露时，公司只能仓促之下提供实验性、探索性的船只。
entries.en: $CHALLENGING_CIVIC$For years, this civilization was told that the hyperdrive was almost finished. Patiently they waited, yet all the while, the subsidiary in charge of the project was quietly diverting the funds into their own, private accounts. When the fraud was finally revealed, the Corporation hastened to provide experimental, exploratory vessels.

entries.zh: $eager_explorers_base_effect$\n开局就拥有§H$tech_starbase_3$§!科技，并且在母星系有一座已经建成的§H$tech_starbase_3$§!。\n£building£§Y$building_private_mining_consortium$§!$megacorp_civic_branch_office_building_effect$
entries.en: $eager_explorers_base_effect$\nStart with the §H$tech_starbase_3$§! technology and a §H$tech_starbase_3$§! already built in your home system.\nThe £building£ §Y$building_private_mining_consortium$§! $megacorp_civic_branch_office_building_effect$

entries.zh: $CHALLENGING_CIVIC$在凝视着夜空的奇迹之后，这个蜂巢思维一直渴望向外探索。为了追求这一雄心壮志，其他形式的发展被搁置一边，并建造了一支能够进行有限亚空间旅行的小型船队。
entries.en: $CHALLENGING_CIVIC$Gazing with wonder at the night sky, this Hive has always yearned for exploration. In pursuit of this ambition, other forms of development were sidelined, and a small fleet of vessels capable of limited subspace travel was constructed.

entries.zh: $eager_explorers_base_effect$\n添加§H$trait_stargazer$§!特质。\n开局时对起始星团的情报为低。
entries.en: $eager_explorers_base_effect$\nAdds the §H$trait_stargazer$§! trait.\nBegin with low Intel about your starting cluster.

entries.zh: $CHALLENGING_CIVIC$这个机械智能中央程序的基石是对外行星生命进行编录的冲动。为了追求这一指令，它将自身资源的绝大多数都用于建造一支小型船队，进行有限的亚空间旅行。
entries.en: $CHALLENGING_CIVIC$The foundation of this Machine Intelligence's central programming is the drive to catalog exoplanetary life. In pursuit of this directive, it has dedicated much of its resources to crafting a small fleet of vessels capable of limited subspace travel.

entries.zh: $eager_explorers_base_effect$\n观测前超光速文明可获得额外§G50%§!的洞见进度。\n每次完成建立第一次接触可获得£unity£§H凝聚力§!。
entries.en: $eager_explorers_base_effect$\nGain §G50%§! more Insight progress from observing pre-FTL Civilizations.\nGain £unity£§HUnity§! every time you finish establishing first contact.

entries.zh: 这些亚空间驱动引擎是在离开我们的家园的迫切愿望下诞生的一种方案，它的设计目的是用来进行有限的星际旅行。虽然它们只能进行小规模跃迁，但仍提供了一个千载难逢的机会来启动我们的星海探索。
entries.en: An insight borne of a desperate desire to leave our home, these Subspace Drive engines were designed to facilitate limited interstellar travel. While only allowing small-scale jumps, they provide a unique opportunity to jumpstart our galactic exploration.

entries.zh: 亚空间引擎能够在时空上创造细微的裂缝，让舰船能够跃迁到临近的恒星系。如果跃迁的距离太长，这个过程会变得非常不稳定。
entries.en: The Subspace Drive creates microtears in spacetime, allowing vessels to jump to nearby systems. The process becomes incredibly unstable if longer jumps are attempted.

entries.zh: 棒极了。将它们加入到我们的索引库。
entries.en: Excellent. Add them to our catalog.

entries.zh: §Y[From.GetName]§!少了几颗星球。\n\n所有的计算都表明应该还有几个天体存在，但在这个星系中却找不到它们的踪迹。传感器已经重新校准，数字也重新核对过，但得出的结论被现实所推翻。我们已经在自己的星图上标记出了失踪小行星的位置。
entries.en: §Y[From.GetName]§! is missing planets.\n\nAll calculations point to the existence of several more celestial bodies, yet they are nowhere to be found in the system. Sensors have been recalibrated and numbers rechecked, but the theory stands disproven by reality. We have marked the missing planetoids positions on our star charts.

entries.zh: $fircon.5000.desc.base$\n\n或许再靠近些扫描这个星系会得到更多信息。
entries.en: $fircon.5000.desc.base$\n\nPerhaps a closer scan of the system could reveal more.

entries.zh: $fircon.5000.desc.base$\n\n我们认为达恰星系中相邻的[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]与这一状况有关。
entries.en: $fircon.5000.desc.base$\n\nWe gather that the neighboring [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] in the Dacha system are connected to this.

entries.zh: $fircon.5000.desc.base$\n\n看来是过去达恰星系中相邻的[owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]造就了这一怪异的星系。然而通往那里的超空间航道却消失了。
entries.en: $fircon.5000.desc.base$\n\nIt seems like the previously neighboring [owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural] in the Dacha system created this strange system. Yet the hyperlane leading there has since disappeared.

entries.zh: 那些星球是被移动了！\n\n我们在§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!星系探测到的异常超空间航道都连接着我们认为应该存在星球的位置。在研究了这些怪异的航道后，我们发现它们都通向同一个地方。一个叫做§Y达恰§!的恒星系，本以为是无法到达的，但如果把这些狭窄的超空间航道合并起来，我们就能送一艘科研船过去。
entries.en: The planets were moved!\n\nThe abnormal hyperlanes we detected in the §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§! system were each tethered to where we previously had expected to discover worlds. After studying these strange lanes, we realize they all lead to the same place. A star system called §YDacha§!, which was thought unreachable, yet if we were to combine all these slender hyperlanes, we could pass a science ship through.

entries.zh: 找到超空间航道通往何处！
entries.en: Find out where the hyperlanes lead!
Do we really want to know?

entries.zh: 围绕着§Y[From.GetName]§!星系三颗恒星的每颗行星都是生态天堂，即盖亚星球，每一颗都能维持有机生命。由于这些星球上没有污染，起初我们认为它们可能无人居住。然而在进行了更深入的扫描后，我们在每颗星球上都发现了横亘整颗星球的大型城市。\n\n更奇怪的是，似乎只有环绕中心恒星的行星是属于这个星系的。其他的恒星则由来自$NAME_Helito$和其他更遥远的星系的行星环绕。
entries.en: Orbiting each of the three stars in the §Y[From.GetName]§! system are ecological paradises, Gaia worlds, each capable of sustaining organic life. Initially, we thought these might be uninhabited, given the lack of pollution. Yet after performing deeper scans we discovered large sprawling cities spanning each planet from end to end.\n\nStranger still, it seems like only the central star has planets originally from this system. The others are orbited by planets from $NAME_Helito$ and other, more remote systems.

entries.zh: 检测到极高密度的有机生命。
entries.en: EXTREME CONCENTRATION OF ORGANIC LIFE DETECTED.

entries.zh: 有了[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，那些星球会变得更好。
entries.en: Those worlds would look better with [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] on them.

entries.zh: 遭遇哈宾特统一星球国

调查一颗新的盖亚星球通常是一个重大事件，但它将成为[Root.GetName]的船员在未来几个月里的例行公事。这些星球包含着一些非常奇怪的[Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural]，它们显然还没有实现宇宙飞行，但它们的可再生能源生产可以媲美我们最高效的反应堆。\n\n更奇怪的是资源的平均分配。每颗星球都有生存所需的一切，这应该是不可能的。我们看到只在一颗星球出产的货物抵达另一颗星球，却没有一艘运输船起飞。
entries.en: Surveying a new Gaia world is usually a momentous event but for the crew of the [Root.GetName] it is going to become routine for the next few months. The multiple worlds house some very strange [Owner.GetPreFTLLowerPlural], they obviously have not achieved spaceflight yet their renewable energy production rivals our most efficient reactors.\n\nA further oddity is the equal spread of resources. Every world has everything they need to survive, which should be impossible. We are seeing goods only produced on one planet arrive on another without a single transport ship taking flight.

entries.zh: 我们要赶快建立一座观测哨站！
entries.en: We need an observation outpost now!

entries.zh: §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§!的[GetPreFTLLowerPlural]在某种程度上比我们更善于运用超空间航道理论。它们的每一颗星球都通过一座人造超空间航道网络相互连接。这些航道用来向其他星球运送必要的资源，如食物或建筑材料，而我们不知道它们是如何做到这一点的。\n\n要求更多的[Root.GetScientistPlural]来研究这些星球的请求已经得到批准。虽然从它们的行星监听站的活动来看，它们应该也在观察我们。
entries.en: The [GetPreFTLLowerPlural] of §Y[From.solar_system.GetName]§! are somehow more adept with hyperlane theory than we are. Every one of their worlds are linked to each other through an artificial hyperlane network. These lanes are used transport necessary resources like food or building materials to their other worlds just using planet-bound trains, and we have no idea how they did it.\n\nA request for more [Root.GetScientistPlural] to study these worlds has been approved. Though judging by the activity at their planetary listening posts; we are not the only ones looking at aliens.

entries.zh: 我们以为那些能够穿越星空的人不会如此原始地诉诸暴力。\n\n§R请离开。§!
entries.en: We thought those who could traverse the stars wouldn't be so primitive as to resort to violence.\n\n§RLeave.§!

entries.zh: §R我们在§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]星系§!的所有舰船都在行动中失踪了。\n所有通往§Y[From.solar_system.GetName]星系§!的超空间航道都变得很不稳定。§!
entries.en: §RAll our ships in the §Y[From.solar_system.GetName] system§! have gone missing in action.\nAll Hyperlanes to the §Y[From.solar_system.GetName] system§! have become unstable.§!

entries.zh: 我们已经见识过了泛星系的真面目，并选择隐居避世。然而我们还是遭到了骚扰，你们真的想看看我们的宝藏吗？那就让你们见识一下。
entries.en: We have seen what kind of galaxy it is and chose to avoid it, yet again we are disturbed, do you really want to see our treasures? Then let us show you.

entries.zh: §R§Y[From.GetName]星系§!旁边的每个星系都建立起了新的超空间航道。§!
entries.en: §REvery system near the §Y[From.GetName] system§! has had new hyperlanes established.§!

entries.zh: 试图通过与[event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj]合作来获取超空间航道技术知识的进度一直缓慢得令人沮丧。要想像他们一样掌握局域超空间航道群，我们似乎需要花费数千年的时间来编制超空间波动的目录。我们收到了他们首席代表的新信息。\n\n“老实说，你们在这里让我们越来越不舒服了，既然我们已经帮你们完成了来这里的目的，我们得请你们离开。我们判断你我双方的生活方式不可相容，担心你们在未来可能会觊觎我们拥有的东西。为了避免显得过于粗鲁，我们愿意送给你们一颗星球。我们会负责运输的，不用担心。”
entries.en: The insights we have gained into hyperlane technology through our cooperation with the [event_target:solarpunk_country.GetSpeciesAdj] has been frustratingly slow. It seems that to achieve the mastery of a local hyperlane cluster like they have, we would need to spend thousands of years cataloging hyper-fluctuations. We have received a new communication from their chief representative.\n\n"To be honest, your presence here has been grating, so now that we have taught you what you came for, we need to ask you to leave. Having judged that our ways of life are incompatible, we worry that you might covet what we have in the future. So to prevent any feelings of ill will, we wish to offer you one of our worlds. We will handle the transportation, don't worry."
We accept, have a good life.
§YSol X§! will be added in orbit around §Y[capital_star.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 我们要夺走你们的秘密！
§R侵略这些外星人，获得超空间航道的秘密。§!
entries.en: §RInvade the aliens to learn the secrets of the hyperlanes.§!

entries.zh: 这个星系中有大量的超空间航道。通常情况下，我们会认为它们太小了，宇宙飞船无法在其中航行，但是它们的数量本身就很惊人。
entries.en: There are an unusual amount of hyperlanes in this system. Usually, we would dismiss these as too small to facilitate a spaceship, but the sheer amount is intriguing in and of itself.

entries.zh: 这个民族过着怡然自得的生活，却被激怒了。
entries.en: This nation was content living on their own, yet they had to be antagonized.

entries.zh: 完善的大气控制系统保持了这颗行星的原始状态。
entries.en: Perfected atmospheric controls maintaining this planets pristine status.

entries.zh: 享受行星美景的度假胜地。
entries.en: A retreat to enjoy this planets beauty.

entries.zh: 一棵巨大的树苗，是数世纪研究与操控植物的成果，能够养活上百万人口。
entries.en: A titanic sapling, the result of centuries of floral research and manipulation, capable of feeding millions.

entries.zh: 隐蔽在宏伟森林中的城市，使居民更接近自然。
entries.en: Cities covered in grand forests, bringing the inhabitants closer to nature.

entries.zh: 在实现了自己的乌托邦之后，这些星球雕塑家们很高兴地开始休息。
entries.en: Having achieved their utopia these world sculptors are glad to rest.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$由于有怪异的超空间航道活动，不能在这个星系的这些行星周围建造。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannon't be built around these planets in this system because of strange hyperlane activity.

entries.zh: 这个前超光速文明仍然在适应他们并非宇宙中唯一存在这一事实。
entries.en: This pre-FTL civilization is still adjusting to the knowledge that they are not alone in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们至少有一支舰队被迫解除隐形状态。
entries.en: At least one of our fleets has been forced to Decloak.

entries.zh: 我们至少有一支舰队被迫解除隐形状态，并且在行动中失踪。他们重新归队还需要一段时间。
entries.en: At least one of our fleets has been forced to Decloak and has gone Missing In Action. It will take them some time to return and rejoin the ranks.

entries.zh: 我们的探测阵列发现了至少一艘隐形的非盟友舰队，我们迫使其解除了隐形状态。
entries.en: Our Detection Arrays discovered at least one cloaked, non-allied fleet and have forced it to Decloak.

entries.zh: 我们的探测阵列发现了至少一艘隐形的非盟友舰队，我们迫使其解除了隐形状态。这些舰队现在处于行动中失踪状态。
entries.en: Our Detection Arrays discovered at least one cloaked, non-allied fleet and forced it to Decloak. The fleet(s) have gone Missing In Action.

entries.zh: 一个外星帝国派遣了一艘舰船抵达我们的边境来开启外交通讯。
entries.en: An alien empire has sent a ship to our border to begin diplomatic communications.

entries.zh: §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!派遣了一艘舰船到我们的边境上，广播着重复的信号。\n\n翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出以为代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
entries.en: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! stationed a vessel at our border, broadcasting a repeating signal.\n\nIt was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange event on their ship.

entries.zh: §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!停靠在我们舰队边上，广播着重复的信号。\n\n翻译这些信息颇具挑战，但我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]相信他们是在邀请我们派出一位代表去往他们的舰船上参加一场持续多日的文化交流活动。
entries.en: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! drew alongside our fleet, broadcasting a repeating signal.\n\nIt was a challenge to translate their message, but our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe they are inviting one of our representatives to a multi-day cultural exchange event on their ship.

entries.zh: 行，但听起来很像一个陷阱。
entries.en: Ok, but this sounds like a trap.

entries.zh: 我们会派我们的特使去参加活动。
entries.en: We will send our envoy to the event.

entries.zh: [This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]和我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]连蒙带猜地接受了外星人的文化交流邀请。§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的热烈反应应该是积极的。不久之后，他们发来了表示派对倒计时的象形文字。\n\n[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]正在利用剩余的时间准备并进一步学习我们目前获得的语言样本。
entries.en: With a little bit of guesswork, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] and our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] accepted the alien cultural exchange invitation. We interpreted the enthusiastic response from the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! as positive. Shortly after, they sent pictographs depicting a countdown to the party.\n\n[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is using the remaining time to prepare and further study the language samples we have obtained.

entries.zh: 这是不可多得的学习机会。
entries.en: This is a unique learning opportunity.

entries.zh: 我们会为邀请做好准备。
entries.en: We will prepare for the invitation.

entries.zh: 这是一个秘密收集信息的绝佳机会。
entries.en: This would be a perfect chance to covertly gather intel.

entries.zh: 我们同意参会，但会让特使装备上间谍科技。
entries.en: We agree, but will equip our envoy with our spy tech.

entries.zh: §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!文化交流活动的倒计时马上就到尾声了。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]很快就要登上前往外星特使舰船的太空梭。出于尊重，宴会期间与我们的[This.Owner.GetEnvoy]的通讯将会暂停。
entries.en: The countdown to the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! cultural exchange event is nearing completion. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] is about to board the shuttle to the alien envoy ship. Communication with our [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] will pause for the duration of the party out of respect.

entries.zh: 我们应该尽可能地融入他们的文化。
entries.en: We should embrace their culture as best as possible.

entries.zh: 我们的特使将会试着与他们的文化保持一致。
entries.en: Our envoy will try to integrate with their culture.

entries.zh: 表现得热情又专业就行。
我们的特使会以专业的态度行事。
我们的特使将会尽可能地获取情报。
entries.en: Our envoy will learn as much as they can.

entries.zh: 我们对§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的邀请不闻不问冒犯到了他们。他们的态度发生了一百八十度大转弯。在后续的通讯中我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]翻译出了一些敌意性的言辞。\n\n他们似乎不想要我们拒绝。
entries.en: Our lack of interest in their invitation has offended the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. Their tone has dramatically changed. Our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] translated some hostile language within their follow-up communication.\n\nIt seems they do not want to take no for an answer.

entries.zh: 很好很好。我们会出席的。
我们终究会为了顺畅的外交关系出席的。
entries.en: We will attend, after all, for the sake of smooth diplomatic relations.

entries.zh: 我们没有任何理由接受这个邀请
entries.en: We will in no way accept the invitation.

entries.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的活动持续的时间远超预期。

[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]的太空梭返回时汇报了任务失败。

在活动过程中，主办方找到了谍报装置。[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]遭到了审问和训斥，并被遣返。通过后备间谍科技获取的数据，我们现在理解了他们的语言和科技，然而我们的外交前景一片渺茫。
entries.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation failed.

During the event, the hosts found an espionage device. [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] was interrogated, scolded and then asked to leave. Using the data from the back-up spy tech, we now understand their language and technology, although our diplomatic future will start on rocky ground.

entries.zh:
§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的活动举办时间远超预期。

乘坐太空梭返回后，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]汇报了行动大获成功。不仅这种外星语言被大部分破解了，我们的扫描也揭示了他们科技能力的清晰图景。

这将会极大地促进我们与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!未来的关系，同时还让他们对我们对他们科技了如指掌一事蒙在鼓里。
entries.en:
The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s event lasted much longer than expected.

When [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName]'s shuttle returned, they reported that the operation was a success. Not only did they successfully decipher most of the alien language, but our scan has given us a clear picture of their technological capabilities.

This will greatly enhance further relations with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!, without them being aware of our understanding of their scientific knowledge.

entries.zh: 敞开心胸来到这场持续多日的盛会，[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]参加了音乐、戏剧和舞蹈的表演，并尝试了许多餐饮传统。他们对各种体验的接受得到了§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的热烈欢迎。\n\n离开时，[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]对他们的语言获得了非常深切的理解，对他们的文化也颇为赞赏。这段经历将会为我们未来与§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!更加积极正面的外交奠定基础。
entries.en: Entering the multi-day event with an open mind, [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] joined in musical, theater, and dance performances and explored various culinary traditions. Their receptiveness to experience was met enthusiastically by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.\n\n[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with an intimate understanding of their language and a deep appreciation of their culture. Their experience will pave the way to more positive diplomatic interactions with the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 来自新朋友的邀请真是亲切啊。
entries.en: A kind invitation from new friends.

entries.zh: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]在这场持续多日的活动中客气地参观着文艺活动，小试着他们的饮食文化。不温不火的态度让§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!颇感沮丧。根据我们对他们语言的理解，他们说我们的特使“很无聊”。\n\n我们的特使被护送回到太空梭上并被示意离开。特使已经掌握了他们的语言，并对他们的文化有了初步的了解，我们可以在未来的外交互动中以此为基础。
entries.en: [This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] spent the multi-day event reservedly observing artistic shows and sampling the culinary traditions. The lack of enthusiasm frustrated the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!. According to our understanding of their language, our envoy was considered boring.\n\nEscorted back to their shuttle and signaled to leave, our envoy has left with competence in their language and a surface understanding of their culture, something we can build upon for future diplomatic interactions.

entries.zh: 在这场持续数天的活动这，§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!对营养需求的差异的沮丧显而易见。幸好[This.Owner.GetEnvoy][This.Leader.GetName]还是积极参与到了其他的娱乐活动中，并建立了互相的尊重。\n\n[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap][This.Leader.GetName]离开时对§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!的语言文化获得了基本的了解。值得赞扬的是，他们似乎对这一饮食灾难泰然自若，并为我们提供了许多礼仪手册。虽然乏味，但这些知识应该有助于顺利进行未来的外交互动。
entries.en: The §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s disappointment in the difference between our nutritional needs couldn't have been more apparent over the multi-day event. Thankfully [This.Owner.GetEnvoy] [This.Leader.GetName] did their best to take an active part in the entertainment events, and mutual respect was established.\n\n[This.Owner.GetEnvoyCap] [This.Leader.GetName] has left with a decent understanding of the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!'s language and culture. To their credit, they seemed to take this culinary mishap in stride, and have provided us with a number of etiquette manuals. While tedious, this knowledge should help smooth future diplomatic interactions.
Understanding is the cornerstone of diplomacy.

entries.zh: 第二次拒绝§H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§!让我们前往他们的舰船的邀请得到了情绪激烈的回复。我们收到了一份来自多名外星船员长达数个小时的通讯，我们的[This.Owner.GetLinguists]认为他们似乎是在因我们的不愿出息而发出谴责。\n\n这些通信，加上从他们船上截获的信号，使我们能够破译足够多他们的语言以产生有意义的理解。尽管他们对这一事件持消极态度，但我们现在可以建立更适当的外交关系了。
entries.en: The second rejection by the §H[This.ContactCountry.GetName]§! to invite us to their ship was met with a strong emotional response. We received communication from multiple alien crew members for several hours, in what our [This.Owner.GetLinguists] believe was an attempt to guilt us for not attending.\n\nThese communications, along with intercepted signals from their ship, have allowed us to decipher enough of their language to have a working understanding. We can now initiate more appropriate diplomatic connections, although they have taken this initial incident negatively.
